programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe

Met de hulp van Merel en de squad plannen de twee meisjes een episch feestje. Maar de avond neemt al snel een dramatische wending.

programme.title: Straight through the Low Countries / Dwars door de Lage Landen
programme.desc: The adventure starts on the beach of Ostend and from there Arnout Hauben continues through the Flemish polders. In Meetkerke he meets Amede, who used to pump water from the polders to drain the land. Arnout has a surprise for Amede. With special glasses, the retired pompist can watch Ruben's drone fly over the polders. The tour then continues through Bruges and along the Belgian-Dutch border where smuggling stories of yesteryear are available for the taking. / Het avontuur start op het strand van Oostende en vanaf daar trekt Arnout Hauben verder door de Vlaamse polders. In Meetkerke maakt hij kennis met Amede, die vroeger het water uit de polders pompte om het land droog te leggen. Arnout heeft een verrassing voor Amede. Met een speciale bril kan de pompist op rust meekijken door de drone van Ruben die over de polders vliegt. Daarna gaat de tocht verder over Brugge en langs de Belgisch-Nederlandse grens waar smokkelverhalen van weleer voor het oprapen liggen.

Danira surprises Christiane with a private concert on a centuries-old violin. / Elke en Nathalie ontrafelen het mysterie achter de bijzondere klok van Jorg en Ines. Valerie zou graag de geboortebeer van haar mama hersteld zien. Een moeilijke opdracht voor poppendokter Geertje want Valeries moeder en haar beer zijn onafscheidelijk. Danira verrast Christiane met een priveconcert op een eeuwenoude viool.

programme.title: Floor's rules / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: When Floor and Margreet decide to snack on marshmallows, Jan intervenes. Eating marshmallows without a tent and campfire is sacrilege! Irritated, Floor and Margreet wait until Jan is ready to roast marshmallows outdoors. That takes centuries, so they take matters into their own hands. / Wanneer Floor en Margreet besluiten lekker marshmallows te snoepen grijpt Jan in. Marshmallows eten zonder tent en kampvuur is heiligschennis! Geïrriteerd wachten Floor en Margreet tot Jan klaar is voor het outdoor marshmallows roosteren. Dat duurt eeuwen, dus nemen ze het heft in eigen hand.

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: All gymnastics equipment is broken. Soekie promises that she will provide a new trampoline. Pedro demands that if Soekie does not succeed by the end of the week, she must resign as student council president. With the help of her friends, Soekie raises enough money for the new trampoline. But then she discovers that the money was not acquired completely honestly. If Pedro discovers this, he will immediately demand her resignation. / Al het turnmateriaal is stuk. Soekie belooft dat ze voor een nieuwe trampoline zal zorgen. Pedro eist dat indien dit Soekie niet lukt tegen het einde van de week, ze moet opstappen als voorzitter van de leerlingenraad. Met de hulp van haar vrienden zamelt Soekie genoeg geld in voor de nieuwe trampoline. Maar dan ontdekt ze dat het geld niet helemaal op een eerlijke manier is verworven. Indien Pedro dit ontdekt, zal hij onmiddellijk haar ontslag eisen.

programme.title: The goldfish / De goudvis
programme.desc: Dieter and Kevin are almost halfway through their journey and receive a surprise visit from Jacotte Brokken to celebrate. During their boat trip they are pulled over by the shipping police. In Klein-Willebroek they can have lunch with a couple who live along the water. Kevin and Dieter also sail along the Zennegat where they are warmly welcomed on a houseboat and can stay there. They make a stopover in Lier and taste the Lierse regional specialty. They then end up in Viersel at a bison farm run by a sympathetic family. / Dieter en Kevin zitten bijna in de helft van hun tocht en krijgen een verrassingsbezoek van Jacotte Brokken om dat te vieren. Tijdens hun vaartocht worden ze aan de kant gehouden door de scheepvaartpolitie. In Klein-Willebroek mogen ze lunchen bij een koppel dat langs het water woont. Kevin en Dieter varen ook langs het Zennegat waar ze hartelijk ontvangen worden op een woonboot en er mogen logeren. Ze maken een tussenstop in Lier en proeven er de Lierse streekspecialiteit. Vervolgens belanden ze in Viersel bij een bizonboerderij die wordt uitgebaat door een sympathieke familie.

programme.sub-title: Te bed of niet te bed
programme.desc: Carmen complains about Xavier's lack of passion. When the latter starts repairing Pascale's bed, Fernand interprets this differently. He starts a fire at Carmen's house, resulting in her throwing Xavier out. Xavier then goes to stay with Pascale, which worsens the misunderstanding. Meanwhile, Carmen hooks up with Fernand in the hope of making Xavier jealous... / Carmen klaagt over het gebrek van passie bij Xavier. Wanneer deze laatste bij Pascale het bed gaat repareren, wordt dit door Fernand anders geïnterpreteerd. Hij gaat stoken bij Carmen, met als gevolg dat zij Xavier buitengooit. Xavier gaat dan maar logeren bij Pascale, wat het misverstand nog verergert. Ondertussen papt Carmen aan met Fernand in de hoop Xavier jaloers te maken...

programme.desc: Mohammed has been through a lot in his life. He fled his native country and is now looking for love in Belgium. Can he find that love with Thomas? Sabine wants to open herself up to love again. She already receives special gifts from her date Ryan. Ann and Heidi are looking for a new buddy, a friend to do fun things with. Marco likes to make people happy with food. Hopefully he will be liked by Santina, a social and spontaneous lady. / Mohammed heeft al veel meegemaakt in zijn leven. Hij is zijn geboorteland ontvlucht en zoekt nu de liefde in België. Kan hij die liefde vinden bij Thomas? Sabine wil zich terug openstellen voor de liefde. Ze krijgt alvast speciale cadeaus van haar date Ryan. Ann en Heidi zijn op zoek naar een nieuwe buddy, een vriendin om leuke dingen mee te doen. Marco maakt graag mensen blij met eten. Hopelijk valt hij in de smaak bij Santina, een sociale en spontane dame.

programme.title: Blood flowers / Krvavo cvijeće
programme.desc: The story of Dilan and Baran, two young people who are forced to enter the port of marriage. programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: The nation bears witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Special treatment / Poseban tretman
programme.desc: Doctor Ilić works in a hospital for forced treatment of alcoholics. Carrying out his "special treatment" composed of physical exercises, an apple diet, the healing effect of Wagner's music and psychodrama, he and a group of six patients visit a brewery where alcoholism in the workplace is a big problem. From the events that follow, it is revealed that the doctor applies his way of treating patients in order to express his essentially despotic and hypocritical personality. / Doktor Ilić radi u bolnici za prinudno liječenje alkoholičara. Sprovodeći svoj "poseban tretman" sastavljen od fizičkih vežbi, dijete jabukama, iscjeliteljskog dejstva Vagnerove muzike i psihodrame, on sa grupom od šest pacijenata odlazi u posjetu pivari u kojoj je veliki problem alkoholizam na radnom mjestu. Iz događaja koji slijede otkriva se da doktor primjenjuje svoj način liječenja pacijenata kako bi mogao da izrazi svoju, u suštini, despotsku i hipokritsku ličnost.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Wild bees / Divlje pčele
programme.desc: Three sisters were left alone after the death of their father. Without the support of a man, they will have to stand up to the opposite and dominant sex and show that they are capable of running their own estate. / Tri sestre ostale su same nakon smrti oca. Bez podrške nekog muškarca one će morati da se suprotstave suprotnom i dominantnom spolu i pokazati da su sposobne same voditi svoje imanje.

programme.title: The best of the ATV morning / Najbolje iz ATV jutra
programme.desc: The morning program of Alternative Television "ATV jutro" is a specific combination of information and entertainment. The first daily information, the first morning reports from the field throughout Republika Srpska, interesting contributions from the world of politics, culture and sports, dedicated to people and interesting events. / Jutarnji program Alternativne televizije "ATV jutro" specifičan je spoj informative i zabave. Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Look to tomorrow / Pogledaj u sutra
programme.desc: Chloe Delcourt went in search of her son after the terrible explosion on the coast of Sète. Her life turns upside down when the body of her sister, whom she hasn't seen for years, is found on the shore... / Chloe Delcourt otišla je u potragu za svojim sinom nakon strašne eksplozije na obali Sète. Njezin život okrene se naglavačke kada na obali pronađu tijelo njezine sestre koju godinama nije vidjela...

programme.title: ATV news / ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: The world of agriculture / Svijet poljoprivrede
programme.desc: An agricultural show with a long tradition and author's project of the editor and presenter Dejan Jovanović brings verified information of knowledge and experience that is of interest to every farmer. / Poljoprivredna emisija dugogodišnje tradicije i autorski projekat urednika i voditelja Dejana Jovanovića donosi provjerene informacije znanja i iskustva koja interesuju svakog poljoprivrednika.

programme.title: Agrarian / Agrar
programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. To those who want to learn something new and useful, they want to improve production and increase yields. / Emisija je posvećena poljoprivrednicima, ali i onima koji žive u urbanim sredinama, imaju baštu, vrt, voćnjak, plastenik. Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: Autoshop magazin / Autoshop magazin
programme.desc: A specialized and sponsored show dedicated to the world of the automotive industry. The most important information, novelties, reviews in the half-hourly edition are ideal for four-wheeled lovers. / Specijalizovana i sponzorisana emisija posvećena svijetu automobilske industrije. Najvažinije informacije, noviteti, recenzije u polusatnom izdanju idealne su za ljubitelje četvorotočkaša.

programme.title: Cyrillic / Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: The intending traveler / Putnik namjernik
programme.desc: Join Zoran Matić, travel writer, tourist guide and blogger from Banja Luka, on travels through the Balkans and beyond. In the show, you will discover hidden beauties, cultural stories, local gastronomy and must-see places. / Pridružite se Zoranu Matiću, putopiscu, turističkom vodiču i blogeru iz Banja Luke, na putovanjima kroz Balkan i dalje. U emisiji ćete otkrivati skrivene ljepote, kulturne priče, lokalnu gastronomiju i mjesta koja morate posjetiti.

programme.title: The nation bears witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-reportage show by journalist Biljana Stokić, will reveal to you what the heart of the people says about Srpska, about the tradition and history of our towns and villages, about their everyday life and the struggle to preserve true values, hard work, faith, and love for their and our homeland. In a mix of honest stories of those who live from their work, through the discovery of landmarks and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with words of hope and inspiration, and with images that melt the heart, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokić, with many years of journalistic experience, will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are its problems and challenges? Where does he find the strength to work and nurture traditions and good interpersonal relationships? How does our birth lump breathe and does it have equal beauty? What do they remember? What are they amazed by? What do they return to? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell their story, those for whom we do not know how much love, perseverance, courage they carry, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt both suffering and the beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

programme.title: Clear water / Bistra voda
programme.desc: The story of two once close friends, Aleksandar and Arsen, who unexpectedly meet in Skopje after 45 years. Years of betrayal and separation have left deep traces, and the meeting awakens memories, emotions and hope for reconciliation. / Priča o dva nekada bliska prijatelja, Aleksandru i Arsenu, koji se nakon 45 godina neočekivano sreću u Skoplju. Godine izdaje i razdvojenosti ostavile su duboke tragove, a susret budi sjećanja, emocije i nadu za pomirenje.

programme.title: Business club / Biznis klub
programme.desc: With a new concept, the business club will bring the economy closer to you and provide you with relevant current events in the field of economy and business, monitor economic developments and trends at the global level and investigate their impact on the growth and development of the economy in Srpska. We will reveal to you successful entrepreneurs and their experiences in business, and affirm those who are just at the beginning of developing their business ideas. Along with regular reports from stock exchanges and the gold market, one of the priorities will be reports from regional economic forums, where we will seek answers to key questions from eminent experts. / Biznis klub novim konceptom približiće vam ekonomiju i pružiti vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti ekonomije i privrede, ispratiti ekonomska kretanja i trendove na globalnom nivou i istražiti njihov uticaj na rast i razvoj ekonomije u Srpskoj. Otkrićemo vam uspješne preduzetnike i njihova iskustva u poslovanju, te afirmisati one koji tek na početku razvoja svojih poslovnih ideja. Uz redovne izvještaje sa berzi i tržišta zlata, jedan od prioriteta biće i izvještaji sa regionalnih ekonomskih foruma, gdje ćemo od eminentnih stručnjaka potražiti odgovore na ključna pitanja.

programme.title: Sisi / Sisi
programme.desc: The Extraordinary Life of Elizabeth of Bavaria, better known as Sisi, tells the story of an extraordinary woman who became Europe's first superstar. The series follows her teenage days, her love story with Emperor Franz Joseph I, and life's ups and downs, revealing her greatest joys, but also the pain and suffering she went through. / Izuzetni život Elizabete od Bavarske, poznatije kao Sisi, prikazuje priču izvanredne žene koja je postala prva evropska superzvijezda. Serija prati njene tinejdžerske dane, ljubavnu priču s carem Franjom Josipom I, te životne uspone i padove, otkrivajući i njene najveće radosti, ali i bol i patnju kroz koje je prolazila.

programme.title: Bosko Buha / Boško Buha
programme.desc: Yugoslav film about Boško Buha, a boy from Virovitica who grew up overnight due to the horrors of war. At the age of 15, Boško joined the partisans in battle and became known for his courage. / Jugoslavenski film o Bošku Buhi, dječaku iz Virovitice koji je zbog ratnih strahota preko noći odrastao. Sa 15 godina Boško se pridružuje partizanima u borbi i postaje poznat po svojoj odvažnosti.

programme.title: BHT 1 live / BHT 1 uživo
programme.desc: The motto of the BHT 1 live show is "News plus". In the show, information, analysis, predictions and the background of the event. Experts, analysts and citizens speak live for BHT 1. Comments on what is being talked about on social networks, and analysis of the topic of the day. Part of the content of the show are reports about lesser-known places, but also stories about beautiful and unusual regions of our country, and valuable and interesting people. / Moto emisije BHT 1 uživo je "Vijest plus". U emisiji informacije, analize, predviđanja i pozadina događaja. Za BHT 1 uživo govore stručnjaci, analitičari i građani. Komentari o čemu se priča na društvenim mrežama, i analiza teme dana. Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Morning for everyone / Jutro za sve
programme.desc: "Jutro za sve" is a show of the BHT1 morning program that guides viewers through the most current and interesting topics of the day, with plenty of useful information, local, regional and world news from all areas, live reporters from all parts of BiH, publishing stories about BiH citizens, tourism, culture, sports and music. / "Jutro za sve" emisija je jutarnjeg programa BHT1 koja gledatelje voditi kroz najaktuelnije i najinteresantnije teme dana, uz obilje korisnih informacija, lokalnih, regionalnih i svjetskih vijesti iz svih oblasti, javljanja reportera uživo iz svih dijelova BiH, objavljujući priče o građanima BiH, turizmu, kulturi, sportu i muzici.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V / Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the daring boy Yuya Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's big dream is to follow in his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he unexpectedly discovers a new technique for summoning monsters, that dream slowly begins to become his reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: Mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are apparently an ordinary family.. they look like hippos and live in the Valley of the Mummies. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both at home and on trips and excursions, where they meet various interesting beings and persons. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Eli Shane's life is ordinary, except for one thing. He comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the underworld of Slugterra to protect the special world of slugs. Now it's Eli's turn to visit the underworld and protect it from the enemy, whether he's ready or not. Eli is determined to become a hero in order to resist the forces of evil. Together with his friends Trixie, Korda and Pronto, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, which have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: The entrepreneurs of Carrara left Alberto's election rally, after learning of the fraud of Leopoldo Corradi, who used the miners' strike to seize the freight railway for the transportation of marble. Corrado and Alberto didn't know what their father was up to, so now they feel the consequences of his malfeasance. Brando and Lucrezia accompanied Giosue to his final resting place, and the pain of losing their friend brought them even closer. Maddalena is finally released from prison, but Augusta Maffei does not forgive. She has decided to take control of her life, so she proposes to Rosetta to become her partner. Thanks to her experience and skills, "Fairy Garden" is a great success, and among the clients is Nana, an eccentric artist who immediately attracts the interest of Maffeica. Silvia tries not to think about Brando, so she involves Carlotta in a very ambitious project that could improve the lives of the quarry workers. The management of Sveta Kruna Hospital does not approve the cost for the education of Professor Forlanini, which was proposed by Dr. Lucchesi, and Leopoldo is the most opposed. / Poduzetnici Carrare napustili su Albertov izborni skup, nakon što su saznali za prijevaru Leopolda Corradija koji je iskoristio štrajk kopača kako bi se dograbio teretne željeznice za prijevoz mramora. Corrado i Alberto nisu znali što otac sprema, pa sad osjećaju posljedice njegovih malverzacija. Brando i Lucrezia su otpratili na posljednji počinak Giosuea, a bol zbog gubitka prijatelja dodatno ih je zbližila. Maddalenu napokon puštaju iz zatvora, ali Augusta Maffei ne oprašta. Odlučila je preuzeti kontrolu nad svojim životom pa predlaže Rosetti da joj postane partnerica. Zahvaljujući njezinom iskustvu i vještinama, "Vrt vila" doživi veliki uspjeh, a među klijentima je i Nana, ekscentrična umjetnica koja smjesta privuče zanimanje Maffeice. Silvia nastoji ne misliti o Brandu, pa uključi Carlottu u vrlo ambiciozan projekt koji bi mogao poboljšati život radnicima kamenoloma. Vodstvo bolnice Sveta Kruna ne odobri trošak za edukaciju profesora Forlaninija, koju je predložio Dr. Lucchesi, a najviše se protivi Leopoldo.

programme.title: Diary 1 / Dnevnik 1

programme.title: Weather and road conditions / Vrijeme i stanje na putevima
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast for Bosnia and Herzegovina and the region, with information on road conditions. / Najnovija vremenska prognoza za Bosnu i Hercegovinu i regiju, uz informacije o stanju na putevima.

programme.title: Heritage treasure / Blago naslijeđa
programme.desc: TV series about cultural and historical treasures, as well as about traditional values ​​of Bosnia and Herzegovina. A story about life in these areas... creation, beauty, history, culture, and construction. What does heritage treasure actually mean, how much attention do we pay to it, how much do we know about it? / TV serijal o kulturnom i historijskom blagu, kao i o tradicionalnim vrijednostima područja Bosne i Hercegovine. Priča o životu na ovim prostorima... stvaranju, ljepoti, historiji, kulturi, i graditeljstvu. Što blago naslijeđa zapravo znači, koliko mu pažnje posvećujemo, koliko znamo o njemu?

programme.title: Ways of health / Putevi zdravlja
programme.desc: The show deals with prevention, modern diagnostics, new and proven methods. The best doctors from BiH and the Region teach us how to recognize, prevent and treat disease, in a language understandable to the viewer. Complementary medicine and centuries-old practices enable us to learn and grow together. We protect the trust of viewers gained over the years by providing responsible information. / Emisija se bavi prevencijom, suvremenom dijagnostikom, novim i provjerenim metodama. Najbolji liječnici iz BiH i Regije uče nas kako prepoznati, prevenirati i liječiti bolest, jezikom razumljivim gledatelju. Komplementarna medicina i stoljetne prakse omogućavaju da učimo i rastemo skupa. Čuvamo povjerenje gledatelja stečeno kroz godine odgovornim informiranjem.

programme.title: Consumer direction / Potrošački smjer
programme.desc: The show covers the issue of consumer rights and protection in Bosnia and Herzegovina through comprehensive information to the public. In cooperation with associations for consumer protection, inspection services, state institutions and the Product Quality Testing Agency, through an analysis of the situation in this area and with adequate interlocutors, it provides answers to consumer questions. / Emisija obuhvata problematiku prava i zaštite potrošača u BiH kroz sveobuhvatno informiranje javnosti. U suradnji sa udruženjima za zaštitu potrošača, inspekcijskim službama, državnim institucijama i Agencijom za ispitivanje kvalitete proizvoda, kroz analizu stanja u ovoj oblasti i uz adekvatne sagovornike, daje odgovore na pitanja potrošača.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: 80 years of BHRT / 80 godina BHRT-a
programme.desc: Watch the show created to mark the 80th anniversary of Radio Television of Bosnia and Herzegovina. In this show, you will find out all the information about the origin of BHRT, its work and the challenges it faces every day. / Pogledajte emisiju koja je nastala u svrhu obilježavanja 80. obljetnice Radio Televizije Bosne i Hercegovine. U ovoj ćete emisiji saznati sve informacije o nastanku BHRT-a, njegovom radu i izazovima sa kojima se svakodnevno suočava.

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: Daniele and Giulia invite Elena to dinner with old friends, and they have a lot of questions about her work, which angers Elena. Elena and Daniele find Gilbert's friend Karim, and then they arrest Franco, he is a suspect and has a record. Daniele believes he is the culprit and tries to force him to confess. Elena learns that Gilberto met his girlfriend before his death. Daniele insists on closing the case, and Elena decides to return to Rome to the CNCPO (National Center to Combat Online Child Pornography) and hand the badge over to her superior, Serena Missouri, who criticizes her for wanting to continue the investigation. Meanwhile, in Venice, another boy falls into the trap of a pedophile. Cast: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Director: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli / Daniele i Giulia pozivaju Elenu na večeru sa starim prijateljima, a oni imaju mnogo pitanja o njenom poslu, što ljuti Elenu. Elena i Daniele pronalaze Gilbertovog prijatelja Karima, a potom uhapse Franca, osumnjičen je i ima dosije. Daniele vjeruje da je on krivac i pokušava ga prisiliti da prizna. Elena saznaje da je Gilberto upoznao svoju djevojku prije smrti. Daniele insistira na zatvaranju slučaja, a Elena odlučuje da se vrati u Rim u CNCPO (Nacionalni centar za borbu protiv online dječje pornografije) i predaje značku svojoj nadređenoj, Sereni Misuri, koja je kritikuje što želi da nastavi istragu. U međuvremenu, u Veneciji, još jedan dječak upada u zamku pedofila. Uloge: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Režija: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli

programme.desc: The studio show "Finally Friday" brings interesting conversations with regional stars about their career, private life and future projects. / Studijska emisija "Konačno petak" donosi zanimljive razgovore sa regionalnim zvijezdama o njihovoj karijeri, privatnom životu i budućim projektima.

programme.title: No comment / Bez komentara
programme.desc: News from the world, interesting facts and other content without additional comments. / Vijesti iz svijeta, zanimljivosti i ostali sadržaj bez dodatnih komentara.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: My country / Moja zemlja
programme.desc: A show dedicated to Bosnia and Herzegovina and us in it, people, lives, destinies, what people live, what they would like to fix, show or preserve for some new generations. The earth is not (only) space, it is not only mountains, rivers, valleys, the earth is, above all, people. The country is not made up of flags, political pamphlets, the country is made up of ordinary people with everyday lives, joys and sorrows... About such and such a country is the new series of the BHT1 informative program, "My Country", edited and driven by Elvir Bucalo, driving his oldtimer around the wonderful Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Emisija posvećena Bosni i Hercegovini i nama u njoj, ljudima, životima, sudbinama, onome što ljudi žive, što bi htjeli popraviti, ukazati ili sačuvati za neke nove generacije. Zemlja nije (samo) prostor, nisu samo planine, rijeke, doline, zemlja su, prije svega, ljudi. Zemlju ne čine zastave, politički pamfleti, zemlju čine obični ljudi sa svakodnevnim životima, radostima i tugama... O toj i takvoj zemlji govori novi serijal Informativnog programa BHT1, "Moja zemlja", koji uređuje i, vozeći svoj oldtimer obilazi s kraja na kraj čudesne Bosne i Hercegovine, vodi Elvir Bucalo.

programme.title: American Railroad Travel / Putovanja američkom željeznicom
programme.desc: In this episode, Michael Portillo continues his exploration of the city of Chicago. He visited the largest railway junction in the country, learned how to bake brownies according to Bertha Palmer's recipe. After that, he moves south to the state of Illinois, where he attends the University of Illinois. It reveals how Frank Lloyd Wright influenced American architecture. / U ovoj epizodi Michael Portillo nastavlja sa istraživanjem grada Chicaga. Posjetio je najveće željezničko čvorište u zemlji, naučio je kako ispeći kolač brownie po receptu Berthe Palmer. Nakon toga kreće južnije državom Illinois, gdje posjećuje Univerzitet u Illinoisu. Otkriva kako je Frank Lloyd Wright utjecao na američku arhitekturu.

programme.title: Corner - Music club BHRT / Corner - Muzički klub BHRT
programme.desc: Corner - Music Club is a show in which guests sing accompanied by the band Muzičke produkcije, conceived as a series, lasting 25 minutes of fun music, with performances by some of the most famous performers, bands and DJs of the Bosnian scene. / Corner – Muzički klub je emisija u kojoj gosti pjevaju u pratnji benda Muzičke produkcije, koncipirana kao serijal, u trajanju 25 minuta zabavne muzike, sa nastupima nekih od najpoznatijih izvođača, bendova i DJ-eva bosanskohercegovačke scene.

programme.title: Euromaxx / Euromaxx
programme.desc: This lifestyle show presents Europe at its best, from cultural news to entertainment events, beautiful views of natural landscapes and the most fascinating works of modern art. / Ova lifestyle emisija predstavlja Evropu u najboljem izdanju, od vijesti iz kulture do zabavnih događaja, prekrasnih pogleda na prirodne krajolike i najfascinantnijih umjetničkih djela moderne umjetnosti.

programme.title: A game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: Aziz tells Nehir that he will send her an invitation for his wedding. She works hard for Ferida's fashion show, but Aziz suspects that some dangerous plan of Nehira is behind it. Firat is very angry and wants to take revenge on Kerem at any cost. Feride announces her show on the podium and thanks boss Aziz for his support. Serpil foils the plan of Nehira's assistant. Perihan sends a poisoned drink to the waiter for Feride to drink, but she only drinks half a glass, and Aziz finishes the rest. Feride and Aziz fall unconscious, and Faik suffers a stroke. Firat shoots Kerem. Cast: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Director: Murat Onbul / Aziz govori Nehir da će joj poslati pozivnicu za njegovo vjenčanje. Ona se trudi oko Feridine revije, ali Aziz sluti da iza toga stoji neki opasan Nehirin plan. Firat je veoma ljut i želi se po svaku cijenu osvetiti Keremu. Feride na podijumu najavljuje svoju reviju i zahvaljuje se šefu Azizu na podršci. Serpil osujeti plan Nehirine asistentice. Perihan po konobaru šalje piće sa otrovom koje treba da popije Feride, ali ona popije samo pola čaše, a ostalo dovrši Aziz. Feride i Aziz padaju u nesvijest, a Faik doživljava moždani udar. Firat puca u Kerema. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Barimba / Barimba
programme.desc: Barimba visits Ida and Kiki every night. Telling them various stories, this experienced sailor will teach them many things. / Barimba svaku noć posjećuje Idu i Kikija. Pričajući im razne priče, ovaj iskusni moreplovac, naučiće ih mnogo čemu.

programme.title: My pet / Moj ljubimac
programme.desc: In the magical world that surrounds us, travel with us to the very heart of nature, where our furry friends dance in the meadows, and the petals smell like old fairy tales. In this show, we discover the mysterious language of plants, the embrace of pets, and the whisper of the wind among the branches. Join us in this magic of nature.. / U čarobnom svijetu koji nas okružuje putujte sa nama u samo srce prirode, tamo gdje naši krzneni drugari plešu po livadama, a latice mirišu poput davnih priča iz bajki. U ovoj emisiji otkrivamo tajanstveni jezik biljaka, zagrljaj ljubimaca, i šapat vjetra među granama. Pridružite nam se u ovoj čaroliji prirode..

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: The speech of silence / Govor tišine
programme.desc: The speech of silence, a show for people with impaired hearing and speech. / Govor tišine, emisija za osobe sa oštećenim sluhom i govorom.

programme.title: Shift / Shift
programme.desc: An educational show that deals with the impact of the Internet, digital devices and modern technology on people and their lives. Each edition of the show focuses on a specific topic, which it covers thoroughly. The goal is to educate users about digital platforms and social networks and conscientious consumption of content on the Internet. / Edukativna emisija koja se bavi uticajem interneta, digitalnih uređaja i moderne tehnologije na ljude i njihove živote. Svako izdanje emisije u fokus stavlja određenu temu koju temeljito obrađuje. Cilj je obrazovati korisnike o digitalnim platformama i društvenim mrežama te savjesnom konzumiranju sadržaja na internetu.

programme.title: TV Liberty / TV Liberty
programme.desc: An informative show that brings everything about current events in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The magazine is realized in cooperation with the Sarajevo correspondent of Radio Free Europe. / Informativna emisija koja donosi sve o aktuelnim dešavanjima u Bosni i Hercegovini. Magazin se realizuje u saradnji sa sarajevskim dopisništvom Radija Slobodna Evropa.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Finally ask May / Konačno petak sa Majom
programme.desc: The studio show "Finally Friday" brings interesting conversations with regional stars about their career, private life and future projects. / Studijska emisija "Konačno petak" donosi zanimljive razgovore sa regionalnim zvijezdama o njihovoj karijeri, privatnom životu i budućim projektima.

programme.title: BH gastro corner / BH gastro kutak
programme.desc: With the culinary show "BH Gastro Kutak", get inspired by traditional dishes and tastes that will make your teeth grow. / Uz kulinarsku emisiju "BH gastro kutak" inspirišite se tradicionalnim jelima i okusima od kojih rastu zazubice.

programme.title: A look into the future / Pogled u budućnost
programme.desc: An international TV show that brings us interesting reports and documentaries on various topics. / Međunarodna TV emisija koja nam donosi zanimljive reportaže i dokumentarne filmove o različitim temama.

programme.title: Consumer direction / Potrošački smjer
programme.desc: The show covers the issue of consumer rights and protection in Bosnia and Herzegovina through comprehensive information to the public. In cooperation with associations for consumer protection, inspection services, state institutions and the Product Quality Testing Agency, through an analysis of the situation in this area and with adequate interlocutors, it provides answers to consumer questions. / Emisija obuhvata problematiku prava i zaštite potrošača u BiH kroz sveobuhvatno informiranje javnosti. U suradnji sa udruženjima za zaštitu potrošača, inspekcijskim službama, državnim institucijama i Agencijom za ispitivanje kvalitete proizvoda, kroz analizu stanja u ovoj oblasti i uz adekvatne sagovornike, daje odgovore na pitanja potrošača.

programme.title: Memoirs of an invisible man / Memoari nevidljivog čovjeka
programme.desc: Nick Halloway comes to class hungover. But instead, he decides to look for a place where he can rest for a while and cure his hangover. Meanwhile, in one of the labs, a molecular experiment gets out of control, causing most of the building to soon become invisible, and Nick with it. When he finally wakes up, he seems to be hallucinating... parts of the building seem to be missing, and he doesn't see his reflection in the mirror. Immediately afterwards, he realizes that, as a completely invisible person, he has become the target of the secret police who want to use him for espionage purposes. Then he starts running away and hiding from the police, and looking for a way to return to normal as soon as possible. Realizing that being invisible is much more difficult than he thought, Nick turns to Alice, a cute girl he recently met, for help. Cast: Chevy Chase, Daryl Hannah, Sam Neill, Michael McKean Director: John Carpenter / Nick Halloway dolazi mamuran na predavanje. No, umjesto toga, odluči potražiti mjesto gdje će se nakratko odmoriti i izliječiti mamurluk. Za to vrijeme, u jednoj laboratoriji, molekularni eksperiment se oteo kontroli, zbog čega veći dio zgrade uskoro postane nevidljiv, a sa njom i Nik. Kada se napokon probudi, čini mu se da halucinira... dijelovi zgrade kao da nedostaju, a on ne vidi svoj odraz u ogledalu. Odmah potom shvata i da je, kao potpuno nevidljiva osoba, postao meta tajne policije koja ga želi iskoristiti u svrhu špijunaže. Tada krene bježati i skrivati se od policije, te tražiti način da se što prije vrati u normalno stanje. Shvativši da je biti nevidljiv znatno teže nego što je mislio, Nick se za pomoć obrati Alice, simpatičnoj djevojci koju je nedavno upoznao. Uloge: Chevy Chase, Daryl Hannah, Sam Neill, Michael McKean Režija: John Carpenter

programme.title: Bridges of diversity / Mostovi različitosti
programme.desc: About the position and everyday life of national minorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina, with special reference to the preservation of cultural identity, language, issues of discrimination and existing stereotypes. About successful integrations and positive practices, but also about social and political exclusion, legal solutions and their application. Through personal stories of members of different national minorities, in different parts of BiH, conversations with activists, government representatives and citizens, the film reveals the complexity of identity and the treasures that BiH has, thanks to their decision to live and work in BiH, but also detects the necessary changes. What challenges do they face, starting from education to employment, double standards, preservation of language and culture. About examples of good practice in the region and Western Europe The film was shot with the support of the European Union, the Goethe Institute in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the DW Academy. / O položaju i svakodnevnom životu nacionalnih manjina u BiH, sa posebnim osvrtom na očuvanje kulturnog identiteta, jezika, pitanja diskriminacije i prisutnih stereotipa. O uspješnim integracijama i pozitivnim praksama, ali i o društvenoj i političkoj isključenosti, zakonskim rješenjima i njihovoj primjeni. Kroz lične priče pripadnika različitih nacionalnih manjina, u različitim dijelovima BiH, razgovore sa aktivistima, predstavnicima vlasti i građanima, film otkriva kompleksnost identiteta i blago koje BiH ima, zahvaljujući njihovoj odluci da žive i rade u BiH, ali i detektuje potrebne promjene. Sa kojim izazovima se susreću, počevši od obrazovanja do zapošljavanja, dvostrukih standarda, očuvanja jezika i kulture. O primjerima dobre prakse u regionu i zapadnoj Evropi Film je snimljen uz podršku Evropske unije, Goethe instituta u Bosni i Hercegovini i DW akademije.

programme.desc: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2

programme.title: BHT sport / BHT sport
programme.desc: Overview of current sports news from Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. / Pregled aktuelnih sportskih vijesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, regiona i svijeta.

programme.title: Weather forecast and road conditions / Vremenska prognoza i stanje na putevima
programme.desc: The latest weather forecast for Bosnia and Herzegovina and the region, with information on road conditions. / Najnovija vremenska prognoza za Bosnu i Hercegovinu i regiju, uz informacije o stanju na putevima.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for European Championship (Women) / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž)
programme.desc: After a difficult away game in Switzerland, the women's handball team of Bosnia and Herzegovina continues its qualification for the European Championship with a match against the Netherlands. Our girls will meet one of the best representatives of the Old Continent in Cazin, where, with full stands, they will try to cause a surprise in the match against a renowned rival. / Poslije teskog gostovanja u Svicarskoj, zenska rukometna reprezentacija BiH nastavlja kvalifikacije za plasman na Evropsko prvenstvo utakmicom protiv Nizozemske. Jednu od najboljih reprezentacija Starog kontineta nase djevojke ce docekati u Cazinu gdje ce, uz pune tribune, pokusati stici do iznenadjenja u mecu protiv renomiranog rivala.

programme.title: Art Depo / Art Depo
programme.desc: In the Art Depo show, promotions, performances, premieres, new projects and artists, topics, interviews, current events from the cultural scene, their background and the work of the protagonists. The magazine is dedicated, among other things, to contemporary art. Most of the content consists of reports and reportages that talk about cultural events, presentations of projects and artists. Reports, portraits, contributions that problematize a certain topic or phenomenon, and interviews. / U emisiji Art Depo promocije, predstave, premijere, novi projekti i umjetnici, teme, intervjui, aktuelni događaji sa kulturne scene, njihova pozadina i rad protagonista. Magazin je posvećen, između ostalog, savremenoj umjetnosti. Najveći dio sadržaja čine izvještaji i reportaže koje govore o kulturnim događanjima, predstavljanju projekata i umjetnika. Reportaže, portreti, prilozi koji problematiziraju određenu temu ili pojavu, i intervjui.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: The power of one / Snaga jednog
programme.desc: World War II... As a seven-year-old, Peekay lives on a family farm in South Africa, and is cared for by a Zulu nanny. After the death of his mother, Peekay goes to college. He almost died there during a gathering of students who were supporters of Nazi Germany. He starts living with his grandfather, and after his death, he grows up with his grandfather's friend Doc, a German musician, who ends up in prison as an illegal immigrant after the war. While visiting Doc in prison, Peekay meets Geel Piet, who teaches him boxing. / Drugi svjetski rat... Peekay kao sedmogodišnjak živi na porodičnoj farmi u Južnoj Africi, a za njega se brine dadilja porijeklom iz naroda Zulu. Nakon smrti majke, Peekay odlazi na koledž. Tamo gotovo nastrada za vrijeme okupljanja studenata pristaša nacističke Njemačke. Počinje živjeti s djedom, a nakon njegove smrti, odrasta uz djedovog prijatelja Doca, njemačkog muzičara, koji poslije rata završava u zatvoru kao ilegalni migrant. Tokom posjeta Docu u zatvoru, Peekay upoznaje Geela Pieta, koji ga nauči boksu.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga: Round 7: Union Berlin - Borussia Mönchengladbach / Футбол: Бундеслига: 7 кръг: Унион Берлин - Борусия Мьонхенгладбах
programme.desc: First Bundesliga is the highest level of German club football. It was established on August 24, 1963, it is a continuation of the German football championship, which existed since 1903. The founders of the Bundesliga in 1963 were Borussia Dortmund, Eintracht Braunschweig, Eintracht Frankfurt, Hamburger SV, Hertha Berlin, Kaiserslautern, Karlsruhe, Köln, Meydenreicher, 1860 Munich, Nürnberg, Preussen Münster, Saarbrücken, Schalke 04, Stuttgart and Werder. The first champion in 1964 was Cologne. The most successful team in the German First Bundesliga is undoubtedly Bayern Munich, which until 2023 has won 32 titles from 60 editions of the championship. / Първа Бундеслига е най-високото стъпало в германския клубен футбол. Създадена е на 24 август 1963 г.,тя е естевен продължител на Германския футболен шампионат, съществуващ от 1903 г. Основатели на Бундеслигата през 1963-а са Борусия Дортмунд, Айнтрахт Брауншвайг, Айнтрахт Франкфурт, Хамбургер ШФ, Херта Берлин, Кайзерслаутерн, Карлсруе, Кьол, Майденрихер, 1860 Мюнхен, Нюрнберг, Пройсен Мюнстер, Саарбрюкен, Шалке 04, Щутгарт и Вердер. Първият шампион през 1964 г. е Кьолн. Най-успешен отбор в немската Първа Бундеслига безспорно е Байерн Мюнхен, който до 2023 г., е спечели 32 титли от 60 издания на първенството.

programme.desc: The Spanish Basketball League was founded in 1957 as the National League and received its current format in 1983 when the ACB organization took control of the competition. According to the scoring, Liga ACB is one of the three best European leagues. There are currently 18 teams in the league that play each other twice a season. The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, closely followed by Barcelona. The Spanish league has given us some of the world's greatest players and coaches throughout history. / Испанската баскетболна лига е основана през 1957 г. като Национална лига и получава настоящия си формат през 1983 г., когато организацията ACB поема контрола над състезанието. Според точкуването Лига ACB е една от трите най-добри европейски лиги. В момента в лигата участват 18 отбора, които играят помежду си два пъти през сезона. Отборът с най-много спечелени титли е Реал Мадрид, но плътно следван от Барселона. Испанското първенство ни даде някои от най-великите играчи и треньори в света през цялата история.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1: Round 8: Angers - Monaco / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 8 кръг: Анже - Монако
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams competing against each other in 38 rounds, on an alternating away basis. The French championship dates back to 1892, the so-called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 included in its first season, 1932-33, the following teams, divided into two groups: Club Française, Excelsior, Hierre, Lille, Marseille, Mulhouse, Nice, Nîmes, Racing Paris, Sette, Ale, Antibes, Cannes, SA Paris, Fives, Metz, Montpellier, Red Star, Rennes and Sochaux. In recent years, the club Paris Saint-Germain, formed much later, has been an absolute dominator on the domestic scene, but before that Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nantes, Saint-Etienne, Reims, Nice, Lance, etc. also had a lot of success. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E47, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E47, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The dance of fate / Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Alem da Ilusao - (E19, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Onofre tells the village that Olivia likes the priest Tenorio. Isadora sees Olívia kissing Rafael and goes crazy with jealousy. Olívia asks Rafael to pretend to be wooing her to help her get rid of the rumors about Reverend Tenorio. Rafael agrees because he knows it affects Isadora. Leônidas manages to get Matias out of the sanatorium and brings him back to the estate. Violeta is sad about Matias' situation. She is supported by Eugenio who ruins the romantic dinner that Úrsula is preparing for him. Olívia and Onofre have disagreements within the factory. Olívia is changing shifts. Isadora cannot hide Rafael's jealousy. Rafael disguises himself, goes to the club and steals Joaquim's car. Julinha was fired from the LBA. Violeta questions Rafael about their relationship and he confesses to her that he loves Isadora. Rafael pristaje jer zna da to utječe na Isadoru. Leônidas uspije odvesti Matiasa iz sanatorija i vraća ga na imanje. Violeta je tužna zbog Matiasove situacije. Podupire ju Eugenio koji uništi romantičnu večeru koju Úrsula priprema za njega. Olívia i Onofre imaju nesuglasice unutar tvornice. Olívia mijenja smjenu. Isadora ne može sakriti Rafaelovu ljubomoru. Rafael se maskira, ode u klub i ukrade Joaquimov auto. Julinha je otpuštena iz LBA. Violeta ispituje Rafaela o njihovoj vezi i on joj prizna da voli Isadoru. programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E15, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacao, who lives on the estate of her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E15, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural heritage - (doc. series, Croatia, 2013) Parkways are made for walks, and walks are made for conversations, closeness, togetherness in discovering blooming magnolias, leaves carried by the wind, changing seasons, nature that seems to want to escape from the cities, and they, on the contrary, try to keep it, place it among the houses, preserve it somewhere in sight. Therefore, gardens are arranged. There are several of them in the center of Zagreb, so in this walk, which is also suitable for those who are not inclined to long walks, we will visit some that are particularly dear to us and some that we wanted to see again after a long time. Director: Luka Marotti... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) Perivoji su stvoreni za šetnje, a šetnje su stvorene za razgovore, bliskost, zajedništvo u otkrivanju procvjetale magnolije, lista nošena vjetrom, mijene godišnjih doba, prirode koja kao da želi pobjeći iz gradova, a oni je, naprotiv, pokušavaju zadržati, smjestiti među kuće, sačuvati negdje u vidokrugu. Stoga, uređuju se perivoji. U užem središtu Zagreba smjestilo ih se nekoliko pa ćemo i mi, u ovoj šetnji prikladnoj i za one nesklone dugom pješačenju, obići neke koji su nam osobito dragi i neke koje smo nakon mnogo vremena poželjeli ponovno vidjeti. programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) In the show Dr. Beck we are talking about alopecia. This is hair loss, i.e. loss of hair from the head, and in more severe cases, loss of all body hair. The causes of alopecia are various, from endocrine disorders to stress and systemic diseases. In the show, we talk about the causes, symptoms and methods of treatment, as well as why hair loss causes serious stress in many people and how to deal with it. Actor Asim Ugljen will share his experience with alopecia... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) U emisiji Dr. Beck govorimo o alopeciji. To je opadanje kose odnosno gubitak dlaka s glave a u težim slučajevima i gubitak svih tjelesnih dlaka. Uzroci alopecije su razni, od endokrinih poremećaja do stresa i sistemskih bolesti. U emisiji govorimo o uzrocima, simptomima i načinima liječenja te o tome zašto gubitak kose kod mnogih izaziva ozbiljan stres i kako se nositi s njim. Svoje iskustvo s alopecijom podijelit će glumac Asim Ugljen...

Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. R.: Erika Heymann Ul.: Miles Bastianich (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E18, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule.
