programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E19, doc. series, USA, 2024) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. ... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E19, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. ...

programme.title: A normal life / Normalan život
programme.desc: Normal life - (Croatia) After the show dedicated to World Mental Health Day and suicide prevention, especially among adolescents, we continue with the topic "Social work and mental health", which was also the central topic of the 14th conference of social workers, recently held in Vodice. The guests of the show are: Štefica Karačić, B.Sc. soc. worker, president of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and member of the Board of Directors of the Croatian Chamber of Social Workers, Ph.D. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, B.Sc. soc. worker, member of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and the Association's Ethics Committee, advocate and initiator of the Zagreb Strategy for Equalizing Opportunities for People with Disabilities. Guests will speak about prevention and protection of mental health, especially in at-risk and vulnerable groups. As many as 20% of people with disabilities have impaired mental health - guests will testify about invisible barriers, stigmatization and social exclusion of the poor, elderly and infirm and people with intellectual disabilities. They will especially emphasize the role of social support in improving mental health, especially in the process of mourning, and the importance of interdisciplinary cooperation between institutions. In the context of the digital age, we will also discuss the need to reduce administrative barriers, in order to help people in need in a timely and efficient manner... / Normalan život - (Hrvatska) Nakon emisije posvećene Svjetskom danu mentalnog zdravlja i prevenciji suicida, osobito među adolescentima, nastavljamo s temom "Socijalni rad i mentalno zdravlje", koja je ujedno bila središnja tema 14. konferencije socijalnih radnika, nedavno održane u Vodicama. Gošće emisije su: Štefica Karačić, dipl. soc. radnica, predsjednica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i članica Upravnog odbora Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika dr. sc. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, dipl. soc. radnica, članica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i Etičkog povjerenstva Udruge, zagovarateljica i pokretačica Zagrebačke strategije izjednačavanja mogućnosti za osobe s invaliditetom Gošće će govoriti o prevenciji i zaštiti mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u rizičnih i ranjivih skupina. Čak 20 % osoba s invaliditetom ima narušeno mentalno zdravlje - gošće će svjedočiti o nevidljivim barijerama, stigmatizaciji i socijalnoj isključenosti siromašnih, starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s intelektualnim teškoćama.Posebno će istaknuti ulogu socijalne podrške u poboljšanju mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u procesu žalovanja, te značaj interdisciplinarne suradnje među institucijama. U kontekstu digitalnog doba, razgovarat ćemo i o potrebi smanjenja administrativnih barijera, kako bi se pravovremeno i učinkovito pomoglo osobama u potrebi...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E16, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacau, who lives on the estate where her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena, live. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E16, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.title: The way of the rivers / Put rijeka
programme.desc: Path of the Rivers - (E03, nature film, Croatia, 2024) The river Zrmanja is one of the most beautiful, but also one of the wildest rivers in Croatia. In places of its course, it is extremely fast and full of smaller and larger waterfalls. The nature and canyons that surround it leave an impression of its magnificent strength. In addition to the usual tourist attractions, rafting has also been designed, an adrenaline adventure that gives the river additional richness. The abundance of flora and fauna and travertine waterfalls have now given man a new, enriched meaning. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Put rijeka - (E03, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Rijeka Zrmanja je jedna od najljepših, ali i jedna od najdivljijih rijeka u Hrvatskoj. Na mjestima njezina toka izrazito je brza i puna manjih i većih slapova. Priroda i kanjoni koji je okružuju ostavljaju dojam njezine veličanstvene snage. Uz uobičajene turističke atrakcije, osmišljen je i rafting, adrenalinska avantura koja rijeci daje dodatno bogatstvo. Obilje flore i faune i sedreni slapovi sada su čovjeku dali novo, obogaćeno značenje. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia) In the city on four rivers, he found his way of life. Born in Karlovac with Czech roots, Dinko Neskusil observes the world through the lens of a camera. He took his first steps with his father, appearing in Karlovac weeklies, but also on the front line, documenting the devastating attacks on the city. His war photographs make up most of the display of the Museum of the Homeland War in Turnje. "It didn't happen again," says Dinko, who still takes photographs with the same passion today. He knows very well that a picture is worth a thousand words. Sound master: Boris Harmić Lighting master: Darko Višek... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) U gradu na četiri rijeke pronašao je svoj životni tok. Rođeni Karlovčanin čeških korijena, Dinko Neskusil, svijet promatra kroz objektiv fotoaparata. Prve je korake napravio uz oca, stasao u karlovačkim tjednicima, ali i na prvoj liniji fronte, dokumentirajući razorne napade na grad. Njegove ratne fotografije čine većinu postava Muzeja Domovinskog rata na Turnju. "Ne ponovilo se", kaže Dinko, koji i danas fotografira s jednakom strašću. Dobro zna da slika govori više od tisuću riječi. Ton-majstor: Boris Harmić Majstor rasvjete: Darko Višek...

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E05, Education, England, 2022) Ben travels to the Shetland Islands, one of the most isolated spots in Britain. He will visit Helen and Jason, a couple who have been living on the island of Yell for several years. They will discover why they gave up life in the city and see what obstacles they face as they realize their dream of living on this beautiful island far from civilization. Ben's hosts devote a lot of time to the physically demanding renovation of the house, and at the same time cultivate 10 hectares of land. They admit that sometimes they have too much work. Ben will shear sheep, lay water pipes, weave woolen rugs and extract peat with them. Director: Sean McDonnell... / Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E05, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Ben putuje na Shetlandsko otočje, jednu od najizoliranijih točaka Britanije. Posjetit će Helen i Jasona, par koji već nekoliko godina živi na otoku Yellu. Otkrit će zašto su odustali od života u gradu i vidjeti s kakvim se preprekama suočavaju dok ostvaruju san o životu na ovom lijepom otoku daleko od civilizacije. Benovi domaćini mnogo vremena posvećuju fizički zahtjevnoj obnovi kuće, a usto obrađuju i 10 hektara zemlje. Priznaju da katkad imaju previše posla. Ben će s njima šišati ovce, polagati vodovodne cijevi, tkati vunene sagove i vaditi treset. R.: Sean McDonnell...

programme.desc: Potjera - (quiz show, Croatia) In Potjera, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz - it's also a race where the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is?... / Potjera - (kviz show, Hrvatska) U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz - ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?...

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend / Geronimo: Američka legenda
programme.desc: Geronimo: An American Legend - (western, USA, 1993) Western about the Indian Geronimo who, at the head of his Apache tribe, opposed the American army. At the end of the 19th century, the Apaches are still the only free-roaming Indian tribe, but the US government wants to move them to a reservation. The legendary warrior Geronimo (W. Studi) refused to submit when they tried to arrest him. For the next five years, the American army tried to capture a man who wanted to preserve the freedom of his people at all costs... Director: Walter Hill Street: Jason Patric (Charles B. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz - it's also a race where the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is?... / Potjera - (kviz show, Hrvatska) U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Lorenzo meets Silvana, who charms him. Fátima wants to help keep the farce of Olivia's relationship going, so she suggests the couple make feijoada for the whole village. Olivia can't stand Isadora grieving over Rafael and tells her the truth about the farce. Eugenio holds an emergency meeting to discuss the loss of an important client. Rafael proposes a competition to save the factory. This infuriates Joaquim. Isadora admits to Violeta that she is afraid of her love for Rafael. Isadora decides to participate in competitions at Rafael's request. Joaquim apologizes to Isadora and offers to present the prize to the winner. Director: Luiz Henrique Rios Street: Antonio Calloni (Matias Tapajos), Paloma Duarte (Heloísa Camargo), Malu Galli (Violeta Camargo Tapajos), Larissa Manoela (Isadora Camargo Tapajos / Elisa Camargo Tapajos), Danilo Mesquita (Joaquim)... / Alem da Ilusao - (E20, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Joaquim tvrdi da je Rafaelova i Olívijna veza lažna. Fátima želi pomoći da se održi farsa o Olivijinoj vezi, pa predlaže paru da naprave feijoadu za cijelo selo. Olivia ne može podnijeti da Isadora tuguje zbog Rafaela i kaže joj istinu o farsi. Eugenio održi hitan sastanak kako bi razgovarali o gubitku važnog klijenta. Rafael predlaže natjecanje kojim bi spasili tvornicu. Joaquima to razbjesni. Isadora priznaje Violeti da se boji svoje ljubavi prema Rafaelu. Isadora odluči sudjelovati u natjecaje na Rafaelov zahtjev. Joaquim se ispriča Isadori i ponudi se da pobjednici uruči nagradu. programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E16, drama series, Portugal, 2024) The telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacau, who lives on the estate where her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena, live. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E16, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. programme.title: A normal life / Normalan život
programme.desc: Normal life - (Croatia) After the show dedicated to World Mental Health Day and suicide prevention, especially among adolescents, we continue with the topic "Social work and mental health", which was also the central topic of the 14th conference of social workers, recently held in Vodice. The guests of the show are: Štefica Karačić, B.Sc. soc. worker, president of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and member of the Board of Directors of the Croatian Chamber of Social Workers, Ph.D. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, B.Sc. soc. worker, member of the Croatian Association of Social Workers and the Association's Ethics Committee, advocate and initiator of the Zagreb Strategy for Equalizing Opportunities for People with Disabilities. Guests will speak about prevention and protection of mental health, especially in at-risk and vulnerable groups. As many as 20% of people with disabilities have impaired mental health - guests will testify about invisible barriers, stigmatization and social exclusion of the poor, elderly and infirm and people with intellectual disabilities. They will especially emphasize the role of social support in improving mental health, especially in the process of mourning, and the importance of interdisciplinary cooperation between institutions. In the context of the digital age, we will also discuss the need to reduce administrative barriers, in order to help people in need in a timely and efficient manner... / Normalan život - (Hrvatska) Nakon emisije posvećene Svjetskom danu mentalnog zdravlja i prevenciji suicida, osobito među adolescentima, nastavljamo s temom "Socijalni rad i mentalno zdravlje", koja je ujedno bila središnja tema 14. konferencije socijalnih radnika, nedavno održane u Vodicama. Gošće emisije su: Štefica Karačić, dipl. soc. radnica, predsjednica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i članica Upravnog odbora Hrvatske komore socijalnih radnika dr. sc. Marinka Bakula-Anđelić, dipl. soc. radnica, članica Hrvatske udruge socijalnih radnika i Etičkog povjerenstva Udruge, zagovarateljica i pokretačica Zagrebačke strategije izjednačavanja mogućnosti za osobe s invaliditetom Gošće će govoriti o prevenciji i zaštiti mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u rizičnih i ranjivih skupina. Čak 20 % osoba s invaliditetom ima narušeno mentalno zdravlje - gošće će svjedočiti o nevidljivim barijerama, stigmatizaciji i socijalnoj isključenosti siromašnih, starijih i nemoćnih osoba te osoba s intelektualnim teškoćama.Posebno će istaknuti ulogu socijalne podrške u poboljšanju mentalnog zdravlja, osobito u procesu žalovanja, te značaj interdisciplinarne suradnje među institucijama. U kontekstu digitalnog doba, razgovarat ćemo i o potrebi smanjenja administrativnih barijera, kako bi se pravovremeno i učinkovito pomoglo osobama u potrebi...

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E19, doc. series, USA, 2024) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. ... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E19, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. ...

It is interesting that the same actors have starred in the series since the very beginning, so this is proof of how close it is to them, as well as to viewers around the world. The theme that runs through this season is the acceptance of the unexpected, new experiences and knowledge, moving along unknown paths. The Bartlett Fleming family will find themselves facing new challenges, ready for new adventures and relationships. But no matter how many surprises life brings, Amy, Lou, Jack and Tim, the four most important and steadfast characters, remain loyal to Heartland, which has been owned by them for generations. R.: Kristin Lehman Ul.: Amber Marshall (Amy Fleming), Michelle Morgan (Samantha Louise Lou Fleming), Shaun Johnston (Jack Bartlett), River Codack (Teenage Nathan Pryce), Spencer Lord (Nathan Pryce Jr.)... / Heartland - (S17, E07, dramska serija, Kanada, 2025) Najdugovječnija kanadska serija Heartland nastavlja se 17. sezonom, koja se odvija na legendarnom imanju Heartland i u izmišljenom gradiću Hudsonu u podnožju prekrasnog Stjenjaka. Zanimljivo je da u seriji glume isti glumci od samoga početka, pa je i to dokaz koliko im je ona, kao i gledateljima diljem svijeta, prirasla k srcu. Tema koja se provlači kroz ovu sezonu je prihvaćanje neočekivanog, nova iskustva i spoznaje, kretanje nepoznatim stazama. Obitelj Bartlett Fleming naći će se pred novim izazovima, spremni na nove pustolovine i veze. Ali ma koliko život donosi iznenađenja, Amy, Lou, Jack i Tim, četvero najvažnijih i najpostojanijih likova, ostaju vjerni Heartlandu, koji je naraštajima u njihovu vlasništvu. programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: The Forgotten Battle of Nuštar 91 - (E01, doc. film, Croatia, 2018) In the fall of 1991, Croatia is fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić Director: Darko Bušnja... / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91. - (E01, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2018) U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić R.: Darko Bušnja...

programme.title: Dogs on a mission / Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: Dogs on assignment - (E01, nature film, Croatia, 2023) This documentary series reveals another side of our favorite four-legged friends. Through four exciting episodes, we dive deeper into the world of working dogs, exploring their jobs, but also their leisure time. By following their daily lives, we discover not only how they contribute to our society, but also listen to their thoughts about it through imaginative interpretations. ------ In the first episode, we will dive deeper into the world of Istrian truffles, but literally! Following Bubica, a curly-haired lagotti from Paladin, and her owner Ivana, we will find out the role of sniffing friends in finding this valuable food and what is hidden in the depths of the Istrian forests. Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of gourmet delights and incredible adventures with our four-legged truffle. R.: Petar Vukičević... / Psi na zadatku - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Ova dokumentarna serija otkriva nam drugu stranu naših omiljenih četveronožnih prijatelja. Kroz četiri uzbudljive epizode zaranjamo dublje u svijet radnih pasa, istražujući njihove poslove, ali i dokolicu. Prateći njihov svakodnevni život, otkrivamo ne samo kako oni doprinose našem društvu, već i kroz maštovite interpretacije slušamo njihova razmišljanja o tome. ------ U prvoj epizodi zaronit ćemo dublje u svijet istarskih tartufa, ali doslovno! Prateći Bubicu, kovrčavu lagotticu iz Paladina, i njezinu vlasnicu Ivanu, doznat ćemo koja je uloga njuškajućih prijatelja u pronalasku ove vrijedne namirnice i što se to krije u dubinama istarskih šuma. Pripremite se za uzbudljivo putovanje kroz svijet gurmanskih užitaka i nevjerojatnih pustolovina s našom četveronožnom tartufarkom. R.: Petar Vukičević...

programme.title: And she was / I bila je
programme.desc: Write and Wrong - (comedy, USA, 2007) Byrdie is a prolific screenwriter in her fifties. The problem is that none of the producers want to work with her. Even though she's just completed what is probably the best screenplay of her life, her agent isn't returning her calls, and none of the filmmakers want to read it. So he comes up with a plan to get revenge on them. Looking to revive her career, Byrdie enlists the help of her charming and attractive twentysomething nephew, a former used car salesman, Neil. Just like Cyrano de Bergerac, Byrdie writes screenplays and Neil pitches them to studios as his own. Thanks to Byrdie's giftedness and Neil's youthful charm, the duo achieve great success. Neil soon becomes one of the most sought after Hollywood screenwriters. While visiting the studios, he meets Andrea, the head of acquisitions and the only devotee of Byrdie's work, and falls in love with her. Byrdie and Neil feel guilty about lying to Andrea, but they're in too deep to back out now. Things get even more complicated when Byrdie's family, unaware of their prank, deduces that Byrdie has a drinking problem and organizes an intervention. Despite her fierce opposition, Byrdie is sent to rehab and unable to deliver the script to Neil. Neil tries to write on his own, but soon realizes that writing a screenplay is much more difficult than going to meetings. Does the 50-year-old have a chance to succeed in the ruthless world of Hollywood? And will the truth destroy her nephew's relationship? Director: Graeme Clifford Street: Kirstie Alley (Byrdie Langdon), Eric Christian Olsen (Jason Langdon), Stacy Grant (Andrea Davis), Peter Cockett (Ray McDeere), Britt Irvin (Stacy Herskowitz)... / Write and Wrong - (komedija, SAD, 2007) Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka? R.: Graeme Clifford Ul.: Kirstie Alley (Byrdie Langdon), Eric Christian Olsen (Jason Langdon), Stacy Grant (Andrea Davis), Peter Cockett (Ray McDeere), Britt Irvin (Stacy Herskowitz)...

programme.title: Call the midwife / Zovite babicu
programme.desc: Call the Midwife - (S01, E03, drama series, England, 2012) This time Jenny does not face the beginning, but the end of life. Frank, the brother of the cleaner Peggy of Nonnatus House, has cancer, and the sisters take care of him. Jenny thus gets to know better their difficult past and the relationship that was shaped by the childhood spent in the poorhouse. At the same time, the other residents of the house help Fred in his (somewhat unusual) business idea - breeding Evie the piglet. But the bacon-earning plan changes when Evie is left unborn. With that, the police find Sister Monica Joan wandering around the docks and bring her back to Nonnatus House. After recovering from pneumonia, she returns to her duties - until she is accused of theft... R.: Philippa Lowthorpe St.: Jessica Raine (Jenny Lee), Jenny Agutter (Sister Julienne), Pam Ferris (Sister Evangelina), Helen George (Trixie Franklin), Laura Main (Sister Bernadette)... / Call the Midwife - (S01, E03, dramska serija, Engleska, 2012) Jenny se ovoga puta ne susreće s početkom, već s krajem života. Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji - uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama - sve dok je ne optuže za krađu... R.: Philippa Lowthorpe Ul.: Jessica Raine (Jenny Lee), Jenny Agutter (Sister Julienne), Pam Ferris (Sister Evangelina), Helen George (Trixie Franklin), Laura Main (Sister Bernadette)...

programme.desc: Jersey Girl - (romantic comedy, USA, 2004) Ollie Trinkie (B. Affleck) is a successful music producer who married the love of his life. However, his wife suddenly dies in childbirth. A terrible tragedy, a terrible shock and the beginning of a completely new lifestyle, with new problems that this New York businessman did not count on. Alone with a newborn baby girl, he decides to return to his native New Jersey, to the house where his father lives. Ollie has resigned himself to the fact that he will never again meet a person with whom he can have a romantic relationship. But that doesn't mean there aren't hot girls in the neighborhood... Director: Kevin Smith Street: Ben Affleck (Ollie Trinke), Liv Tyler (Maya), Raquel Castro (Gertie Trinke), George Carlin (Bart Trinke), Jennifer Lopez (Gertrude Steiney)... / Jersey Girl - (romant. komedija, SAD, 2004) Ollie Trinkie (B. Affleck) uspješan je glazbeni producent koji je oženio ljubav svog života. Međutim, supruga mu iznenada umre na porodu. Strašna tragedija, strašan šok i početak potpuno novog stila života, s novim problemima na koje ovaj njujorški biznismen nije računao. Sam s tek rođenom djevojčicom, on odluči vratiti se u rodni New Jersey, u kuću u kojoj živi njegov otac. Ollie se pomirio s činjenicom da nikada više neće upoznati osobu s kojom bi mogao ostvariti ljubavnu vezu. No, to ne znači da u susjedstvu nema zgodnih djevojaka... R.: Kevin Smith Ul.: Ben Affleck (Ollie Trinke), Liv Tyler (Maya), Raquel Castro (Gertie Trinke), George Carlin (Bart Trinke), Jennifer Lopez (Gertrude Steiney)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S09, E21, comedy, USA, 2022) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Jeff Garlin (Murray Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg)... / The Goldbergs - (S09, E21, komedija, SAD, 2022) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Jeff Garlin (Murray Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg)...

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Escape to the Country - (S32, E10, Entertainment, England, 2024) The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because the only thing that matters to them is that it is close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house... / Escape to the Country - (S32, E10, zabavni program, Engleska, 2024) Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući...

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George Clarkes Amazing Spaces - (S12, E02, Education, England, 2024) Architect George Clarke explores the amazing ways people make the most of small spaces. He travels the country in search of incredible micro-builds and the people who make them. Their goal is to make the most of every square centimeter of space in their home or garden. George discovers that in the world of microdesign, size doesn't matter. He will meet people who organize their living space in the most unusual places: from toilets that are no longer in use to shipping containers, from horse trailers to wonderfully equipped campers. But George is not just a passive observer. For just £300, he bought a shabby old caravan from the 1970s and hopes to transform it in just three months into one of the most amazing small spaces you've ever seen. Each episode of this British series is themed around the micro-building challenges George faces as part of his own project. From obtaining permits to making the most of the space. The episodes are full of risks, ingenious solutions and eccentric characters. The revolution in decorating small spaces has begun! Director: Scott Ward... / George Clarkes Amazing Spaces - (S12, E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2024) Arhitekt George Clarke istražuje nevjerojatne načine na koje ljudi iskorištavaju male prostore. Putuje zemljom u potrazi za nevjerojatnim mikrogradnjama i ljudima koji se njima bave. Cilj im je maksimalno iskoristiti svaki četvorni centimetar prostora u svom domu ili vrtu. George otkriva da u svijetu mikrodizajna veličina nije bitna. Upoznat će ljude koji si uređuju životni prostor na najneobičnijim mjestima: od zahoda koji više nisu u uporabi do brodskih kontejnera, od prikolica za konje do čudesno opremljenih kampera.No George nije tek pasivan promatrač. Za samo 300 funta kupio je otrcanu, staru kamp-prikolicu iz 1970-ih i nada se da će je u samo tri mjeseca preurediti u jedan od najnevjerojatnijih malih prostora koje ste ikad vidjeli.Svaka je epizoda ove britanske serije tematski podijeljena na izazove mikrogradnje s kojima se George suočava u sklopu svog vlastitog projekta. Od ishođenja dozvola do maksimalnog iskorištavanja prostora. Epizode su pune rizika, genijalnih rješenja i ekscentričnih likova. Revolucija u uređenju malih prostora je počela! R.: Scott Ward...

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E10, Education, USA, 2023) Host Pati Jinich revisits the Mexican state of Yucatán, once the center of the Mayan civilization, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. Pati returns to southeastern Mexico to get to know the widely known state of Yucatán. Remnants of Mayan culture are still ubiquitous in everyday life, so Pati travels the country to meet chefs, craftsmen and families who preserve and continue this tradition. In the lively capital Merida, he discovers how Mayan cuisine changed over the centuries under Spanish influence and became one of the best cuisines in the world. Street: Daniel Jinich (Self)... / Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E10, obrazovni program, SAD, 2023) Voditeljica Pati Jinich ponovno odlazi u meksičku saveznu državu Yucatán, nekoć središte civilizacije Maja, te istražuje utjecaj ovog drevnog naroda na njezinu kulturnu i kulinarsku baštinu. Pati se vraća u jugoistočni Meksiko kako bi pobliže upoznala nadaleko poznatu državu Yucatán. Ostaci majanske kulture i danas su sveprisutni u svakodnevnom životu pa Pati putuje državom kako bi upoznala kuhare, obrtnike i obitelji koji čuvaju i nastavljaju tu tradiciju. U živahnom glavnom gradu Meridi otkriva kako se tijekom stoljeća majanska kuhinja mijenjala pod španjolskim utjecajem te postala jednom od najboljih kuhinja svijeta. Ul.: Daniel Jinich (Self)...

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Garden Of The Year - (S01, E03, Entertainment, England, 2022) Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae compare contestants from Central England and the Midlands in this episode. They visit a garden in Cambridgeshire where the American owner has spared no effort to shape his vision of English rural perfection. In Nottinghamshire, they find tranquility in a garden arranged around a natural pond, and in Oxfordshire, they explore a garden in a plot in a city garden. The beautifully landscaped area reflects true gardening love and passion. And behind a seemingly ordinary home in suburban Walsall, the jury discovers a garden that is anything but ordinary. R.: Kathryn Williams Ul.: Zoë Ball (Self - Judge), Manoj Malde (Self - Judge), Lachlan Rae (Self - Judge), Alison Steadman (Narrator)... / Garden Of the Year - (S01, E03, zabavni program, Engleska, 2022) Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi uspoređuju natjecatelje iz središnje Engleske i Midlandsa. Posjećuju vrt u Cambridgeshireu gdje vlasnik Amerikanac nije štedio truda kako bi oblikovao svoju viziju engleskog ruralnog savršenstva. U Nottinghamshireu pronalaze spokoj u vrtu koji je uređen oko prirodnog jezerca, a u Oxfordshireu razgledavaju vrt na parceli u gradskom vrtu. U krasno uređenom prostoru ogledaju se istinska vrtlarska ljubav i strast. A iza naizgled običnog doma u predgrađu u Walsallu žiri otkriva vrt koji je sve drugo nego običan. R.: Kathryn Williams Ul.: Zoë Ball (Self - Judge), Manoj Malde (Self - Judge), Lachlan Rae (Self - Judge), Alison Steadman (Narrator)...

programme.title: Michel Roux: Flavors of the South of France / Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: Michel Rouxs French Country Cooking - (S03, E04, Education, England, 2022) In this episode, Michel will organize a real feast. programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E04, doc series, Germany, 2021) Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E04, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2021) Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku...

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: Escape to the Country - (S32, E10, Entertainment, England, 2024) The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because the only thing that matters to them is that it is close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house... / Escape to the Country - (S32, E10, zabavni program, Engleska, 2024) Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući...

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: George Clarkes Amazing Spaces - (S12, E02, Education, England, 2024) Architect George Clarke explores the amazing ways people make the most of small spaces. He travels the country in search of incredible micro-builds and the people who make them. Their goal is to make the most of every square centimeter of space in their home or garden. George discovers that in the world of microdesign, size doesn't matter. He will meet people who organize their living space in the most unusual places: from toilets that are no longer in use to shipping containers, from horse trailers to wonderfully equipped campers. But George is not just a passive observer. For just £300, he bought a shabby old caravan from the 1970s and hopes to transform it in just three months into one of the most amazing small spaces you've ever seen. Each episode of this British series is themed around the micro-building challenges George faces as part of his own project. From obtaining permits to making the most of the space. The episodes are full of risks, ingenious solutions and eccentric characters. The revolution in decorating small spaces has begun! Director: Scott Ward... / George Clarkes Amazing Spaces - (S12, E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2024) Arhitekt George Clarke istražuje nevjerojatne načine na koje ljudi iskorištavaju male prostore. Putuje zemljom u potrazi za nevjerojatnim mikrogradnjama i ljudima koji se njima bave. Cilj im je maksimalno iskoristiti svaki četvorni centimetar prostora u svom domu ili vrtu. George otkriva da u svijetu mikrodizajna veličina nije bitna. Upoznat će ljude koji si uređuju životni prostor na najneobičnijim mjestima: od zahoda koji više nisu u uporabi do brodskih kontejnera, od prikolica za konje do čudesno opremljenih kampera.No George nije tek pasivan promatrač. Za samo 300 funta kupio je otrcanu, staru kamp-prikolicu iz 1970-ih i nada se da će je u samo tri mjeseca preurediti u jedan od najnevjerojatnijih malih prostora koje ste ikad vidjeli.Svaka je epizoda ove britanske serije tematski podijeljena na izazove mikrogradnje s kojima se George suočava u sklopu svog vlastitog projekta. Od ishođenja dozvola do maksimalnog iskorištavanja prostora. Epizode su pune rizika, genijalnih rješenja i ekscentričnih likova. Revolucija u uređenju malih prostora je počela! R.: Scott Ward...

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E10, Education, USA, 2023) Host Pati Jinich revisits the Mexican state of Yucatán, once the center of the Mayan civilization, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. Pati returns to southeastern Mexico to get to know the widely known state of Yucatán. Remnants of Mayan culture are still ubiquitous in everyday life, so Pati travels the country to meet chefs, craftsmen and families who preserve and continue this tradition. In the lively capital Merida, he discovers how Mayan cuisine changed over the centuries under Spanish influence and became one of the best cuisines in the world. Street: Daniel Jinich (Self)... / Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E10, obrazovni program, SAD, 2023) Voditeljica Pati Jinich ponovno odlazi u meksičku saveznu državu Yucatán, nekoć središte civilizacije Maja, te istražuje utjecaj ovog drevnog naroda na njezinu kulturnu i kulinarsku baštinu. Pati se vraća u jugoistočni Meksiko kako bi pobliže upoznala nadaleko poznatu državu Yucatán. Ostaci majanske kulture i danas su sveprisutni u svakodnevnom životu pa Pati putuje državom kako bi upoznala kuhare, obrtnike i obitelji koji čuvaju i nastavljaju tu tradiciju. U živahnom glavnom gradu Meridi otkriva kako se tijekom stoljeća majanska kuhinja mijenjala pod španjolskim utjecajem te postala jednom od najboljih kuhinja svijeta. Ul.: Daniel Jinich (Self)...

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Garden Of The Year - (S01, E03, Entertainment, England, 2022) Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae compare contestants from Central England and the Midlands in this episode. They visit a garden in Cambridgeshire where the American owner has spared no effort to shape his vision of English rural perfection. In Nottinghamshire, they find tranquility in a garden arranged around a natural pond, and in Oxfordshire, they explore a garden in a plot in a city garden. The beautifully landscaped area reflects true gardening love and passion. And behind a seemingly ordinary home in suburban Walsall, the jury discovers a garden that is anything but ordinary. R.: Kathryn Williams Ul.: Zoë Ball (Self - Judge), Manoj Malde (Self - Judge), Lachlan Rae (Self - Judge), Alison Steadman (Narrator)... / Garden Of the Year - (S01, E03, zabavni program, Engleska, 2022) Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi uspoređuju natjecatelje iz središnje Engleske i Midlandsa. Posjećuju vrt u Cambridgeshireu gdje vlasnik Amerikanac nije štedio truda kako bi oblikovao svoju viziju engleskog ruralnog savršenstva. U Nottinghamshireu pronalaze spokoj u vrtu koji je uređen oko prirodnog jezerca, a u Oxfordshireu razgledavaju vrt na parceli u gradskom vrtu. U krasno uređenom prostoru ogledaju se istinska vrtlarska ljubav i strast. A iza naizgled običnog doma u predgrađu u Walsallu žiri otkriva vrt koji je sve drugo nego običan. R.: Kathryn Williams Ul.: Zoë Ball (Self - Judge), Manoj Malde (Self - Judge), Lachlan Rae (Self - Judge), Alison Steadman (Narrator)...

programme.title: Zadar, European table tennis championship / Zadar, Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: European Table Tennis Championships - (sport program, Croatia, 2025) From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Table Tennis Team Championship, where 24 men's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title... / European Table Tennis Championships - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov...

programme.title: Recreation / Rekreacija
programme.desc: Recreation - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) We take you to Petrinja to the Chestnut Festival and Mountaineering Chestnut Festival - a two-day event that successfully combines tradition, sport and mountaineering, gastronomy and music into one unforgettable experience. We were also at the Zagreb Marathon, which gathered as many as 5,019 runners from almost 80 countries around the world. We investigated who the pacers are and what their role is in the success of the race. We also bring a story about outdoor training - on training grounds that are springing up in more and more Croatian cities. And in our permanent section From the gym, we present a series of new, useful exercises to strengthen muscles and improve body stability... / Rekreacija - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Vodimo vas u Petrinju na Festival kestena i planinarsku kestenijadu - manifestaciju koja u dva dana uspješno spaja tradiciju, sport i planinarenje, gastronomiju i glazbu u jedno nezaboravno iskustvo. Bili smo i na Zagrebačkom maratonu, koji je okupio čak 5019 trkača iz gotovo 80 zemalja svijeta. Istražili smo tko su pejseri i kakva je njihova uloga u uspjehu na utrci. Donosimo i priču o treningu na otvorenom - na vježbalištima koja niču u sve više hrvatskih gradova. A u našoj stalnoj rubrici Iz teretane predstavljamo niz novih, korisnih vježbi za jačanje mišića i poboljšanje stabilnosti tijela...

programme.title: World of entertainment / Svijet zabave
programme.desc: The world of entertainment - (entertainment program, Croatia, 2025) While the world public considered Victoria Beckham to be nobility, she - was swimming in debt! In addition to the unexpected recognition of the famous spice, we also bring news about the new projects of Scarlett Johansson, Julia Roberts, Idris Elba and Keira Knightley. While presenting new films, Hollywood stars do not spare praise when it comes to the actress who left us in the week after us, the inimitable Diane Keaton. R.: Kamelija Čančarević... / Svijet zabave - (zabavni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Dok je svjetska javnost Victoriju Beckham smatrala plemstvom, ona je - plivala u dugovima! Osim neočekivanog priznanja poznate spajsice, donosimo i novosti o novim projektima Scarlett Johansson, Julije Roberts, Idrisa Elbe i Keire Knightley. Dok predstavljaju nove filmove, holivudske zvijezde ne štede pohvale kada je riječ o glumici koja nas je napustila u tjednu za nama, neponovljivoj Diane Keaton. R.: Kamelija Čančarević...

programme.title: Hit of the day / Hit dana
programme.desc: Hit of the day - (musical video clip, Croatia, 2025) In Hit of the Day every weekday the latest from the Croatian music scene. We present the latest popular, fun and tambura songs by Croatian authors and performers... / Hit dana - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska, 2025) U Hitu dana svaki radni dan najnovije s hrvatske glazbene scene. Predstavljamo najnovije pjesme popularne, zabavne i tamburaške pjesme hrvatskih autora i izvođača...

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E05, Education, England, 2022) Ben travels to the Shetland Islands, one of the most isolated spots in Britain. He will visit Helen and Jason, a couple who have been living on the island of Yell for several years. They will discover why they gave up life in the city and see what obstacles they face as they realize their dream of living on this beautiful island far from civilization. Ben's hosts devote a lot of time to the physically demanding renovation of the house, and at the same time cultivate 10 hectares of land. They admit that sometimes they have too much work. Ben will shear sheep, lay water pipes, weave woolen rugs and extract peat with them. Director: Sean McDonnell... / Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E05, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Ben putuje na Shetlandsko otočje, jednu od najizoliranijih točaka Britanije. Posjetit će Helen i Jasona, par koji već nekoliko godina živi na otoku Yellu. Otkrit će zašto su odustali od života u gradu i vidjeti s kakvim se preprekama suočavaju dok ostvaruju san o životu na ovom lijepom otoku daleko od civilizacije. Benovi domaćini mnogo vremena posvećuju fizički zahtjevnoj obnovi kuće, a usto obrađuju i 10 hektara zemlje. Priznaju da katkad imaju previše posla. Ben će s njima šišati ovce, polagati vodovodne cijevi, tkati vunene sagove i vaditi treset. R.: Sean McDonnell...

programme.title: Krimi petak: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea / Krimi petak: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea
programme.desc: I bastardi di Pizzofalcone - (E06, drama series, Italy, 2017) In Naples, the Pizzofalcone inspectorate is planned to be closed after it was discovered that its former police officers were corrupt and tarnished the station's reputation. Colleagues from other stations called them the derogatory nickname I Bastardi di Pizzofalcone. That infamous nickname is now also carried by five new policemen, called to complete the remaining tasks before the station's closure. During the investigations, personal relationships within the team will also develop: rapprochement, occasional conflicts, misunderstandings and the search for a balance between demanding work and complicated private lives. Slowly, but surely, a real team emerges from a group of individuals. Underneath everything remains Naples - a city where the blue of the sky, the sea and the light of the sun are followed day by day by shadows, pain, compassion, laughter and tears. R.: Carlo Carlei Ul.: Alessandro Gassman (Ispettore Giuseppe Lojacono), Carolina Crescentini (P.M. Laura Piras), Tosca DAquino (Ottavia Calabrese), Alberto Angrisano (Padre di Aragona), Miriam Candurro (Giorgia Romano)... / I bastardi di Pizzofalcone - (E06, igrana serija, Italija, 2017) U Napulju se planira zatvaranje inspektorata Pizzofalcone nakon što je otkriveno da su njegovi dotadašnji policajci bili korumpirani i ukaljali ugled postaje. Kolege iz drugih postaja prozvali su ih pogrdnim nadimkom I Bastardi di Pizzofalcone. Taj zloglasni nadimak sada nose i petorica novih policajaca, pozvanih da dovrše preostale poslove prije zatvaranja postaje.Tijekom istraga, razvijat će se i osobni odnosi unutar tima: približavanje, povremeni sukobi, nesporazumi i traženje ravnoteže između zahtjevnog posla i kompliciranih privatnih života. Polako, ali sigurno, od skupine pojedinaca nastaje pravi tim. U podlozi svega ostaje Napulj - grad u kojem plavetnilo neba, mora i svjetlost sunca iz dana u dan prate sjene, bol, suosjećanje, smijeh i suze. R.: Carlo Carlei Ul.: Alessandro Gassman (Ispettore Giuseppe Lojacono), Carolina Crescentini (P.M. Laura Piras), Tosca DAquino (Ottavia Calabrese), Alberto Angrisano (Padre di Aragona), Miriam Candurro (Giorgia Romano)...

programme.title: Crime Friday: Silent Witness / Krimi petak: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: Silent Witness - (S26, E02, crime series, England, 2023) Dead and dying people are found in an abandoned truck in a quarry. At first it seems to be about people smuggling, but it soon becomes clear that the story is not what it seems. The survivors refuse to cooperate, so Nikki and the team must apply their expertise to identify the victims and discover what really happened. Gabriel gets especially involved, which causes him to face an ethical dilemma, and Jack is surprised by an unexpected visit. R.: Max Myers Ul.: Aaron Garland (Hero Teenager), Eoin Lynch (Marcus Tillman), Maisie Ayres (Maeve Tooney), Kate Bracken (Lucy Stevens), Maria Forrester (Ketevan Gvazava)... / Silent Witness - (S26, E02, krim. serija, Engleska, 2023) U napuštenom kamionu u kamenolomu pronađeni su mrtvi i ljudi na samrti. U početku se čini da je riječ o krijumčarenju ljudi, no ubrzo postaje jasno da priča nije onakva kakvom se doima. Preživjeli odbijaju surađivati, pa Nikki i ekipa moraju primijeniti svoje stručno znanje kako bi identificirali žrtve i otkrili što se zapravo dogodilo. Gabriel se posebno angažira, zbog čega se nađe pred etičkom dilemom, a Jacka iznenađuje neočekivan posjet. R.: Max Myers Ul.: Aaron Garland (Hero Teenager), Eoin Lynch (Marcus Tillman), Maisie Ayres (Maeve Tooney), Kate Bracken (Lucy Stevens), Maria Forrester (Ketevan Gvazava)...

programme.title: Plot crime: Mode / Krimi petak: Modus
programme.desc: Modus - (S02, E06, crime series, Sweden, 2017) In the classic Nordic noir, we follow inspector Inger Johanne Vik as she solves a series of brutal murders and a kidnapping of global significance in the middle of the Swedish metropolis. Rather than a straightforward detective thriller, this suspenseful, thought-provoking drama follows Johanne as she slowly becomes drawn into a web of international intrigue, directly putting herself and her daughter in danger. Viewers will immediately follow the tense plot, accompanied by superb acting and a masterful script. Director: Håkan Lindhe Street: Henrik Norlen (Ingvar Nyman), Melinda Kinnaman (Inger Johanne Vik), Kim Cattrall (Helen Tyler), Greg Wise (Warren Schifford), Paprika Steen (Alva Roos)... / Modus - (S02, E06, krim. serija, Švedska, 2017) U klasičnom nordijskom noiru pratimo inspektoricu Inger Johanne Vik dok rješava niz surovih ubojstava i otmicu od globalnog značenja usred švedske metropole. Umjesto izravnog detektivskog trilera, ova napeta, misaona drama prati Johanne kako se polako uvlači u mrežu međunarodnih intriga i time izravno dovodi u opasnost sebe i svoju kćer. Gledatelji će netremice pratiti napeti zaplet, praćen vrhunskom glumom i majstorskim scenarijem. R.: Håkan Lindhe Ul.: Henrik Norlen (Ingvar Nyman), Melinda Kinnaman (Inger Johanne Vik), Kim Cattrall (Helen Tyler), Greg Wise (Warren Schifford), Paprika Steen (Alva Roos)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S09, E21, comedy, USA, 2022) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Jeff Garlin (Murray Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg)... / The Goldbergs - (S09, E21, komedija, SAD, 2022) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Jeff Garlin (Murray Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S09, E22, Comedy, USA, 2022) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lew Schneider St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S09, E22, komedija, SAD, 2022) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: Out of format / Izvan formata
programme.desc: Outside the format - (art program, Croatia, 2025) When Gallery f8 was opened seven years ago on the eve of Christmas at Trg Republike Hrvatska at number 8, the photography students of the Academy of Dramatic Arts in Zagreb received the most beautiful holiday present. In the past seven years, we have seen more than 40 exhibitions at that address, which gathered numerous visitors. And this is confirmation that Galerija f8 has outgrown the student gallery story and that it has become an important place that was missing on the Croatian photography and art scene. These days, due to the danger of the facade collapsing and cracked sculptures on the building, the Gallery had to move out. The agile professors and students of the Department of Photography arranged a new exhibition space in the immediate vicinity and thus continued this beautiful gallery story. In the studio about the ADU Gallery and Department of Photography, we talk with professor Jelena Blagović and photographer Gloria Lizde. And we were also at an interesting exam exhibition of photography students Vid Redža and David Bakarić Mihaljević... / Izvan formata - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Kada je prije sedam godina uoči Božića na Trgu Republike Hrvatske na broju 8 otvorena Galerija f8, studenti fotografije zagrebačke Akademije dramske umjetnosti dobili su najljepši blagdanski poklon. U proteklih sedam godina na toj smo adresi vidjeli više od 40 izložbi koje su okupljale brojne posjetitelje. A to je potvrda da je Galerija f8 prerasla studentsku galerijsku priču te da je postala važno mjesto koje je nedostajalo na hrvatskoj fotografskoj i umjetničkoj sceni. Ovih dana zbog opasnosti od urušavanja fasade i napuklih skulptura na zgradi Galerija se morala iseliti. Agilni profesori i studenti Katedre za fotografiju uredili su u neposrednoj blizini novi izložbeni prostor i tako nastavili ovu lijepu galerijsku priču. U studiju o Galeriji i Katedri za fotografiju ADU razgovaramo s profesoricom Jelenom Blagović i fotografkinjom Glorijom Lizde. A bili smo i na zanimljivoj ispitnoj izložbi studenata fotografije Vida Redže i Davida Bakarića Mihaljevića...

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: Night music program - videos - (musical video clips, Croatia) In the night hours, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive... / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi - (glazb. videoisječak, Hrvatska) U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E01, Comedy, USA, 2021) After Murray's death, Adam, Barry and Erica return home to be with their mother. Adam postpones going to college and decides to pursue film, Barry is on his way to becoming a doctor, Erica and Geoff are becoming parents, and Beverly is preparing for the most important role in life - that of a grandmother! The new season brings a handful of exciting plots as family members try to navigate their new roles, and Uncle Marvin and Grandpa make an unexpected statement. --- Everyone lives together again, so the usual chaos reigns in the Goldberg house. Pregnant Erica asks Beverly to help her make room for the new baby, and Adam and Barry have to share a room so the baby can have its own. R.: Lew Schneider St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E01, komedija, SAD, 2021) Nakon Murrayeve smrti, Adam, Barry i Erica vraćaju se kući kako bi bili uz majku. Adam odgađa odlazak na studij i odlučuje se baviti filmom, Barry je na putu da postane liječnik, Erica i Geoff postaju roditelji, a Beverly se priprema za najvažniju ulogu u životu - onu bake! Nova sezona donosi pregršt uzbudljivih zapleta dok se članovi obitelji pokušavaju snaći u svojim novim ulogama, a stric Marvin i djed neočekivano se iskažu. --- Svi ponovno žive zajedno pa u kući Goldbergovih vlada uobičajeni kaos. Trudna Erica zamoli Beverly da joj pomogne napraviti mjesta za prinovu, a Adam i Barry moraju dijeliti sobu kako bi beba dobila svoju. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: Square home / Dom na kvadrat
programme.desc: Dom na kvadrat - (educational program, Croatia, 2025) We bring all the novelties presented at this year's NnDizajn fair held in Zagreb. From shower channels, quiet luxury and furniture made of quartz and porcelain, to products of small craftsmen... / Dom na kvadrat - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Donosimo sve novitete predstavljene na ovogodišnjem NnDizajn sajmu održanom u Zagrebu. Od tuš kanalica, tihog luksuza i namještaja od kvarca i porculana, do proizvoda malih obrtnika...

programme.title: Business plan / Poslovni plan
programme.desc: Business plan - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) The show brings the latest news from the economy, talks about perspectives, economic forecasts, GDP trends, problems and growth generators... / Poslovni plan - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija donosi najnovije vijesti iz ekonomije, govori o perspektivama, ekonomskim prognozama, kretanju BDP-a, problemima i generatorima rasta...

programme.title: Coordination / Koordinacija
programme.desc: Coordination - (educational program, Croatia, 2025) Introducing a new section - Master's practice! The master of this practice is Doctor DS, also known as David Skrbin. He is followed on YouTube by almost three million do-it-yourself project enthusiasts, and he will demonstrate equally useful procedures in the Master's surgery. It was easier to build a new one than to restore the old one! We find out what were the biggest challenges during the reconstruction of the first tube of the Učka tunnel. The guest of the Notes column is Dario Silić, the general manager of Bina Istra, the concessionaire of Istrian ipsilon. We bring you a story about a famous Croatian stone - and no, it's not from Brac! In the Tips and Tricks column, we deal with furnishing the bathroom... / Koordinacija - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Predstavljamo novu rubriku - Majstorska ordinacija! Majstor ove ordinacije je Doctor DS, poznat i kao David Skrbin. Na YouTubeu ga prati gotovo tri milijuna zaljubljenika u uradi sam projekte, a jednako korisne zahvate pokazat će i u Majstorskoj ordinaciji. Jednostavnije je bilo izgraditi novu nego obnoviti staru! Doznajemo koji su bili najveći izazovi tijekom obnove prve cijevi tunela Učka. Gost rubrike Notes je Dario Silić, generalni direktor Bina Istre, koncesionara Istarskog ipsilona. Donosimo priču o jednom poznatom hrvatskom kamenu - i ne, nije brački! U rubrici Tips and Tricks bavimo se opremanjem kupaonice...

programme.title: Auto Market Magazine / Auto Market Magazin
programme.desc: Auto Market Magazin - (educational program, Croatia, 2025) In the show for car lovers, new car models, technological innovations are presented every week, new vehicles are tested, maintenance tips are provided... / Auto Market Magazin - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) U emisiji za ljubitelje automobila svaki tjedan predstavljaju se novi modeli automobila, tehnološke inovacije, testiraju nova vozila, donose savjeti o održavanju...

programme.title: Hotel Portofino / Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Hotel Portofino - (S02, E06, Drama, England, 2023) The Ainsworth family and their guests head to the local casino to celebrate, and Luciano's relationship with Rose reaches a critical point. Bella tries to contain the consequences, but she is hindered by the jealous showdown between Cecil and Marc and the outburst of mad manly courage that threatens the future of the hotel, as well as the need to deal with Constance's family problems. Bella must act decisively to save everything she has invested in the Portofino Hotel, but at what cost to her relationships and those of her children? Director: Adam Wimpenny Street: Daniele Pecci (Count Carlo Albani), Olivia Morris (Alice Mays-Smith), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth), Assad Zaman (Anish Sengupta), Pasquale Esposito (Vincenzo Danioni)... / Hotel Portofino - (S02, E06, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Obitelj Ainsworth i njihovi gosti kreću na proslavu u mjesni kasino, a Lucianov odnos s Rose doseže kritičnu točku. Bella pokušava obuzdati posljedice, ali u tome je ometa ljubomorni obračun između Cecila i Marca te ispad lude muške hrabrosti koji prijeti budućnosti hotela, kao i potreba da se uhvati u koštac s Constanceinim obiteljskim problemima. Bella mora odlučno djelovati kako bi spasila sve što je uložila u hotel Portofino, ali pod koju cijenu za svoje veze i veze svoje djece? R.: Adam Wimpenny Ul.: Daniele Pecci (Count Carlo Albani), Olivia Morris (Alice Mays-Smith), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth), Assad Zaman (Anish Sengupta), Pasquale Esposito (Vincenzo Danioni)...

programme.title: Hotel Portofino / Hotel Portofino
programme.desc: Hotel Portofino - (S03, E01, Drama, England, 2024) While trying to slip out of town after a night out with her lover Marco, Bella Ainsworth runs into local fascist leader Danioni. Bella has an excuse ready, but it's clear that Danioni doesn't believe her. During this time, the hotel is preparing for the arrival of Bella's father George and sister Amelia. But Bella's plans fall apart when Cecil suddenly shows up, followed shortly by George and Amelia. As Bella tries to cope with her demanding father and bitter sister, Cecil shocks her by suggesting they break up. It's also exciting among the servants because Constance meets the pharmacist Vita, who likes her, but because of many secrets from her past, Constance doesn't know how to behave. Betty is also enjoying love and preparing for her engagement to Salvatore. Amelia takes Alice to Genoa to try to awaken her former spirit, but Alice is shocked to meet her former suitor Count Carlo Albani. During this time, Bella is seriously considering a divorce, but Cecil tells her that she will have to publicly admit to adultery. Bella gets angry and doesn't know what to do. Director: Adam Wimpenny Street: Natascha McElhone (Bella Ainsworth), Mark Umbers (Cecil Ainsworth), Louisa Binder (Constance March), Elizabeth Carling (Betty Scanlon), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth)... / Hotel Portofino - (S03, E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2024) Dok pokušava neopaženo otići iz mjesta nakon što je provela noć sa svojim ljubavnikom Marcom, Bella Ainsworth naleti na vođu mjesnih fašista Danionija. Bella ima spreman izgovor, ali jasno je da joj Danioni ne vjeruje. Za to se vrijeme hotel priprema za dolazak Bellina oca Georgea i sestre Amelije. No Bellini planovi padaju u vodu kad se iznebuha pojavi Cecil, a ubrzo nakon njega i George i Amelia. Dok Bella pokušava izaći na kraj sa svojim zahtjevnim ocem i ogorčenom sestrom, Cecil je šokira prijedlogom da se rastanu. Uzbudljivo je i među poslugom jer Constance upoznaje ljekarnika Vitu kojemu se svidi, ali zbog mnogo tajni iz svoje prošlosti Constance ne zna kako bi se ponašala. Betty također uživa u ljubavi i priprema se za zaruke sa Salvatoreom. Amelia odvede Alice u Genovu kako bi pokušala probuditi njezin nekadašnji duh, no Alice šokira susret s bivšim udvaračem grofom Carlom Albanijem. Za to vrijeme Bella ozbiljno razmišlja o rastavi, ali Cecil joj kaže da će morati javno priznati preljub. Bella se razbjesni i ne zna što bi. R.: Adam Wimpenny Ul.: Natascha McElhone (Bella Ainsworth), Mark Umbers (Cecil Ainsworth), Louisa Binder (Constance March), Elizabeth Carling (Betty Scanlon), Oliver Dench (Lucian Ainsworth)...

programme.title: World of gardeners / Svijet vrtlara
programme.desc: Gardeners World - (S13, E30, nature film, England, 2023) In the Dry Garden, Monty transplants common iris, sets up a greenhouse for winter salad and picks quinces. As part of the major modernization of the Village Garden, he transplants bushes into the Orchard and shows us how collecting and saving seeds from plants from the garden can save money. Arit Anderson explores the arguments for and against artificial grass. Deep in the beautiful rural landscape of Wales, Toby Buckland discovers a rich and tranquil Japanese garden. We go to the garden of Andrew Clifton, who repurposes and recycles a wide range of materials to create a wonderful Secret Garden in Nottingham. We are also with gardeners Steve Edney and Louise Dowle, who have planted the entire flowerbed with plants that, with their structure and shapes, not only create stunning winter scenes, but also leave seeds for the next one every year. In addition, we bring more videos about gardens sent to us by viewers... / Gardeners World - (S13, E30, prirod. film, Engleska, 2023) Monty u Suhom vrtu presađuje običnu peruniku, rasprema staklenik za zimsku salatu i bere dunje. U sklopu velike modernizacije Seoskog vrta, presađuje grmlje u Voćnjak i pokazuje nam kako se skupljanjem i čuvanjem sjemena od biljaka iz vrta može uštedjeti novac. Arit Anderson istražuje koji argumenti govore za, a koji protiv umjetne trave. Toby Buckland duboko u prekrasnom ruralnom krajobrazu Walesa otkriva bogat i smiren japanski vrt. Odlazimo u vrt Andrewa Cliftona, koji prenamjenjuje i reciklira široki spektar materijala i stvara predivan Tajni vrt u Nottinghamu.
