Nalazimo se i s vrtlarima Steveom Edneyjem i Louiseom Dowle koji su zasadili cijelu gredicu biljkama koje svojom strukturom i oblicima stvaraju ne samo zapanjujuće zimske prizore, već im i svake godine ostavljaju sjeme za iduću. Osim toga donosimo još videouradaka o vrtovima koje nam šalju gledatelji...

programme.title: Teen cream: Grantchester / Krimi matineja: Grantchester
programme.desc: Grantchester - (S04, E01, drama series, England, 2019) The year is 1953. Sidney Chambers (James Norton) is the vicar of Grantchester, a village not far from Cambridge. Sidney leads a peaceful life, or at least he did - until he encountered a murder... Finding himself in the dangerous world of lies, betrayal and murder, Sidney soon realizes that his knowledge of the human psyche and the trust he instills in people enable him to perform his new detective work extremely skillfully. R.: Tim Fywell St.: James Norton (Sidney Chambers), Robson Green (Geordie Keating), Tom Brittney (Will Davenport), Al Weaver (Leonard Finch), Tessa Peake-Jones (Mrs. Chapman)... / Grantchester - (S04, E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2019) Godina je 1953. Sidney Chambers (James Norton) je vikar u Grantchesteru, selu nedaleko od Cambridgea. Sidney vodi miran život, ili ga je barem vodio - sve dok nije naišao na ubojstvo... Zatekavši se u opasnom svijetu laži, izdaje i umorstva, Sidney ubrzo shvaća da mu poznavanje ljudske psihe te povjerenje koje ljudima ulijeva omogućavaju da iznimno vješto obavlja svoj novi detektivski posao. R.: Tim Fywell Ul.: James Norton (Sidney Chambers), Robson Green (Geordie Keating), Tom Brittney (Will Davenport), Al Weaver (Leonard Finch), Tessa Peake-Jones (Mrs. Chapman)...

programme.title: Teenage cream: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea / Krimi matineja: Bitange iz Pizzofalconea
programme.desc: I bastardi di Pizzofalcone - (E06, drama series, Italy, 2017) In Naples, the Pizzofalcone inspectorate is planned to be closed after it was discovered that its former police officers were corrupt and tarnished the station's reputation. Colleagues from other stations called them the derogatory nickname I Bastardi di Pizzofalcone. That infamous nickname is now also carried by five new policemen, called to complete the remaining tasks before the station's closure. During the investigations, personal relationships within the team will also develop: rapprochement, occasional conflicts, misunderstandings and the search for a balance between demanding work and complicated private lives. Slowly, but surely, a real team emerges from a group of individuals. Underneath everything remains Naples - a city where the blue of the sky, the sea and the light of the sun are followed day by day by shadows, pain, compassion, laughter and tears. R.: Carlo Carlei Ul.: Alessandro Gassman (Ispettore Giuseppe Lojacono), Carolina Crescentini (P.M. Laura Piras), Tosca DAquino (Ottavia Calabrese), Alberto Angrisano (Padre di Aragona), Miriam Candurro (Giorgia Romano)... / I bastardi di Pizzofalcone - (E06, igrana serija, Italija, 2017) U Napulju se planira zatvaranje inspektorata Pizzofalcone nakon što je otkriveno da su njegovi dotadašnji policajci bili korumpirani i ukaljali ugled postaje. Kolege iz drugih postaja prozvali su ih pogrdnim nadimkom I Bastardi di Pizzofalcone. Taj zloglasni nadimak sada nose i petorica novih policajaca, pozvanih da dovrše preostale poslove prije zatvaranja postaje.Tijekom istraga, razvijat će se i osobni odnosi unutar tima: približavanje, povremeni sukobi, nesporazumi i traženje ravnoteže između zahtjevnog posla i kompliciranih privatnih života. Polako, ali sigurno, od skupine pojedinaca nastaje pravi tim. U podlozi svega ostaje Napulj - grad u kojem plavetnilo neba, mora i svjetlost sunca iz dana u dan prate sjene, bol, suosjećanje, smijeh i suze. R.: Carlo Carlei Ul.: Alessandro Gassman (Ispettore Giuseppe Lojacono), Carolina Crescentini (P.M. Laura Piras), Tosca DAquino (Ottavia Calabrese), Alberto Angrisano (Padre di Aragona), Miriam Candurro (Giorgia Romano)...

programme.title: Crime matinee: Silent witness / Krimi matineja: Nijemi svjedok
programme.desc: Silent Witness - (S26, E02, crime series, England, 2023) Dead and dying people are found in an abandoned truck in a quarry. At first it seems to be about people smuggling, but it soon becomes clear that the story is not what it seems. The survivors refuse to cooperate, so Nikki and the team must apply their expertise to identify the victims and discover what really happened. Gabriel gets especially involved, which causes him to face an ethical dilemma, and Jack is surprised by an unexpected visit. R.: Max Myers Ul.: Aaron Garland (Hero Teenager), Eoin Lynch (Marcus Tillman), Maisie Ayres (Maeve Tooney), Kate Bracken (Lucy Stevens), Maria Forrester (Ketevan Gvazava)... / Silent Witness - (S26, E02, krim. serija, Engleska, 2023) U napuštenom kamionu u kamenolomu pronađeni su mrtvi i ljudi na samrti. U početku se čini da je riječ o krijumčarenju ljudi, no ubrzo postaje jasno da priča nije onakva kakvom se doima. Preživjeli odbijaju surađivati, pa Nikki i ekipa moraju primijeniti svoje stručno znanje kako bi identificirali žrtve i otkrili što se zapravo dogodilo. Gabriel se posebno angažira, zbog čega se nađe pred etičkom dilemom, a Jacka iznenađuje neočekivan posjet. R.: Max Myers Ul.: Aaron Garland (Hero Teenager), Eoin Lynch (Marcus Tillman), Maisie Ayres (Maeve Tooney), Kate Bracken (Lucy Stevens), Maria Forrester (Ketevan Gvazava)...

programme.title: Karl Lagerfeld: Exposed / Karl Lagerfeld: Razotkrivanje
programme.desc: Karl Lagerfeld : Revelation - (E02, educational program, France, 2024) While his longtime rival Yves Saint-Laurent was experiencing a series of life successes, Karl decided to take a different path. He became an advocate of ready-to-wear and distanced himself from Yves and his efforts to become an artist and haute couture designer. Saint-Laurent and Pierre Berge despised him for his understanding of fashion as a commodity. And Lagerfeld despised them with all his heart. In 1972, at the age of 39, Lagerfeld fell in love for the first time when he met Jacques de Bascher. Lagerfeld and Saint-Laurent's business rivalry became personal when Jacques cheated on him with Yves. R.: Stephane Bohee... / Karl Lagerfeld : Revelation - (E02, obrazovni program, Francuska, 2024) Dok je njegov dugogodišnji suparnik Yves Saint-Laurent doživljavao niz životnih uspjeha, Karl je odlučio poći drugim putem. Postao je zagovornik konfekcije i udaljio se od Yvesa i njegovih nastojanja da postane umjetnik i dizajner visoke mode. Saint-Laurent i Pierre Berge prezirali su ga zbog njegova shvaćanja mode kao robe. A i Lagerfeld je njih prezirao iz sveg srca. Godine 1972., u 39. godini života, Lagerfeld se prvi put zaljubio kad je upoznao Jacquesa de Baschera. Poslovno suparništvo Lagerfelda i Saint-Laurenta postalo je i osobno kad ga je Jacques prevario s Yvesom. R.: Stephane Bohee...

programme.title: I love Croatia / Volim Hrvatsku
programme.desc: I Love Croatia - (S12, E04, show program, Croatia, 2025) Sunday afternoons are again cheered up by the team of the show I Love Croatia. The captains are Dušan Bućan and Goran Navojec. In the fourth show, they will compete: in Dušan's team Lovro Juraga, Iva Šimić Šakoronja and Ivana Starčević, and in Goran's team Natali Radovčić, Matija Šakoronja and Mario Kovač. Contestants will try their hand at well-known games such as Guess the Song, Happy Birthday, TV and Film, Sport, Famous Compatriots, Shufflers, Average Citizen and Word Croatian. The show is hosted by Mirko Fodor. The hits of local music are performed live by the band Ante Gele. Director: Ivan Miladinov... / Volim Hrvatsku - (S12, E04, show program, Hrvatska, 2025) Nedjeljna popodneva ponovno uveseljava ekipa šoua Volim Hrvatsku. Kapetani su Dušan Bućan i Goran Navojec. U četvrtoj emisiji snage će odmjeriti: u Dušanovom timu Lovro Juraga, Iva Šimić Šakoronja i Ivana Starčević, a u Goranovom timu Natali Radovčić, Matija Šakoronja i Mario Kovač. Natjecatelji će se okušati u dobro poznatim igrama poput Pogodi pjesmu, Sretan rođendan, TV i film, Sport, Poznati sunarodnjaci, Premetaljke, Prosječni građanin i Riječ hrvatska. Emisiju vodi Mirko Fodor. Hitove domaće glazbe uživo izvodi bend Ante Gele. R.: Ivan Miladinov...

programme.title: Don't forget to leave a review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Don't forget to leave a review - (E03, tourist program, Croatia, 2025) The fries were cold, the waiter was hot! A review like this makes the chef angry, but makes the restaurant owner happy. Satisfying hungry tourists is one of the biggest challenges. Gastronomy is the area where reviews are the most peppery, but also the most powerful. In just a few clicks, guests can launch a restaurant to the very top of the rankings, or leave it eerily empty. Is our sea enough for Croatian gastronomy to get five stars? R.: Ivan Grgur... / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju - (E03, turistički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pomfrit je bio hladan, konobar je bio vatren! Recenzija poput ove naljuti glavnog kuhara, ali razveseli vlasnika restorana. Zadovoljiti gladne turiste jedan je od najvećih izazova. Gastronomija je područje gdje su recenzije najpaprenije, ali i najmoćnije. U samo nekoliko klikova gosti mogu lansirati restoran na sam vrh ljestvice, ili ga ostaviti sablasno praznim. Je li naše more dovoljno da hrvatska gastroponuda dobije pet zvjezdica? R.: Ivan Grgur...

programme.title: Police witnesses / Policijske priče
programme.desc: Police stories - (E03, educational program, Croatia, 2025) Participation in "Action Camorra" by Krunoslav Pokas will bring him face to face with a known dangerous criminal. See what encounters with dangerous criminals look like and what a man feels when he has to reach for the last option - take out his own gun. R.: Hrvoje Mabić... / Policijske priče - (E03, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Sudjelovanje u "Akciji Camorra" Krunoslava Pokasa dovest će oči u oči s poznatim opasnim počiniteljem. Pogledajte kako izgledaju susreti s opasnim kriminalcima te što čovjek osjeća kada mora posegnuti za zadnjom opcijom - izvaditi svoj vlastiti pištolj. R.: Hrvoje Mabić...

programme.title: Diary of a Nomad / Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Diary of a Nomad - (E03, nature film, Croatia, 2025) Kristijan Iličić's journey through Ethiopia begins in Harar, one of the holy cities of Islam. Harar is known for the coexistence of humans and hyenas, so Kristijan meets a pack of wild hyenas that clean the city at night, feeding on garbage. Visiting Gondar, the former seat of Ethiopian rulers, Kristijan finds himself in a conflict zone between the army and the rebels. Despite the danger of war, he climbs Mount Semien to find gelada monkeys, a unique species of primate that lives only in that location. He briefly visits Lalibella, the holy city of Ethiopian Christians, with the so-called the eighth wonder of the world - the rock-hewn Church of St. Jurja. Arriving in the modern metropolis of Addis Ababa, Kristijan explores the past and present of the big city - he hangs out with the rap star Kassmasse, but also visits the castle of Emperor Menelik, where the Seljan brothers lived 125 years ago. Director: Dario Lonjak Ul.: Kristijan Ilicic (Self)... / Dnevnik Nomada - (E03, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Putovanje Etiopijom Kristijan Iličić počinje u Hararu, jednom od svetih gradova islama. Harar je poznat po suživotu ljudi i hijena pa tako i Kristijan susreće čopor divljih hijena koje noću čiste grad hraneći se otpacima. Posjećujući Gondar, bivše sjedište etiopskih vladara, Kristijan se nađe u zoni sukoba vojske i pobunjenika. Unatoč ratnoj opasnosti, penje se na planinu Semien kako bi pronašao majmune gelade, jedinstvenu vrstu primata koja živi samo na toj lokaciji. Nakratko posjeti Lalibellu, sveti grad etiopskih kršćana, s tzv. osmim svjetskim čudom - u stijenu uklesanom Crkvom sv. Jurja. Dolaskom u modernu metropolu Addis Abebu, Kristijan istražuje prošlost i sadašnjost velikog grada - druži se s rap zvijezdom Kassmasseom, ali i posjećuje dvorac cara Menelika, u kojem su prije 125 godina boravila braća Seljan. R.: Dario Lonjak Ul.: Kristijan Ilicic (Self)...

programme.title: Zadar, European table tennis championship / Zadar, Europsko prvenstvo u stolnom tenisu
programme.desc: European Table Tennis Championships - (sport program, Croatia, 2025) From October 12 to 19, 2025, Zadar will host the 44th European Table Tennis Team Championship, where 24 men's national teams will compete in the group and knockout stages. The competition in the Višnjik hall brings top sport, tension and spectacular encounters in the quest for the title... / European Table Tennis Championships - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Od 12. do 19. listopada 2025. Zadar će biti domaćin 44. Europskog ekipnog prvenstva u stolnom tenisu, gdje će 24 muške reprezentacije odmjeriti snage u grupama i nokaut fazama. Natjecanje u dvorani Višnjik donosi vrhunski sport, napetost i spektakularne susrete u pohodu na naslov...

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain - Meeting the Unknown / Anthony Bourdain - Upoznavanje nepoznatog
programme.desc: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown - (S10, E04, zn. pop. series, USA, 2017) Bourdain dives into the gastronomic scene at a crossroads: on the one hand, a recognizable steel town defined by working-class food - steaks and potatoes, sausages and sauerkraut - and on the other, a city on the rise that attracts a foodie crowd thanks to a new high-tech industry. Bourdain crosses the divide between old and new, hanging out with, among others, professional wrestlers, civil rights activists, and author and native Pittsburgher Stewart ONan. The pioneering chefs of the new restaurant scene, Sonja Finn and Justin Severino, are roasting suckling pig out of town, and chef Kevin Sousa is serving up pasture-fed ribs at his new Superior Motors restaurant. R.: Jesse Sweet Ul.: Anthony Bourdain (Self - Host), John Fetterman (Self), Gisele Fetterman (Self), Franco Harris (Self), Britt Baker (Britt Baker)... / Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown - (S10, E04, znan. pop. serija, SAD, 2017) Bourdain zaranja u gastronomsku scenu na raskrižju: s jedne strane, prepoznatljivi grad čelika definiran radničkom hranom - odresci i krumpir, kobasice i kiseli kupus - a s druge, grad u usponu koji privlači gurmansku publiku zahvaljujući novoj visokotehnološkoj industriji. Bourdain prelazi razdjelnice starog i novog družeći se, među ostalima, s profesionalnim hrvačima, aktivistima za građanska prava te piscem i rođenim Pitsburžaninom Stewartom ONanom. Pionirski kuhari nove restoranske scene, Sonja Finn i Justin Severino, peku odojka izvan grada, a chef Kevin Sousa poslužuje rebarca od krava hranjenih na pašnjaku u svom novom restoranu Superior Motors. R.: Jesse Sweet Ul.: Anthony Bourdain (Self - Host), John Fetterman (Self), Gisele Fetterman (Self), Franco Harris (Self), Britt Baker (Britt Baker)...

programme.title: Clarkson's Farm / Clarksonova farma
programme.desc: Clarksons Farm - (S02, E07, nature film, England, 2023) Spring arrives on the farm and it's time to let the cows and chickens out of their winter quarters. Jeremy's plans to open a restaurant fell through, but that's not the end of his run-ins with the council, who persistently send him letters questioning what is being sold in his shop. Jeremy decides to look for loopholes in the future and resort to various tricks on the edge of the law. Jeremy's best heifer Pepper is not pregnant yet, her last chance is a bull called Heartbreaker. In a conversation with Alan, the builder, it dawned on Jeremy how to make his idea for a restaurant come to life. Everyone is excited about the construction work starting, and Jeremy meets the cook, Pip. But the excitement suddenly subsides when he has to take his first bull to the slaughterhouse. R.: Will Yapp Ul.: Gerald Cooper (Self - Head of Security), Kaleb Cooper (Self - Farmhand), Lisa Hogan (Self - Jeremys Girlfriend), Charlie Ireland (Self - Land Agent), Alan Townsend (Self - Builder)... / Clarksons Farm - (S02, E07, prirod. film, Engleska, 2023) Proljeće stiže na farmu i vrijeme je da puste krave i kokoši iz njihovih zimskih nastambi. Jeremyjevi su planovi o otvaranju restorana propali, no to nije kraj njegovim okapanjima s vijećem, koje mu uporno šalje dopise u kojima propituje ono što se prodaje u njegovoj trgovini. Jeremy odlučuje ubuduće tražiti rupe u zakonu i pribjegavati raznim lukavstvima na samom rubu zakona. Jeremyjeva najbolja junica Pepper još nije steona, njezina je posljednja šansa bik zvan Srcolomac. U razgovoru s graditeljem Alanom Jeremyju sine kako da njegova ideja o restoranu ipak zaživi. Svi su uzbuđeni zbog početka građevinskih radova, a Jeremy upoznaje kuharicu Pip. No uzbuđenje naglo splasne kad mora odvesti svog prvog junca u klaonicu. R.: Will Yapp Ul.: Gerald Cooper (Self - Head of Security), Kaleb Cooper (Self - Farmhand), Lisa Hogan (Self - Jeremys Girlfriend), Charlie Ireland (Self - Land Agent), Alan Townsend (Self - Builder)...

programme.title: Dalida, a woman who dreamed of a different stage / Dalida, žena koja je sanjala o drukčijoj pozornici
programme.desc: Dalida, la femme qui revait dune autre scène - (doc. film, France, 2015) Dalida's life was not a series of hits and gossip, but a Greek tragedy. On May 3, 1987, Dalida committed suicide at the age of 54. Just before her death, she hastily wrote a few words on a piece of paper: "I can't take this life anymore. Forgive me." Then she lay down on the bed and swallowed the pills that she had carefully prepared, with a glass of alcohol to enhance their effect. After that, she turned off the lamp on the bedside table and, unlike every other night, fell asleep without the light on. It was as if for the first time in her life she was no longer afraid of the dark. Throughout her career, she was considered the most successful music hall star, the most popular artist and singer with the most performances. Could Dalida have imagined then that her songs, as well as the story of her life, which became unbearable for her, would be so special that they would outlive her in 30 years, unlike most of her colleagues who fell into oblivion after their death? Her friend Line Renaud called her "flashy and dark" in the documentary by Gerard Miller and Anaïs Feuillette, where she appears with fifteen other guests (Orlando, Serge Lama, Bertrand Delanoe, Liza Azuelos, Jean Sobieski, David Lelait-Helo, and Rosy Gigliotti, Dalidina cousin and secretary). Line says that Dalida constantly doubted herself and her love and professional life, so she always considered herself incomplete. "Who could be bound to me forever, given my job?" she said in an interview. After singing in front of thousands of ecstatic spectators and thinking the crowd would choke her, she added: "Success is scary sometimes." The documentary film by Gerard Miller and Anaïs Feuillette tells about the extraordinary fate of a woman who became famous at 20, a world star at 30, and an icon at 40. It follows all the stages of Dalida's life and career and with a somewhat Freudian analysis explains the thoughts of a woman who always followed her desire. Director: Gerard Miller... / Dalida, la femme qui revait dune autre scène - (dok. film, Francuska, 2015) Život Dalide nije bio niz hitova i tračeva, nego grčka tragedija. Dana 3. svibnja 1987. Dalida se ubila u 54. godini. Netom prije smrti na brzinu je napisala na papirić nekoliko riječi: "Ne mogu više podnijeti ovaj život. Oprostite mi." Zatim je legla na krevet i progutala tablete koje je brižno pripremila, uz čašu alkohola koja im je pojačala učinak. Nakon toga ugasila je svjetiljku na noćnom ormariću i, za razliku od svih ostalih večeri, zaspala bez upaljenog svjetla. Kao da se prvi put u životu više nije bojala tame. Cijelu su je karijeru smatrali najuspješnijom zvijezdom music halla, najpopularnijom umjetnicom i pjevačicom s najviše nastupa. Je li Dalida tada mogla zamisliti da će njezine pjesme, ali i priča o njezinu životu, koji joj je postao nepodnošljiv, biti toliko posebne da će je nadživjeti za 30 godina, za razliku od većine njezinih kolega koji su nakon smrti pali u zaborav? Njezina prijateljica Line Renaud nazvala ju je "blještavom i mračnom" u dokumentarnom filmu Gerarda Millera i Anaïs Feuillette, gdje se pojavljuje uz petnaestak drugih gostiju (Orlanda, Sergea Lame, Bertranda Delanoea, Lizu Azuelos, Jeana Sobieskoga, Davida Lelait-Heloa, i Rosy Gigliotti, Dalidinu rođakinju i tajnicu). Line kaže da je Dalida neprestano sumnjala u sebe te svoj ljubavni i profesionalni život, pa se uvijek smatrala nepotpunom. "Tko bi se mogao zauvijek vezati za mene, s obzirom na moj posao?" rekla je u jednom intervjuu. Nakon što je pjevala pred tisućama zanesenih gledatelja i mislila da će je gomila ugušiti, nadodala je: "Uspjeh je katkad zastrašujuć." Dokumentarni film Gerarda Millera i Anaïs Feuillette govori o iznimnoj sudbini žene koja je s 20 godina postala poznata, s 30 svjetska zvijezda, a s 40 ikona. Slijedi sve etape Dalidina života i karijere i pomalo frojdovskom analizom objašnjava razmišljanja žene koja je uvijek slijedila svoju želju. R.: Gerard Miller...

programme.title: Grantchester / Grantchester
programme.desc: Grantchester - (S04, E01, drama series, England, 2019) The year is 1953. Sidney Chambers (James Norton) is the vicar of Grantchester, a village not far from Cambridge. Sidney leads a peaceful life, or at least he did - until he encountered a murder... Finding himself in the dangerous world of lies, betrayal and murder, Sidney soon realizes that his knowledge of the human psyche and the trust he instills in people enable him to perform his new detective work extremely skillfully. R.: Tim Fywell St.: James Norton (Sidney Chambers), Robson Green (Geordie Keating), Tom Brittney (Will Davenport), Al Weaver (Leonard Finch), Tessa Peake-Jones (Mrs. Chapman)... / Grantchester - (S04, E01, igrana serija, Engleska, 2019) Godina je 1953. Sidney Chambers (James Norton) je vikar u Grantchesteru, selu nedaleko od Cambridgea. Sidney vodi miran život, ili ga je barem vodio - sve dok nije naišao na ubojstvo... Zatekavši se u opasnom svijetu laži, izdaje i umorstva, Sidney ubrzo shvaća da mu poznavanje ljudske psihe te povjerenje koje ljudima ulijeva omogućavaju da iznimno vješto obavlja svoj novi detektivski posao. R.: Tim Fywell Ul.: James Norton (Sidney Chambers), Robson Green (Geordie Keating), Tom Brittney (Will Davenport), Al Weaver (Leonard Finch), Tessa Peake-Jones (Mrs. Chapman)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E01, Comedy, USA, 2021) After Murray's death, Adam, Barry and Erica return home to be with their mother. Adam postpones going to college and decides to pursue film, Barry is on his way to becoming a doctor, Erica and Geoff are becoming parents, and Beverly is preparing for the most important role in life - that of a grandmother! The new season brings a handful of exciting plots as family members try to navigate their new roles, and Uncle Marvin and Grandpa make an unexpected statement. --- Everyone lives together again, so the usual chaos reigns in the Goldberg house. Pregnant Erica asks Beverly to help her make room for the new baby, and Adam and Barry have to share a room so the baby can have its own. R.: Lew Schneider St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E01, komedija, SAD, 2021) Nakon Murrayeve smrti, Adam, Barry i Erica vraćaju se kući kako bi bili uz majku. Adam odgađa odlazak na studij i odlučuje se baviti filmom, Barry je na putu da postane liječnik, Erica i Geoff postaju roditelji, a Beverly se priprema za najvažniju ulogu u životu - onu bake! Nova sezona donosi pregršt uzbudljivih zapleta dok se članovi obitelji pokušavaju snaći u svojim novim ulogama, a stric Marvin i djed neočekivano se iskažu. --- Svi ponovno žive zajedno pa u kući Goldbergovih vlada uobičajeni kaos. Trudna Erica zamoli Beverly da joj pomogne napraviti mjesta za prinovu, a Adam i Barry moraju dijeliti sobu kako bi beba dobila svoju. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: Goldbergovi / Goldbergovi
programme.desc: The Goldbergs - (S10, E02, Comedy, USA, 2022) Once upon a time, not so long ago, 11-year-old Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) used his parents' video camera to document life on the outskirts of the 1980s. He has his hands full, starting with well-meaning but stifling mom Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), to temperamental dad Murray (Jeff Garlin), to rebellious older sister Erica (Hayley Orrantia) and hypersensitive brother Barry (Troy Gentile). And then there is the unbelted grandfather (George Segal), a seducer, who is Adam's mentor when there are better things in life. Driving lessons, first jobs, college applications, and making new friends without losing old ones are all part of the Goldberg family saga. Some leave their childhood behind in search of their first kiss, others struggle with raising teenagers or, faced with aging, recall youthful passions - the Goldberg family will experience it all. For better or for worse, they are always there for each other. R.: Lew Schneider St.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)... / The Goldbergs - (S10, E02, komedija, SAD, 2022) Jednom ne tako davno i ne tako daleko 11-godišnji Adam Goldberg (Sean Giambrone) video-kamerom svojih roditelja dokumentira život na periferiji 1980-ih godina. Ima pune ruke posla, počevši od mame Beverly (Wendi McLendon-Covey), koja je dobronamjerna, ali ga guši, preko temperamentnog tate Murrayja (Jeff Garlin), do buntovne starije sestre Erice (Hayley Orrantia) i hipersenzibilnog brata Barryja (Troy Gentile). A tu je i raspojasani djed (George Segal), zavodnik, koji je Adamu mentor kad su posrijedi ljepše stvari u životu. Satovi vožnje, prvi poslovi, prijave za fakultet i stjecanje novih prijatelja, a da se pritom ne izgube stari, sve je to dio sage o obitelji Goldberg. Neki ostavljaju djetinjstvo iza sebe u potrazi za prvim poljupcem, drugi pak muku muče s odgojem tinejdžera ili se, suočeni sa starenjem, prisjećaju mladenačkih strasti - obitelj Goldberg iskusit će sve to. I u dobru i u zlu, oni su uvijek tu jedni za druge. R.: Lew Schneider Ul.: Wendi McLendon-Covey (Beverly Goldberg), Sean Giambrone (Adam Goldberg), Troy Gentile (Barry Goldberg), Hayley Orrantia (Erica Goldberg), Sam Lerner (Geoff Schwartz)...

programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: The world of classics - (music show, Croatia, 2025) Leonard Bernstein's musical directed by Leo Mujić, June 14, 2025, HNK Ivan pl. Zajca Rijeka. At the end of the 2024/2025 season, on June 14, 2025, Leonard Bernstein's musical West Side Story from 1957 premiered in Rijeka, for the first time in the Croatian language, with Borivoj Radaković's cover. The idea came from the intendant Dubravka Vrgoč and the director of the opera, the conductor Valentin Egel, that in the end of the season, all the ensembles of the Croatian National Theater Ivan pl. Zajca with guest soloists. The direction was entrusted to a favorite choreographer with experience in Zagreb's Komedija successes, Leo Mujić, who once again hired his colleague Balint Rauscher for the dramatization, and Stefan Katunar for the set designer. From the many roles that are intertwined among the permanent employees of the ensembles, as well as external collaborators selected at the audition, here we meet pop stars such as Damir Kedža (Toni) and Franka Batelić Ćorluka (Anita), and some new young faces such as Katarina Margaretić (Maria), Ivan Čuić (Bernardo), Devin Juraj (Riff), Dorian Stipčić (Diesel) and Deni Sanković (Chino). From the diverse profile of Rijeka's theater artists, we definitely single out the ballerina Tea Rušin as the seductress Velma and the Italian drama actress Elena Brumini in the role of the temperamental boy Anybody. All together, it makes an excellent show, the highlights of which are presented in a half-hour reportage, but which must be seen live for a complete first-hand experience... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Mjuzikl Leonarda Bernsteina u režiji Lea Mujića, 14. lipnja 2025., HNK Ivana pl. Zajca Rijeka. Krajem sezone 2024./2025., 14. lipnja 2025., u Rijeci je premijerno uprizoren mjuzikl Priča sa Zapadne strane Leonarda Bernsteina iz 1957., prvi put na hrvatskom jeziku, u prepjevu Borivoja Radakovića. Ideja je potekla od intendantice Dubravke Vrgoč i direktora opere, dirigenta Valentina Egela, ne bi li se u završnici sezone u stvaranju popularnog naslova povezali svi ansambli Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta Ivana pl. Zajca uz gostujuće soliste. Režija je povjerena omiljenom koreografu s iskustvom zagrebačkih Komedijinih uspješnica, Leu Mujiću, koji je za dramatizaciju ponovno angažirao kolegu Balinta Rauschera, a za scenografa Stefana Katunara. Od mnoštva uloga koje se isprepleću među stalno zaposlenima u ansamblima, ali i vanjskih suradnika probranih na audiciji, ovdje susrećemo estradne zvijezde poput Damira Kedže (Toni) i Franke Batelić Ćorluke (Anita), te neka nova mlada lica kao što su Katarina Margaretić (Maria), Ivan Čuić (Bernardo), Devin Juraj (Riff), Dorian Stipčić (Diesel) i Deni Sanković (Chino). Iz raznolikog profila umjetnika riječkoga kazališta svakako izdvajamo balerinu Teu Rušin kao zavodnicu Velmu i glumicu Talijanske drame Elenu Brumini u ulozi temperamentnog dječaka Anybodyja. Sve skupa čini vrsnu predstavu čije vrhunce donosimo u polusatnoj reportaži, ali koja se za potpuni doživljaj iz prve ruke ipak mora pogledati uživo...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: The world of jazz - (music show, Croatia, 2025) If it is true that nowadays it is increasingly difficult, in terms of style, to answer the question "What is jazz?", that is not a reason for concern. On the contrary - jazz should first of all be music that is constantly being redefined, which is perhaps best embodied by Miles Davis: music that slips away from you the next moment just when you thought you had caught it by the tail. More than a style, jazz is - at least in theory - an open house, where everyone is welcome. How long they stay in it, as musicians or listeners, depends on their openness to the unpredictable, especially that which arises from spontaneous interaction. In this sense, although it is sometimes perceived as narrow and exclusive, jazz is actually the music of a live encounter and collective experience - either in joint music-making, or in front of an audience. The Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival is based on this idea, which combines a high-level music camp and a concert program in a special way. Workshops, get-togethers and masterclasses with mentors are held during the day, while the evenings are dedicated to public performances by distinguished guests and jam sessions in which all participants, through mutual musicianship, fuse different musical traditions and influences. The third edition of the festival, held from August 28 to 30, fully immersed in the atmosphere of the island, continued to build on the great foundations laid by vocalist Thana Alexa and Ponta Lopud Creative Platform Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. The concert program and mentoring team consisted of saxophonist Ben Wendel and vocalists Sofia Rey and Michael Mayo, together with members of their supporting ensembles. They conducted workshops, lectures and talks with a selected group of musicians from all over the world, including those from Croatia. Terri Lyne Carrington, multi-awarded drummer and Grammy winner, presided over the entire program as the main mentor and master of the festival... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Ako je točno da je danas sve teže, u stilskom smislu, odgovoriti na pitanje "Što je jazz?", to nije razlog za zabrinutost. Naprotiv - jazz bi prije svega trebao biti glazba koja se neprestano redefinira, što je možda najbolje utjelovio Miles Davis: glazba koja vam u sljedećem trenutku izmakne baš kad ste pomislili da ste je uhvatili za rep. Više od stila, jazz je - barem u teoriji - kuća otvorenih vrata, u koju su svi dobrodošli. Koliko će se u njoj zadržati, kao glazbenici ili slušatelji, ovisi o njihovoj otvorenosti prema nepredvidivom, osobito onom koje proizlazi iz spontane interakcije. U tom je smislu, premda ga se katkad doživljava zakučastim i isključivim, jazz zapravo glazba živog susreta i kolektivnog iskustva - bilo u zajedničkom muziciranju, bilo pred publikom. Na toj ideji temelji se i Ponta Lopud Jazz Festival, koji na poseban način spaja glazbeni kamp visoke razine i koncertni program. Tijekom dana održavaju se radionice, druženja i masterclassovi s mentorima, dok su večeri posvećene javnim nastupima uglednih gostiju i jam sessionima u kojima svi sudionici, kroz međusobno muziciranje, stapaju različite glazbene tradicije i utjecaje. Treće izdanje festivala, održano od 28. do 30. kolovoza, u potpunosti uronjeno u atmosferu otoka, nastavilo je graditi sjajne temelje koje su postavili vokalistica Thana Alexa i Kreativna platforma Ponta Lopud Tilde Grossel Bogdanović. Koncertni program i mentorski tim činili su saksofonist Ben Wendel te vokalisti Sofia Rey i Michael Mayo, zajedno s članovima svojih pratećih sastava. Vodili su radionice, predavanja i razgovore s odabranom skupinom glazbenika iz cijelog svijeta, uključujući i one iz Hrvatske. Cijelim je programom, kao glavna mentorica i master festivala, predsjedala Terri Lyne Carrington, višestruko nagrađivana bubnjarka i dobitnica Grammyja...

programme.title: Detained upon arrival / Zadržani nakon dolaska
programme.desc: Upon Entry - (drama, Spain, 2022) Diego, an urban planner from Venezuela, and his partner Elena, a dancer from Barcelona, ​​arrive in the USA to start a new life. However, at the immigration department of the airport, they are separated into a room for additional examination. A seemingly routine control turns into a grueling interrogation that exposes their secrets and puts their relationship to the test. Director: Alejandro Rojas Street: Alberto Ammann (Diego), Bruna Cusí (Elena), Ben Temple (Agent Barrett), Laura Gomez (Agent Vásquez), Johann Perez Viera (Sr. Bachir)... / Upon Entry - (drama, Španjolska, 2022) Diego, urbanist iz Venezuele, i njegova partnerica Elena, plesačica iz Barcelone, stižu u SAD kako bi započeli novi život. No, na imigracijskom odjelu zračne luke izdvajaju ih u prostoriju za dodatno ispitivanje. Naizgled rutinska kontrola pretvara se u iscrpljujuće ispitivanje koje razotkriva njihove tajne i stavlja na kušnju njihov odnos. R.: Alejandro Rojas Ul.: Alberto Ammann (Diego), Bruna Cusí (Elena), Ben Temple (Agent Barrett), Laura Gomez (Agent Vásquez), Johann Perez Viera (Sr. Bachir)...

programme.title: Split Blues Festival / Split Blues Festival
programme.desc: Split Blues Festival - (E02, entertainment program, Croatia, 2021) As part of the 11th Split Blues Festival, all-night concerts were held by Croatian bluesers from the homeland and diaspora. Thus, on the same stage in Split's Đardin, Croatian blues performers from Amsterdam, Bologna, London, Paris, but also from Velika Gorica, Zabok, Sisak, Split, Rogoznica, Lepoglava, Čiovo, Zagreb, Hvar, Solin, Veliko Trgovišće... Performed: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco and Southern Cooking and Charlie and Bell Blues Experience, who are this year's winners of the Croatian Blues Challenge and representatives of Croatia at the world blues competition in Memphis. Director: Ivana Radić... / Split Blues Festival - (E02, zabavni program, Hrvatska, 2021) U sklopu 11. Split Blues Festivala cjelovečernje koncerte održali su hrvatski blueseri iz domovine i dijaspore. Tako su na istoj pozornici u splitskom Đardinu prodefilirali hrvatski izvođači bluesa iz Amsterdama, Bologne, Londona, Pariza, ali i iz Velike Gorice, Zaboka, Siska, Splita, Rogoznice, Lepoglave, Čiova, Zagreba, Hvara, Solina, Velikog Trgovišća... Nastupili su: Tony Lee King, Tomislav Goluban, Harpoon Blues Band, Francesco and Southern Cooking te Charlie and Bell Blues Experience koji su ovogodišnji pobjednici Croatian Blues Challengea i predstavnici Hrvatske na svjetskom blues natjecanju u Memphisu. R.: Ivana Radić...

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: I'm telling you a story - (E03, doc. series, Croatia, 2015) The film "About people and stories" from the series "I'm telling you a story" is a very personal "story about a story" by director Mladen Santrić, and the latest work by R.: Mladen Santrić... / Pričam ti priču - (E03, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2015) Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad R.: Mladen Santrić...

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: Kako se kaže - (E16, show magazine, Croatia, 2025) The Education and Science Department of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language tips, other interesting things from the Croatian language are covered, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. The show was realized by Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković and Viktor Nenadić and Branimira Volf with the support of colleagues from the Web Department of HRT Iva Hren and Matka Švarca and Tomislav Mršić and Maja Fishter... / Kako se kaže - (E16, show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec. Emisiju su realizirali Danijela Ivančević, Ana Radmilović, Robert Cecelja, Alan Stanković i Viktor Nenadić i Branimira Volf uz potporu kolega iz Odjela Web HRT-a Ive Hren i Matka Švarca te Tomislava Mršića i Maje Fišter...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound Collector - (E43, feature series, Croatia) Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he has very poor hearing. This little being spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are most often the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle... / Skupljač zvukova - (E43, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S07, E24, animated series, USA, 2021) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Madison Abbott (Gasket), Julian Crispo (Hubcap), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Tristan Mammitzsch (Wild Cat)... / PAW Patrol - (S07, E24, anim. serija, SAD, 2021) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Madison Abbott (Gasket), Julian Crispo (Hubcap), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Tristan Mammitzsch (Wild Cat)...

programme.title: Time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy Time - (S01, E21, animated series, England, 2009) An animated British children's series follows the adventures of a little troubled lamb and his friends. Timmy goes to kindergarten in the hills where teacher Harriet and teacher Osbourne teach him how to be a good friend and how to share with friends. In addition, it is important that students accept their mistakes and learn something from them. Join Timmy and his friends - Yabba the duck, Paxton the pig and Mittens the kitten as they sing, play and laugh. Director: Jackie Cockle... / Timmy Time - (S01, E21, anim. serija, Engleska, 2009) Animirana britanska dječja serija prati avanture malog problematičnog janjeta i njegovih prijatelja. Timmy ide u vrtić u brdima gdje ga učiteljica Harriet i učitelj Osbourne uče kako da bude dobar prijatelj te kako s prijateljima treba dijeliti. Osim toga važno je da učenici prihvaćaju svoje pogreške i na njima nešto nauče. Pridružite se Timmyju i njegovim prijateljima - patki Yabbi, praščiću Paxtonu i mačiću Mittensu u njihovoj pjesmi, igri i smijehu. R.: Jackie Cockle...

programme.title: Kreki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki - (children's program, Croatia, 2023) Krceki are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game are also waiting for you!... / Krceki - (dječji program, Hrvatska, 2023) Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!...

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Krceki - song - (E26, children's program, Croatia, 2023) In addition to the animated series Krceki, we also get seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramezljlko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja - Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić... / Krceki - pjesmica - (E26, dječji program, Hrvatska, 2023) Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja - Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić...

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: I love ZOO animals - (E03, nature film, Croatia) In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he gets a special task that he cannot complete if he does not learn something about the daily activities in the zoo - feeding, cleaning and arranging the housing, playing, training or treating the animals. In this episode, Marko was given the task of making a house for a milk snake. Before starting the task, you need to find out how to adapt the spaces where the animals stay to their needs... / Volim životinje ZOO - (E03, prirod. film, Hrvatska) U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu - prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju,treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U ovoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti nastambu za mliječnu zmiju. Prije nego što krene na zadatak, treba doznati kako prostore u kojima borave životinje prilagoditi njihovim potrebama...

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E04, cartoon series, Ireland, 2023) Lu is a little ladybug who has just started preschool with her new friends, and is entering a completely new social life. This animated dramedy for preschoolers takes place in Bubingrad, a small village that is home to a community of bugs. Lu's teacher Mila is a snail, and Lu goes to school in a house on her back. Lu and her new friends, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica and Maks, build their first friendships and at the same time learn social skills in order to navigate them! The series explores the fun, drama and mishaps that come from the lives of preschoolers. Filled with music, humor and heart, Lu and the merry band celebrate their friendships. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Knihomolka Betty), Alice Helenport (Elodie and Silkworm), Kolby McDonald (Gus)... / Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E04, crt. serija, Irska, 2023) Lu je mala bubamara koja je upravo krenula u predškolu sa svojim novim prijateljima, te ulazi u sasvim novi društveni život. Ova animirana dramedija za predškolarce događa se u Bubingradu, malom selu koje je dom zajednici buba. Luina učiteljica Mila je puž, te Lu odlazi u školu u kućici na njezinim leđima. Lu i njezini novi prijatelji, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica i Maks, grade svoja prva prijateljstva te usto uče društvene vještine kako bi se u njima snašli! Serija istražuje zabavu, dramu i nezgode koje proizlaze iz života predškolaraca. Ispunjeni glazbom, humorom i srcem, Lu i vesela družina slave svoja prijateljstva. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Knihomolka Betty), Alice Helenport (Elodie and Silkworm), Kolby McDonald (Gus)...

programme.title: Pocoyo / Pocoyo
programme.desc: Pocoyo - (S04, E52, animated series, Spain) Pocoyo is a curious toddler dressed in blue from head to toe, prone to jokes and petty mischief. The series follows the fun adventures of Pocoy and his friends, and each episode deals with a different theme. Cheerful sociables explore the world and learn new words and concepts through play. And he's having a good time along the way. The fourth season introduces us to the new character Nina and her pet robot Robert. Street: Stephen Fry (Narrator), Alex Marty (Pocoyo)... / Pocoyo - (S04, E52, anim. serija, Španjolska) Pocoyo je radoznali mališan odjeven u plavo od glave do pete, sklon šali i sitnim nestašlucima. Serija prati zabavne pustolovine Pocoya i njegovih prijatelja, a svaka se epizoda bavi drugom temom. Veselo društvance kroz igru istražuje svijet i uči nove riječi i pojmove. I usput se dobro zabavlja. Četvrta sezona upoznaje nas s novim likom Ninom i njezinim kućnim ljubimcem robotom Robertom. Ul.: Stephen Fry (Narrator), Alex Marty (Pocoyo)...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E42, Drama, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E42, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E03, feature series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E03, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu - (S01, E07, cartoon series, Croatia, 2020) A cheerful society in which the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško live in a village where travelers from different countries arrive. This time they are approached by an unusual surfer who was once afraid of water and therefore could not learn to swim. See how this surfer taught Hu Hu to overcome his fear of water and learn to swim. Director: Vjekoslav Živković... / Hu Hu - (S01, E07, crt. serija, Hrvatska, 2020) Veselo društvo u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško živi na selu u koje stižu putnici iz različitih zemalja. Ovaj put k njima stiže neobični surfer koji se nekoć bojao vode i zato nije mogao naučiti plivati. Pogledajte kako je taj surfer naučio Hu Hua da prevlada strah od vode i nauči plivati. R.: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Hu Hu song / Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu song - (children's program, Croatia, 2020) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. In the series, we follow the adventures of a happy society in which the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško... / Hu Hu pjesmica - (dječji program, Hrvatska, 2020) Hu Hu je animirana serija u 10 nastavaka. U seriji pratimo dogodovštine veselog društva u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško...

programme.title: Oggy Oggy / Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy - (S01, E12, feature series, France, 2021) Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri, The series follows Oggy the kitten who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys... / Oggy Oggy - (S01, E12, igrana serija, Francuska, 2021) Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E18, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E18, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E38, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E38, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E10, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E10, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E25, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. R.: Goh Hong Wei Alex Street: Marlon Dance-Hooi (Captain Redbeard / Farmer Haywire)... / 123 Number Squad - (E25, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123. R.: Goh Hong Wei Alex Ul.: Marlon Dance-Hooi (Captain Redbeard / Farmer Haywire)...

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Pjesmica Crvena - (children's program, Croatia) Crvena We will go on a winter walk and learn about the magic of the color red... / Pjesmica Crvena - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje...

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: Love Monster - (E44, cartoon series, England, 2020) Follow the unforgettable adventures of this little monster who lives in a town full of cute little animals. The love monster may not look like the others, but despite that, his friends love him and go on crazy adventures with him. R.: Rufus Blacklock Ul.: Darren Foreman (Love Monster), Tamsin Greig (Narrator), Javone Prince (Bad Idea Puppy), Sarah Hadland (Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny)... / Love Monster - (E44, crt. serija, Engleska, 2020) Pratite nezaboravne avanture ovog malenog čudovišta koje živi u gradu prepunom mali slatkih životinjica. Ljubavno čudovište možda ne izgleda kao ostali, ali usprkos tome njegovi ga prijatelji vole i odlaze s njim na lude pustolovine. R.: Rufus Blacklock Ul.: Darren Foreman (Love Monster), Tamsin Greig (Narrator), Javone Prince (Bad Idea Puppy), Sarah Hadland (Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny)...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob - (E30, feature series, England) In the children's series Bitz and Bob, we follow the adventures of the girl inventor Bitz and her younger brother Bob. She embodies the new strong girl and is fascinated by all innovative things and activities related to science, technology, art and mathematics. The goal of this series is to encourage girls and boys to do their own research, to be ambitious and to come up with different ways to solve any problem. Director: Kitty Taylor Street: Rob Delaney (Bevel), Duke Davis (Bob)... / Bitz and Bob - (E30, igrana serija, Engleska) U dječjoj seriji Bitz i Bob pratimo dogodovštine djevojčice izumiteljice Bitz i njezinog mlađeg brata Boba. Ona utjelovljuje novu snažnu djevojku i fasciniraju je sve inovativne stvari i aktivnosti vezane za znanost, tehnologiju, umjetnost i matematiku. Cilj ove serije je poticanje djevojčica i dječaka da sami istražuju, da budu ambiciozni i osmišljavaju razne načine s ciljem da riješe bilo koji problem. R.: Kitty Taylor Ul.: Rob Delaney (Bevel), Duke Davis (Bob)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E23, Drama, Canada, 2022) Blitz shows Vrck how to round up the dinosaurs, but the little dino is overexcited and keeps scaring them instead of guiding them. When the Dinoranchers discover that some parasaurs are lost in the High Forest, Vrcko can't wait to help and secretly sneaks in on their mission. When the Dinoranchers discover the hidden Vrcko, they tell him not to follow them, but Jon accidentally drops his dino whistle as he leaves, and Vrcko runs back into the forest to get it back. Deep in the misty forest, Vrcko finds Jon and returns his whistle so he can summon the parasaurs. When the moment comes to chase them back home, Jon and Blitz patiently let Vrck help them and see that the dinic has finally learned how not to scare the dinosaurs. All the Dinoranchers are glad they gave Vrck a second chance, because it turns out he just needed a little more practice. R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E23, igrana serija, Kanada, 2022) Blitz pokazuje Vrcku kako okupiti dinosaure, ali mali dinosaur je preuzbuđen i neprestano ih plaši umjesto da ih usmjerava. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju da su se neki parasauri izgubili u Visokoj šumi, Vrcko jedva čeka pomoći i potajno se ušulja na njihov zadatak. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju skrivenog Vrcka, kažu mu da ne ide za njima, no Jon pri odlasku slučajno ispusti svoju dinozviždaljku, a Vrcko potrči natrag u šumu kako bi mu je vratio. Duboko u maglovitoj šumi, Vrcko pronalazi Jona i vraća mu zviždaljku kako bi mogao dozvati parasaure. Kad dođe trenutak da ih potjeraju natrag kući, Jon i Blitz strpljivo dopuste Vrcku da im pomogne i vide da je dinić napokon naučio kako ne uplašiti dinosaure. Svi Dinorančeri raduju se što su Vrcku dali drugu priliku, jer se ispostavilo da mu je trebalo samo malo više vježbe. R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: The Furchester Hotel - (S01, E52, Drama, England) Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (a BBC pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel... / The Furchester Hotel - (S01, E52, igrana serija, Engleska) Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela...

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: The song "I'll do it all alone" - (children's program, Croatia) In the humorous song "I'll do it all alone" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own - without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message - that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan... / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami - bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku - da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan...

programme.title: Mechanical assistants / Mehapomagači
programme.desc: Sesame Workshops Mecha Builders - (S01, E52, TV series, USA, 2022) Mecha Elmo, Mecha Keksomlat and Mecha Abby are robot superheroes who are just learning to be, ready to solve the problem in the most unlikely situations. Using their signature mechanized robotic skills, the Mechamages come to the rescue - but it might take them a few tries before they save the day!... / Sesame Workshops Mecha Builders - (S01, E52, igrana serija, SAD, 2022) Meha Elmo, Meha Keksomlat i Meha Abby su robotski superheroji koji tek uče to biti, spremni riješiti problem u najnevjerojatnijim situacijama. Koristeći sebi svojstvene mehanizirane robotske vještine, Mehapomagači stižu u pomoć - no, moglo bi im trebati nekoliko pokušaja prije nego što spase stvar!...

programme.title: Topsy i Tim / Topsy i Tim
programme.desc: Topsy and Tim - (S01, E20, Children's Programme, England) Based on the books by Jean and Gareth Adamson, this British children's series follows the lives of twins, a brother and sister, who enjoy the wonders of childhood by playing and learning about the world. In each episode, we see them in everyday life situations, like playing hide and seek with friends, buying new jeans with mom or getting a new pet. St.: Joshua Lester (Tim), Jocelyn Macnab (Topsy)... / Topsy and Tim - (S01, E20, dječji program, Engleska) Ova britanska dječja serija temelji se na knjigama Jeana i Garetha Adamsona, a prati život blizanaca, brata i sestre koji uživaju u čudima djetinjstva igrajući se i učeći o svijetu. U svakoj ih epizodi vidimo u svakodnevnim životnim situacijama, poput igranja skrivača s prijateljima, kupnje novih traperica s mamom ili nabavke novog kućnog ljubimca. Ul.: Joshua Lester (Tim), Jocelyn Macnab (Topsy)...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E42, Drama, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E42, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E03, feature series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E03, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Huh Huh / Hu Hu
programme.desc: Hu Hu - (S01, E07, cartoon series, Croatia, 2020) A cheerful society in which the owl Hu Hu, the hedgehog Bocko and the rabbit Duško live in a village where travelers from different countries arrive. This time they are approached by an unusual surfer who was once afraid of water and therefore could not learn to swim. See how this surfer taught Hu Hu to overcome his fear of water and learn to swim. Director: Vjekoslav Živković... / Hu Hu - (S01, E07, crt. serija, Hrvatska, 2020) Veselo društvo u kojem su sovica Hu Hu, jež Bocko i zec Duško živi na selu u koje stižu putnici iz različitih zemalja. Ovaj put k njima stiže neobični surfer koji se nekoć bojao vode i zato nije mogao naučiti plivati. Pogledajte kako je taj surfer naučio Hu Hua da prevlada strah od vode i nauči plivati. R.: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Hu Hu song / Hu Hu pjesmica
programme.desc: Hu Hu song - (children's program, Croatia, 2020) Hu Hu is an animated series in 10 episodes. programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...
