Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123. R.: Goh Hong Wei Alex Ul.: Marlon Dance-Hooi (Captain Redbeard / Farmer Haywire)...

programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo - (E49, feature series, England, 2018) The award-winning children's series "Pablo" was shot in 2D animation combined with feature parts. The main character, Pablo, is an artistically gifted five-year-old boy on the autism spectrum. His imaginative drawings come to life and allow him to face the real world with more confidence. With magic crayons, he bravely transforms his life challenges into fantastic adventures, and his feelings into picturesque, talking characters. With the help of his friends from the world of his drawings - Ljam, Noasaur, Misha, Rafi, Tango and Palča - Pablo understands his real world as a five-year-old more easily. "Pablo" pays tribute to individuality and thinking in a different way, as the first children's series in the world with an autistic main character. Each story depicts the real-life experiences of children with autism, who participated in creating the stories and writing the screenplay. Director: David McGrath Street: Callum Janes (Sanjay), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama)... / Pablo - (E49, igrana serija, Engleska, 2018) Nagrađivana serija za djecu "Pablo" snimljena je 2D animacijom u kombinaciji s igranim dijelovima. Glavni lik, Pablo, umjetnički je nadaren petogodišnji dječak u spektru autizma. Njegovi maštoviti crteži oživljavaju i omogućuju mu da se s više pouzdanja suočava sa stvarnim svijetom. Čarobnim bojicama on svoje životne izazove hrabro pretvara u fantastične pustolovine, a osjećaje u slikovite likove koji govore. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz svijeta svojih crteža - Ljamu, Noasaura, Mišu, Rafija, Tanga i Palči - Pablo lakše poima svoj stvarni svijet petogodišnjaka. "Pablo" odaje počast individualnosti i razmišljanju na drukčiji način, kao prva dječja serija na svijetu s autističnim glavnim likom. Svaka priča oslikava stvarna životna iskustva djece s autizmom, koja su sudjelovala u osmišljavanju priča i pisanju scenarija. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Callum Janes (Sanjay), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama)...

programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz and Bob - (E30, feature series, England) In the children's series Bitz and Bob, we follow the adventures of the girl inventor Bitz and her younger brother Bob. She embodies the new strong girl and is fascinated by all innovative things and activities related to science, technology, art and mathematics. The goal of this series is to encourage girls and boys to do their own research, to be ambitious and to come up with different ways to solve any problem. Director: Kitty Taylor Street: Rob Delaney (Bevel), Duke Davis (Bob)... / Bitz and Bob - (E30, igrana serija, Engleska) U dječjoj seriji Bitz i Bob pratimo dogodovštine djevojčice izumiteljice Bitz i njezinog mlađeg brata Boba. Ona utjelovljuje novu snažnu djevojku i fasciniraju je sve inovativne stvari i aktivnosti vezane za znanost, tehnologiju, umjetnost i matematiku. Cilj ove serije je poticanje djevojčica i dječaka da sami istražuju, da budu ambiciozni i osmišljavaju razne načine s ciljem da riješe bilo koji problem. R.: Kitty Taylor Ul.: Rob Delaney (Bevel), Duke Davis (Bob)...

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: The song "I'll do it all alone" - (children's program, Croatia) In the humorous song "I'll do it all alone" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own - without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message - that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! Music and lyrics: Andrija Vujević Singers: Juhuhuovci and Vojko V Director and animator: Marija Ivšić Editor: Ana Macan... / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami - bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku - da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju! Glazba i stihovi: Andrija Vujević Pjevaju: Juhuhuovci i Vojko V Redatelj i animator: Marija Ivšić Urednica: Ana Macan...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Edmond i Luce / Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Edmond et Lucy - (E28, feature series, France, 2023) Winter has come a little early and Mima has not finished all her preparations for the winter and snow season. Edmund and Luce do their best to help her. In the process, they discover how nature is preparing for a long cold winter. Director: François Narboux Street: Emmylou Homs (Edmond), Lisa Caruso (Lucy)... / Edmond et Lucy - (E28, igrana serija, Francuska, 2023) Zima je malo uranila i Mima nije završila sve svoje pripreme za doba zime i snijega. Edmund i Luce daju sve od sebe kako bi joj pomogli. Tijekom toga, oni otkrivaju kako se priroda priprema za dugu hladnu zimu. R.: François Narboux Ul.: Emmylou Homs (Edmond), Lisa Caruso (Lucy)...

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E17, Drama, France) Grizzly Bear and the Lemmings is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the lemmings, who live in the forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. The ranger's log cabin is the only trace of human civilization amidst the untamed wilderness of Canada's great nature reserve. As the ranger escapes, the grizzly bear claims her, because after all, bears are at the top of the food chain. After moving into the house, Grizzly enjoys all the benefits of a modern way of living - a comfortable bed, an air-conditioned space and a fully equipped kitchen. But he is not alone. A group of small creatures, lemmings, also move into it. Since Grizzlies and lemmings are not civilized enough for a peaceful coexistence, they try to outwit each other with various tricks and complete madness reigns in the house. Street: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)... / Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E17, igrana serija, Francuska) "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti - leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan. Rendžerova brvnara jedini je trag ljudske civilizacije usred neukroćene divljine velikog kanadskog rezervata prirode. Dok rendžer izbiva, medvjed Grizli je prisvaja, jer ipak su medvjedi na vrhu hranidbenog lanca. Nakon što se useli u kuću, Grizli uživa u svim blagodatima suvremenog načina stanovanja - udobnom ležaju, klimatiziranom prostoru i potpuno opremljenoj kuhinji. No nije sam. U nju se useljava i skupina malih stvorenja, leminga. Budući da Grizli i leminzi nisu dovoljno civilizirani za miran suživot, nastoje raznoraznim trikovima nadmudriti jedni druge te kućom zavlada potpuno ludilo. Ul.: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E23, Drama, Canada, 2022) Blitz shows Vrck how to round up the dinosaurs, but the little dino is overexcited and keeps scaring them instead of guiding them. When the Dinoranchers discover that some parasaurs are lost in the High Forest, Vrcko can't wait to help and secretly sneaks in on their mission. When the Dinoranchers discover the hidden Vrcko, they tell him not to follow them, but Jon accidentally drops his dino whistle as he leaves, and Vrcko runs back into the forest to get it back. Deep in the misty forest, Vrcko finds Jon and returns his whistle so he can summon the parasaurs. When the moment comes to chase them back home, Jon and Blitz patiently let Vrck help them and see that the dinic has finally learned how not to scare the dinosaurs. All the Dinoranchers are glad they gave Vrck a second chance, because it turns out he just needed a little more practice. R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E23, igrana serija, Kanada, 2022) Blitz pokazuje Vrcku kako okupiti dinosaure, ali mali dinosaur je preuzbuđen i neprestano ih plaši umjesto da ih usmjerava. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju da su se neki parasauri izgubili u Visokoj šumi, Vrcko jedva čeka pomoći i potajno se ušulja na njihov zadatak. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju skrivenog Vrcka, kažu mu da ne ide za njima, no Jon pri odlasku slučajno ispusti svoju dinozviždaljku, a Vrcko potrči natrag u šumu kako bi mu je vratio. Duboko u maglovitoj šumi, Vrcko pronalazi Jona i vraća mu zviždaljku kako bi mogao dozvati parasaure. Kad dođe trenutak da ih potjeraju natrag kući, Jon i Blitz strpljivo dopuste Vrcku da im pomogne i vide da je dinić napokon naučio kako ne uplašiti dinosaure. Svi Dinorančeri raduju se što su Vrcku dali drugu priliku, jer se ispostavilo da mu je trebalo samo malo više vježbe. R.: Trevor Deane-Freeman Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S07, E24, animated series, USA, 2021) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Madison Abbott (Gasket), Julian Crispo (Hubcap), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Tristan Mammitzsch (Wild Cat)... / PAW Patrol - (S07, E24, anim. serija, SAD, 2021) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Madison Abbott (Gasket), Julian Crispo (Hubcap), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Tristan Mammitzsch (Wild Cat)...

programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Pancake song - (children's program, Croatia) Sing and dance to the new Pancake song. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković... / Pjesmica Palačinke - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica
programme.desc: The Worst Witch - (S03, E08, children's program, England) Mildred Hubble lives with her mother and leads a somewhat simple and rather ordinary life. Until one day he gets an unexpected visit from a witch named Maud Spellbody. She introduces her to the world of magic. Nothing has been the same for Mildred since that day, and after joining the Cackle School for Witches, she strives to improve her knowledge and skills... / The Worst Witch - (S03, E08, dječji program, Engleska) Mildred Hubble živi s majkom i vodi pomalo jednostavan i prilično uobičajen život. Sve dok jednog dana ne doživi neočekivani posjet od vještice po imenu Maud Spellbody. Ona je upoznaje sa svijetom čaranja. Od tog dana za Mildred ništa nije isto, a nakon pridruživanja školi za vještice Cackle, trudi se poboljšati svoje znanje i vještine...

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: Kako se kaže - (E17, show magazine, Croatia, 2025) The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language tips, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Institute for the Croatian Language: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec... / Kako se kaže - (E17, show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec...

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: I'm telling you a story - (E03, doc. series, Croatia, 2015) The film "About people and stories" from the series "I'm telling you a story" is a very personal "story about a story" by director Mladen Santrić, and the last work of cinematographer Radovan Sredić. Inspired by the speech of the Nobel laureate Ivo Andrić, the author of the film sets out in search of the fate of the story today. Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras and Drago Grgić - Godra lead us through the literary, filmic, artistic and musical aspects of their "stories". Although they are generations apart, they all have in common that they do not live on stories, but they could not live without them. R.: Mladen Santric... / Pričam ti priču - (E03, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2015) Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad snimatelja Radovana Sredića. Inspiriran govorom nobelovca Ive Andrića, autor filma kreće u potragu za sudbinom priče danas. Kroz književne, filmske, likovne i glazbene aspekte njihovih "priča" vode nas Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras i Drago Grgić - Godra. Iako generacijski udaljeni, svima je zajedničko da ne žive od priča, ali bez njih ne bi mogli živjeti. R.: Mladen Santrić...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: Touch of evil / Dodir zla
programme.desc: Touch of Evil - (drama, USA, 1958) High-ranking Mexican government official Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) enjoys his honeymoon with his American wife Susan (J. Leigh). Their kiss in a small town on the US-Mexico border is interrupted by the explosion of the car in which the town's powerful man was. It is a skillfully planned murder, in which local police chief Hank Quinlan (O. Welles) takes over the investigation. As the crime took place at the border crossing itself, Quinlan is joined in the investigation by Vargas, who deals with exposing drug smugglers. A Mexican law enforcement officer will be targeted by Quinlan, who will not hesitate to cooperate with the gangster Joe Grandi called Uncle (A. Tamiroff) in order to disable his colleague from Mexico... R.: Orson Welles St.: Charlton Heston (Mike Vargas), Janet Leigh (Susan Vargas), Orson Welles (Police Captain Hank Quinlan), Marlene Dietrich (Tanya), Zsa Zsa Gabor (Strip-Club Owner)... / Touch of Evil - (drama, SAD, 1958) Visokopozicionirani službenik u meksičkoj vladi Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) uživa u medenom mjesecu sa svojom suprugom Amerikankom Susan (J. Leigh). Njihov poljubac u gradiću na američko-meksičkoj granici prekine eksplozija automobila u kojoj se nalazio gradski moćnik. Riječ je o vješto isplaniranom ubojstvu pri čemu istragu preuzme mjesni šef policije Hank Quinlan (O. Welles). Kako se zločin zbio na samom graničnom prijelazu, Quinlanu se u istrazi pridruži Vargas koji se bavi raskrinkavanjem krijumčara droge. Meksički čuvar zakona naći će se na meti Quinlana koji neće prezati ni od suradnje s gangsterom Joeom Grandijem zvanim Uncle (A. Tamiroff) kako bi onemogućio svog kolegu iz Meksika... R.: Orson Welles Ul.: Charlton Heston (Mike Vargas), Janet Leigh (Susan Vargas), Orson Welles (Police Captain Hank Quinlan), Marlene Dietrich (Tanya), Zsa Zsa Gabor (Strip-Club Owner)...

programme.title: From whisperer to spokesperson / Od šaptačice do glasnogovornika
programme.desc: From a whisperer to a spokesperson - (documentary film, Croatia, 2008) There is no longer a so-called shell for whisperers. That shell is a kind of symbol of the term "theatre". But time takes its toll and the whisperers, together with the shells, disappear. Shells are deposited in warehouses of staged scenery, and whisperers cease to exist as a profession. Moreover, today most theater companies in Croatia do not have an official, paid, full-time whisperer. Although still, mostly only during rehearsals, they help with the creation of the play and do so in the way they know best - whispering. But even that is less and less. Many claim that this is the most obvious sign that the theater, and with it the world, has irrevocably changed. Namely, less and less texts are played in which it is important what was said by whom in the first place. There are fewer and fewer texts in verse and rhyme, so words have lost their importance. "Whisperers are dying out. People have less and less time to communicate. Life is becoming faster and more technologically modern day by day, people are more distant. There will come a day when there will be no time for whispering" - says one professional whisperer. On the other hand, the fact is that the epochal mood of the 21st century needs noisemakers more than whisperers. It is in this modern tendency that the second layer of this story is hidden. So today, while whisperers are dying out, spokespeople are multiplying unstoppably... Director: Irena Škorić... / Od šaptačice do glasnogovornika - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2008) Više ni u jednom kazalištu ne postoji tzv. školjka za šaptače. Ta je školjka svojevrsni simbol pojma "kazalište". No, vrijeme nosi svoje i šaptači, zajedno sa školjkama - nestaju. Školjke se odlažu u skladišta izigranih scenografija, a šaptači kao zanimanje prestaju postojati. Štoviše, danas većina kazališnih kuća u Hrvatskoj nema službenog, na plaći, stalno zaposlenog šaptača. Mada još uvijek, uglavnom samo na probama, pomažu pri stvaranju predstave i to onako kako najbolje znaju - šapćući. Ali i to sve rjeđe. Mnogi tvrde da je to najočitiji znak da se kazalište, a s njime i svijet, nepovratno promijenilo. Naime, sve se manje igraju tekstovi u kojima je važno što je tko uopće rekao. Sve je manje tekstova u stihu i rimi, pa su i riječi izgubile na važnosti. "Šaptači izumiru. Ljudi imaju sve manje vremena za komunikaciju. Život iz dana u dan postaje sve ubrzaniji i tehnološki suvremeniji, ljudi udaljeniji. Doći će dan kada neće biti vremena za šaptanje" - kaže jedna profesionalna šaptačica. S druge strane, činjenica je da epohalni štimung 21. stoljeća više treba bukače nego li šaptače. Upravo u toj novovjekoj tendenciji krije se drugi sloj ove priče. Tako danas, dok šaptači izumiru, nezaustavljivo se množe glasnogovornici... R.: Irena Škorić...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: ART - (art program, Croatia) Art - your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music... / ART - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Art - vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu...

programme.title: A witness of reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: The story of reality and fantasy - (educational program, Croatia, 2024) In the history of Croatian radio and television, some people gave their faces to the small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man steps off the stage of his life, his story fades into oblivion. They say that some stories existed only to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of memories of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres signed by director Dražen Piškorić are preserved in the HRT archive. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. Director: Ljiljana Šišmanović... / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života. R.: Ljiljana Šišmanović...

programme.title: Legends of Parisian Romanticism / Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Larmee des romantiques - (E01, art program, France, 2024) Paris 1827. A young generation of artists led by Hugo, Dumas and Delacroix is ​​determined to make a real revolution in the art field. These are the beginnings of romanticism in France. Delacroix creates "The Death of Sardanapalus", a painting that becomes a kind of manifesto of a new artistic movement that wants to break with conventions and create a completely new style of writing, painting and composing. "Hernani", "The Skin of Chagrin", "The Hunchback of Notre Dame" and "Fantastic Symphony" ensure the triumph of the romantic army whose soldiers are ready to risk everything in order to win and defeat the classics. Their artistic commitment also gives a strong impetus to new political awareness. While on the streets of Paris the people demand and fight for the Republic, even the romantics will not stop until freedom reigns. R.: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (Narratrice VO VF), Barbara Scaff (Narratrice VA)... / Larmee des romantiques - (E01, umjetnički program, Francuska, 2024) Pariz 1827. Mladi naraštaj umjetnika predvođen Hugoom, Dumasom i Delacroixom odlučan je u namjeri da na umjetničkom polju napravi pravu revoluciju. To su počeci romantizma u Francuskoj. Delacroix stvara "Sardanapalovu smrt", sliku koja postaje svojevrsni manifest novog umjetničkog pokreta koji želi raskinuti s konvencijama i osmisliti potpuno nov stil pisanja, slikanja i komponiranja. "Hernani", "Chagrinska koža", "Zvonar crkve Notre Dame" i "Fantastična simfonija" osiguravaju trijumf romantičarske vojske čiji su vojnici spremni sve riskirati kako bi odnijeli pobjedu i pobijedili klasike. Njihova umjetnička angažiranost daje snažan poticaj i novoj političkoj svijesti. Dok na pariškim ulicama narod zahtijeva i bori se za Republiku, ni romantičari neće stati sve dok ne zavlada sloboda. R.: Amelie Harrault Ul.: Cecile de France (Narratrice VO VF), Barbara Scaff (Narratrice VA)...

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E04, doc series, Germany, 2021) Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America... / Lander - Menschen - Abenteuer - (S13, E04, dok. serija, Njemačka, 2021) Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: The unknown island of St. Klement - Hell Islands / Nepoznati otok Sv. Klement - Pakleni otoci
programme.desc: The unknown island of St. Klement - Pakleni otoci - (documentary film, Croatia, 2004) The film depicts the life of the "škojari" Tonči Matijević. He talks about the traditions and way of life of his family on the island since 1482. Tonči believes that one should continue to live naturally, according to the conditions provided by the island - from fishing, farming and tourism. The island also abounds in forgotten excavations such as Roman baths and remains of Illyrian graves. The love for tradition and that way of life that only well-bred Tonči brings to the younger generation. R.: Iva Jelačić... / Nepoznati otok Sv. Klement - Pakleni otoci - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2004) Film prikazuje život "škojara" Tončija Matijevića. On govori o tradiciji i načinu života svoje obitelji na otoku još od 1482. godine. Tonči smatra da se i nadalje treba živjeti prirodno, prema uvjetima koje pruža otok - od ribarenja, obrađivanja zemlje i od turizma. Otok obiluje i zaboravljenim iskopinama kao što su rimske terme i ostaci ilirskih grobova. Ljubav prema tradiciji i tom načinu života koji donosi samo dobrobriti Tonči prenosi i na mlađu generaciju. R.: Iva Jelačić...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Klasika mundi - (concert film, Austria, 2025) Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic conducted by the renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal - bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Austrija, 2025) Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj - približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja...

programme.title: Box and / Peti dan
programme.desc: The fifth day - (talk show, Croatia, 2025) A weekly show in which given topics from science, art and culture as well as social and political events that directly affect our lives are discussed by intellectuals, moderated by... / Peti dan - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) Tjedna emisija u kojoj zadane teme iz znanosti, umjetnosti i kulture te društvena i politička zbivanja koja izravno utječu na naš život promišljaju intelektualci, uz moderiranje...

programme.title: Salvation for Venice / Spas za Veneciju
programme.desc: Saving Venice - (doc. film, England, 2022) Venice is one of the most famous cities in the world. Her accommodation is a stimulus for her economic progress, but it also exposes her to floods. The first settlers drove wooden stakes into the soft mud of the lagoon and thus achieved sufficient strength for the soil to bear more weight. The whole city rests on this technique. Samples of thousand-year-old stakes show that the sludge slows down the rotting of wood, but increasingly frequent floods are a new threat. Restorers hurriedly remove the salt from the city's monuments, which, when it remains after evaporation, crystallizes and weakens the structure of the walls. After a decade of construction, MOSE, a multi-billion euro flood barrier system, is ready to protect the city. Passages have been built across three narrow bays that connect the lagoon to the open sea. In the control room, we monitor barrier raising operations as a devastating storm approaches the city. Despite the failure of the safety valves, the team manages to solve the problem and raise the door in time. The city is safe, but MOSE can only be used in exceptional circumstances because the barriers prevent the tides, which are necessary to remove pollution and human waste from the city. Engineers are working on plans to balance the two problems, including a groundbreaking project to pump billions of liters of seawater into aquifers deep beneath the city to raise the water level there by 25cm. Venice's relationship with the lagoon is crucial to the city's future and explains its current difficulties. In the 15th century, while the lagoon was getting clogged, large-scale engineering efforts prevented the lagoon from turning into dry land, but because of this, floods became more frequent. New routes to North and South America reduced Venice's trading power. In order to survive, the city was repurposed as an important tourist destination. Today, Venice attracts millions of tourists annually. R.: Duncan Bulling Ul.: Massimo Sergio Martella (Walter Mutti)... / Saving Venice - (dok. film, Engleska, 2022) Venecija je jedan od najpoznatijih gradova na svijetu. Njezin smještaj poticajan je za njezin gospodarski napredak, ali je zbog njega istodobno izložena poplavama. Prvi doseljenici zabijali su drvene kolce u meki mulj lagune i tako postigli dovoljnu čvrstoću da tlo podnese veću težinu. Na toj tehnici počiva cijeli grad. Uzorci kolaca starih tisuću godina pokazuju kako mulj usporava truljenje drva, ali sve češće poplave nova su prijetnja. Restauratori žurno uklanjaju sol s gradskih spomenika koja, kad ostane nakon isparavanja, kristalizira i slabi strukturu zidova. Nakon desetljeća izgradnje, MOSE, sustav poplavnih barijera vrijedan više milijardi eura, spreman je za zaštitu grada. Preko tri uske uvale koje povezuju lagunu s otvorenim morem izgrađeni su prolazi. U kontrolnoj sobi pratimo operacije podizanja barijera dok se gradu približava razorna oluja. Unatoč kvaru sigurnosnih ventila, ekipa uspijeva riješiti problem i na vrijeme podići vrata. Grad je siguran, ali MOSE se može primijeniti samo u iznimnim okolnostima jer barijere sprečavaju plimu i oseku, koje su nužne za uklanjanje onečišćenja i ljudskog otpada iz grada. Inženjeri rade na planovima za uravnoteženje ova dva problema, uključujući revolucionarni projekt ispumpavanja milijardi litara morske vode u vodonosnike duboko ispod grada kako bi se razina ondje podignula za 25 cm. Odnos Venecije s lagunom ključan je za budućnost grada i objašnjava njegove trenutne poteškoće. U 15. stoljeću, dok se laguna začepljivala, krupnim inženjerskim pothvatima spriječeno je pretvaranje lagune u suho tlo, ali zato su poplave postale učestalije. Nove rute prema Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi smanjile su trgovačku moć Venecije. Da bi preživio, grad je prenamijenjen u važnu turističku destinaciju. Danas Venecija privlači milijune turista godišnje. R.: Duncan Bulling Ul.: Massimo Sergio Martella (Walter Mutti)...

programme.title: The Shanghai Triad / Šangajska trijada
programme.desc: Shanghai Triad - (drama, Taiwan, 1995) In the early thirties of the 20th century, Tang (L. Baotian) is the most powerful criminal in Shanghai, and he created an "empire" by selling opium. His lover Xiao Jingbao - "Bijou" (L. Gong) - is once a prostitute, and now a singer in the biggest nightclub in Shanghai, owned by Tang of course. Fourteen-year-old peasant Shuisheng (W. Xiaoxiao) is brought to Shanghai by his uncle, Tang's cousin and servant. The boy will be Bijou's servant and will obediently fulfill her every wish. She lives in a large, luxurious house given to her by Tang. Tang has two assistants - his "right hand" Song (S. Chun) and favorite Zheng (F. Biao). Song is Bijou's secret lover, which a stunned Shuisheng discovers in the first days. Fat Yu (L. Jiang) is Tang's main competitor who kills several of his men, including Shuisheng's uncle... R.: Yimou Zhang Street: Li Gong (Xiao Jingbao), Wang Xiaoxiao (Shuisheng, the boy), Baotian Li (Tang, the gangster boss), Li Xuejian (Sixth Uncle), Sun Chun (Song, Tang's "right hand")... / Shanghai Triad - (drama, Tajvan, 1995) Početkom tridesetih godina 20. stoljeća Tang (L. Baotian) je najmoćniji šangajski kriminalac, a "carstvo" je stvorio prodajući opijum. Njegova je ljubavnica Xiao Jingbao - "Bijou" (L. Gong) - nekoć prostitutka, a sad pjevačica u najvećem šangajskom noćnom klubu čiji je vlasnik dakako Tang. Četrnaestogodišnjeg seljačića Shuishenga (W. Xiaoxiao) dovede u Šangaj njegov stric, Tangov rođak i sluga. Dječak će biti sluga kod Bijou i ispunjavat će poslušno svaku njezinu želju. Ona stanuje u velikoj raskošnoj kući koju joj je poklonio Tang. Tang ima dvojicu pomoćnika - svoju "desnu ruku" Songa (S. Chun) i miljenika Zhenga (F. Biao). Song je tajni ljubavnik Bijou što zapanjeni Shuisheng otkrije već prvih dana. Debeli Yu (L. Jiang) glavni je Tangov konkurent koji pobije nekoliko njegovih ljudi, među njima i Shuishengovog strica... R.: Yimou Zhang Ul.: Li Gong (Xiao Jingbao), Wang Xiaoxiao (Shuisheng, dječak), Baotian Li (Tang, šef gangstera), Li Xuejian (šesti stric), Sun Chun (Song, Tangova "desna ruka")...

programme.title: Free zone / Slobodna zona
programme.desc: Free Zone - (drama, Israel, 2005) Rebecca (Natalie Portman) is a young American woman who has been living in Jerusalem for several months. She just broke up with the Jew Breitberg, after he confessed to her that he raped a Palestinian woman while he was in the army. Rebecca's father is Jewish, and her mother is non-Jewish, so, despite her Jewish upbringing, she is not considered Jewish according to religious tradition. A tearful Rebecca gets into a taxi driven by Israeli Hanna (Hanna Laslo), whose parents survived the Holocaust. Rebecca agrees to go with Hanna, who is headed to a free trade zone not far from the Jordanian border to collect money owed to her husband, who was wounded in a recent rocket attack. There they meet Laila (Hiam Abbass), a Palestinian woman who is supposed to connect them with Hanna's husband's black market partner, a man they call "The American". The three women embark on a perilous journey to recover Hanna's money and find "The American's" son, Walid, who they believe ran off with the money. R.: Amos Gitai Ul.: Natalie Portman (Rebecca), Hana Laslo (Hanna Ben Moshe), Hiam Abbass (Leila), Carmen Maura (Mrs. Breitberg), Makram Khoury (Samir aka "The American")... / Free Zone - (drama, Izrael, 2005) Rebecca (Natalie Portman) je mlada Amerikanka koja već nekoliko mjeseci živi u Jeruzalemu. Upravo je prekinula vezu sa Židovom Breitbergom, nakon što joj je priznao da je silovao Palestinku dok je bio u vojsci. Rebeccin je otac Židov, a majka nežidovka pa se, unatoč židovskom odgoju, ne smatra Židovkom prema vjerskoj tradiciji. Uplakana Rebecca ulijeće u taksi kojim upravlja Izraelka Hanna (Hanna Laslo), čiji su roditelji preživjeli holokaust. Rebecca pristaje poći s Hannom koja se uputila prema slobodnoj trgovačkoj zoni nedaleko od jordanske granice kako bi utjerala novac koji duguju njezinom suprugu, ranjenom u nedavnom raketnom napadu. Ondje se nađu s Lailom (Hiam Abbass), Palestinkom koja ih treba povezati s partnerom Hannina supruga na crnom tržištu, muškarcem kojeg zovu "Amerikanac". Tri žene kreću na opasno putovanje kako bi utjerale Hannin novac i pronašle "Amerikančeva" sina Walida, za kojeg vjeruju da je pobjegao s novcem. R.: Amos Gitai Ul.: Natalie Portman (Rebecca), Hana Laslo (Hanna Ben Moshe), Hiam Abbass (Leila), Carmen Maura (Mrs. Breitberg), Makram Khoury (Samir aka "The American")...

programme.title: Photography in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photography in Croatia - (art program, Croatia, 2007) Sven Stilinović's photography, from early, large-format black-and-white photographic collages to strong structurally saturated color works, is characterized by unconventionality, anarchism and the idea of ​​the absurd. Stilinović treats photography as an intuitive and intellectual process and uses the method of permanent experiment whose changes become a complex collage of the unpredictable and never defined nature of art... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2007) Fotografija Svena Stilinovića, od ranih, crno-bijelih fotografskih kolaža velikog formata do snažnih strukturalno zasićenih kolorističkih radova, karakterizira nekonvencionalnost, anarhizam i ideja apsurda. Stilinović tretira fotografiju kao intuitivni i intelektualni proces te se koristi metodom permanentnog eksperimenta čije mijene postaju složeni kolaž nepredvidive i nikad dorečene prirode umjetnosti...

programme.title: Boy / Boy
programme.desc: Boy - (comedy, New Zealand, 2010) Boy is set in 1984 on the rural east coast of New Zealand and is inspired by the Oscar-nominated short film Two Cars, One Night. Boy is a hilarious and honest story about growing up and heroes. Boy is a dreamer who loves Michael Jackson and lives with his brother Rocky, a bunch of abandoned cousins ​​and his grandmother. Boy has a hero, and that is his father Alamein, about whom the boy fantasizes. He imagines him as a deep-sea diver, a war hero and a close relative of Michael Jackson (he even dances like him). In reality, Alamein is an incompetent moneylender who was imprisoned for robbery. When Alamein returns home after seven years away, Boy is confronted with the man he thought he knew and the realization that he is not the hero he thought he was. R.: Taika Waititi Ul.: James Rolleston (Boy), Taika Waititi (Alamein), Maakariini Butler (Murray), Moerangi Tihore (Dynasty), Cherilee Martin (Kelly)... / Boy - (komedija, Novi Zeland, 2010) Priča filma Boy odvija se 1984. na ruralnoj istočnoj obali Novog Zelanda, a nadahnuta je kratkim filmom Dva automobila, jedna noć, koji je bio nominiran za Oscara. Boy je urnebesna i iskrena priča o odrastanju i junacima. Boy je sanjar koji voli Michaela Jacksona i živi s bratom Rockyjem, hrpom napuštenih rođaka i bakom. Boy ima junaka, a to je njegov otac Alamein o kojemu dječak mašta. Zamišlja ga kao dubinskog ronioca, ratnog junaka i bliskog rođaka Michaela Jacksona (čak i pleše poput njega). U stvarnosti, Alamein je nesposoban niškoristi koji je bio u zatvoru zbog pljačke. Kad se Alamein vrati kući nakon sedam godina izbivanja, Boy se suočava s čovjekom za kojeg je mislio da ga poznaje i spoznajom da nije junak kakvim ga je zamišljao. R.: Taika Waititi Ul.: James Rolleston (Boy), Taika Waititi (Alamein), Maakariini Butler (Murray), Moerangi Tihore (Dynasty), Cherilee Martin (Kelly)...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Klasika mundi - (concert film, Croatia, 2016) The country - partner of the festival in 2016 was the Kingdom of Spain, and the opening ceremony belonged to one of the most respected ensembles specializing in early music - La Ritirata. Under the artistic direction of the brilliant cellist, also the founder of the ensemble, Josetxu Obregon, La Ritirata becomes an unavoidable musical and cultural delicacy of many festivals and concert halls. At our oldest baroque art festival in Varaždin, members of the ensemble perform arias and instrumental excerpts from two operas based on Miguel de Cervantes, by the Italian baroque composer Antonio Caldara. On the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the death of that great Spanish writer, the musical evening was inspired by his masterpiece, the novel The Fair Knight Don Quixote of Mancha. R.: Grgić Company... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2016) Zemlja - partner festivala 2016. godine bila je Kraljevina Španjolska, a svečanost otvorenja pripala je jednom od najuglednijih ansambala specijaliziranih za ranu glazbu - La Ritirata. Pod umjetničkim vodstvom briljantnog čelista, ujedno i utemeljitelja ansambla, Josetxua Obregona, La Ritirata postaje nezaobilazna glazbena i kulturna poslastica mnogih festivala i koncertnih dvorana. Na našem najstarijem festivalu barokne umjetnosti u Varaždinu, članovi ansambla izvode arije i instrumentalne ulomke iz dviju opera prema Miguelu de Cervantesu, talijanskog baroknog skladatelja Antonija Caldare. U povodu 400. godišnjice smrti toga velikog španjolskog pisca, glazbena večer nadahnuta je njegovim remek-djelom, romanom Bistri vitez Don Quijote od Manche. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.title: Skitations / Skitancije
programme.desc: Skitancije (undiscovered Croatia) - (E01, doc. series, Croatia, 2014) Young biologist Goran Šafarek travels through the famous Baranja triangle Kopački rit - Danube - Drava in search of deer roar. He found himself in this area during a severe drought, which makes his journey even more exciting; where he is walking now, the water was high until recently, so he walks between scattered shells. Along the way, he meets interesting people, nature and river guardians, rare inhabitants of ethnic villages that are beautiful and eerily empty, an enthusiastic potter who makes jewelry from Drava stone, which he calls precious stone because of its value for the ecosystem. With a group of young ecologists, he sails down the Danube to a white sandbar that sometimes disappears, sometimes appears in a new, wonderful form. His mission is to help preserve rivers, without unnecessarily interfering with their flow and the life around them, as he likes to say: "Let the rivers breathe." R.: Darko Halapija... / Skitancije (neotkrivena Hrvatska) - (E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2014) Mladi biolog Goran Šafarek putuje glasovitim baranjskim trokutom Kopački rit - Dunav - Drava u potrazi za rikom jelena. U ovom području našao se za vrijeme velike suše što njegovo putovanje čini još uzbudljivijim; tamo gdje sada hoda do nedavno je bila visoka voda, pa prolazi između rasutih školjki. Putem susreće zanimljive ljude, čuvare prirode i čuvare rijeka, rijetke stanovnike etnosela koja su prelijepa i sablasno prazna, zanesenog keramičara koji izrađuje nakit iz dravskog kamena koji naziva dragi kamen zbog njegove vrijednosti za ekosustav. S grupom mladih ekologa Dunavom plovi do bijelog pješčanog spruda koji čas nestaje, čas se pojavljuje u nekom uvijek novom divnom obliku. Njegova je misija pomoći očuvanju rijeka, bez nepotrebnog upletanja u njihov tok i život oko njih, kako on to voli reći: "Pustite rijeke da dišu." R.: Darko Halapija...

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: Kako se kaže - (E17, show magazine, Croatia, 2025) The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language tips, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of young people and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Institute for the Croatian Language: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec... / Kako se kaže - (E17, show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: The Collector of Sounds - (E44, feature series, Croatia) Sixty short stories about sound, which are heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called "The Collector of Sounds", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he has very poor hearing. This little being spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are most often the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle... / Skupljač zvukova - (E44, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S07, E25, animated series, USA, 2020) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Peter Cugno (Francois), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Kingsley Marshall (Marshall)... / PAW Patrol - (S07, E25, anim. serija, SAD, 2020) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Peter Cugno (Francois), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Kingsley Marshall (Marshall)...

programme.title: Time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy Time - (S01, E22, animated series, England, 2009) An animated British children's series follows the adventures of a little troubled lamb and his friends. Timmy goes to kindergarten in the hills where teacher Harriet and teacher Osbourne teach him how to be a good friend and how to share with friends. In addition, it is important that students accept their mistakes and learn something from them. Join Timmy and his friends - Yabba the duck, Paxton the pig and Mittens the kitten as they sing, play and laugh. Director: Jackie Cockle... / Timmy Time - (S01, E22, anim. serija, Engleska, 2009) Animirana britanska dječja serija prati avanture malog problematičnog janjeta i njegovih prijatelja. Timmy ide u vrtić u brdima gdje ga učiteljica Harriet i učitelj Osbourne uče kako da bude dobar prijatelj te kako s prijateljima treba dijeliti. Osim toga važno je da učenici prihvaćaju svoje pogreške i na njima nešto nauče. Pridružite se Timmyju i njegovim prijateljima - patki Yabbi, praščiću Paxtonu i mačiću Mittensu u njihovoj pjesmi, igri i smijehu. R.: Jackie Cockle...

programme.title: Kreki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krceki - (children's program, Croatia, 2023) Krceki are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game are also waiting for you!... / Krceki - (dječji program, Hrvatska, 2023) Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!...

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Krceki - song - (E26, children's program, Croatia) Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramezljlko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja - Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić... / Krceki - pjesmica - (E26, dječji program, Hrvatska) Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja - Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić...

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E05, cartoon series, Ireland, 2023) Lu is a little ladybug who has just started preschool with her new friends, and is entering a completely new social life. This animated dramedy for preschoolers takes place in Bubingrad, a small village that is home to a community of bugs. Lu's teacher Mila is a snail, and Lu goes to school in a house on her back. Lu and her new friends, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica and Maks, build their first friendships and at the same time learn social skills in order to navigate them! The series explores the fun, drama and mishaps that come from the lives of preschoolers. Filled with music, humor and heart, Lu and the merry band celebrate their friendships. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Knihomolka Betty), Alice Helenport (Elodie and Silkworm), Kolby McDonald (Gus)... / Lu and The Bally Bunch - (E05, crt. serija, Irska, 2023) Lu je mala bubamara koja je upravo krenula u predškolu sa svojim novim prijateljima, te ulazi u sasvim novi društveni život. Ova animirana dramedija za predškolarce događa se u Bubingradu, malom selu koje je dom zajednici buba. Luina učiteljica Mila je puž, te Lu odlazi u školu u kućici na njezinim leđima. Lu i njezini novi prijatelji, Branimir, Biba, Damir, Elica i Maks, grade svoja prva prijateljstva te usto uče društvene vještine kako bi se u njima snašli! Serija istražuje zabavu, dramu i nezgode koje proizlaze iz života predškolaraca. Ispunjeni glazbom, humorom i srcem, Lu i vesela družina slave svoja prijateljstva. R.: Nicky Phelan Ul.: Freya Mclaughlin (Lu), Aileen Mythen (Knihomolka Betty), Alice Helenport (Elodie and Silkworm), Kolby McDonald (Gus)...

programme.title: Hi Day / Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Hey Duggee - (S03, E01, cartoon series, England, 2019) Get ready for laughter, learning and exciting activities in an adventure-filled club that every child will want to join! Meet Duggee, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages kids to have fun, be full of energy and most of all, do anything! Each episode of this colorful, fun and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Duggee welcoming the Chipmunks, a group of little curios left at the club by their parents. Then there's laughter and learning as the Chipmunks discover something new about the world around them, and Duggee watches over them patiently. Their adventures are often funny and comical, which will certainly attract young viewers (as well as adults) and encourage them to solve problems actively and on the move, running and jumping. Duggee rewards club members with an activity badge each time, which they proudly show off to the parents who pick them up at the end of each episode. Introducing... Squirrels! Piko, a small and good-natured rhinoceros, a gentle soul who often gets lost in the things around him! Betty, a cheerful octopus who loves to read and is very intelligent, wants to be the first to answer every question. Vrcko, a hyperactive hippopotamus who approaches everything with enthusiasm, is loud and doesn't like listening. Lucky, a small, happy and undemanding crocodile, will use every opportunity to get wet. Nora, thoughtful and smart muscle, is sensitive, curious and gentle. R.: Grant Orchard St.: Alexander Armstrong (Narrator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)... / Hey Duggee - (S03, E01, crt. serija, Engleska, 2019) Pripremite se na smijeh, učenje i uzbudljive aktivnosti u klubu punom pustolovina kojem će se svako dijete htjeti pridružiti! Upoznajte Duggeeja, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i više od svega, da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene, zabavne i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Duggee dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Duggee strpljivo pazi na njih. Njihove pustolovine često su šaljive i komične, što će zasigurno privući mlade gledatelje (ali i odrasle) i potaknuti ih da probleme rješavaju aktivno i u pokretu, trčeći i poskakujući. Duggee svaki put članove kluba nagradi značkom za aktivnost, što oni ponosno pokazuju roditeljima koji dođu po njih na kraju svake epizode. Predstavljamo... Vjeverice! Piko, malen i dobrodušan nosorog, nježna duša koja se često zalijeće u stvari oko sebe! Beti, vesela hobotnica koja voli čitati i vrlo je inteligentna, želi odgovoriti prva na svako pitanje. Vrcko, hiperaktivan vodenkonj koji svemu pristupa s oduševljenjem, glasan je i ne ide mu slušanje. Srećko, malen, sretan i nezahtjevan krokodil, iskoristit će svaku priliku da se smoči. Nora, zamišljena i pametna mišica, osjećajna je, radoznala i nježna. R.: Grant Orchard Ul.: Alexander Armstrong (Narator), Jasmine Bartholomew (Betty), Alfie Sanderson (Tag), Poppy Boyes (Norrie), Duke Davis (Happy)...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E43, Drama, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E43, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E04, drama series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E04, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's - (S01, E17, drama series, Croatia) PEPE, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka Puppet drama series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series! Puppet actors: Katarina Arbanas, Dinka Vuković, Jadran Grubišić, Mladen Vujčić Actors: Mirela Videk, David Petrović Screenwriter: Tomislav Zagoda Director: Petar Orešković Director of photography: Marko Jerbić Editor: Iva Blašković Editor: Sanja Nakić Producer: Sanja Ivančin... / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E39, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E11, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with the vitality of childhood. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku - da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!...

programme.title: How Elmo got a puppy / Kako je Elmo dobio psića
programme.desc: Furry Friends Forever: Elmo Gets a Puppy - (short film, USA, 2021) In this cheerful TV special that teaches us how to love and care for our furry friends, Elmo and Grover help a cute stray puppy find a new, permanent home. One day, on Sesame Street, just as Elmo is about to spend the day playing with his friend, Grover, they hear Oskar complaining about a puppy living in a box near his trash can. Elmo and Grover befriend the puppy and soon help him find the right home, where he will stay forever. Yes, it's a great episode. As Sesame Street always teaches us something, this animated special shows us how to take care of our pets. But maybe he could introduce the children more to the responsibilities they have towards a pet (he shows us only the basic, but not the more complex obligations such as training and going to the vet, although that could be the topic of the next special or episode). But the songs are really great (Keksomlat's song about dog treats is a standout), and the story is great, as are the actors who voice the characters. Director: Joanna Hepworth Actor: Tyler Bunch (Louie), Leslie Carrara (Abby Cadabby / Tango), Stephanie DAbruzzo (Mae), Ryan Dillon (Elmo), Eric Jacobson (Oscar / Grover)... / Furry Friends Forever: Elmo Gets a Puppy - (kratki film, SAD, 2021) U ovom veselom TV-specijalu, koji nas uči kako da volimo i brinemo se o našim čupavim prijateljima, Elmo i Grover pomažu slatkome psiću lutalici da pronađe novi, stalni dom. Jednoga dana, u ulici Sezama, baš kada se Elmo sprema provesti dan u igri sa svojim prijateljem, Groverom, začuju Oskara kako se žali na psića koji živi u kutiji blizu njegove kante za smeće. Elmo i Grover sprijatelje se s psićem i ubrzo mu pomognu pronaći pravi dom, u kojemu će zauvijek ostati. Da, riječ je o sjajnoj epizodi. Kako nas Ulica Sezama uvijek o nečemu uči, ovaj nam animirani specijal pokazuje kako da se brinemo o svojim ljubimcima. No, možda bi djecu mogao i više upoznati s odgovornostima koje imaju prema kućnome ljubimcu (pokazuje nam samo osnovne, ali ne i složenije obveze kao što su dresura i odlazak veterinaru, premda bi to mogla biti tema idućega specijala ili epizode). No, pjesme su doista sjajne (izdvaja se Keksomlatova pjesma o psećim poslasticama), a priča je odlična, kao i glumci koji likovima daju glasove. R.: Joanna Hepworth Ul.: Tyler Bunch (Louie), Leslie Carrara (Abby Cadabby / Tango), Stephanie DAbruzzo (Mae), Ryan Dillon (Elmo), Eric Jacobson (Oscar / Grover)...

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Dino Ranch - (S02, E24, drama series, Canada, 2022) Dinoranchers prepare to take nutritious watermelons to herds of wild dinosaurs, but suddenly a tiny wild microraptor appears and manages to scare even Biscuit! Bo and Jane explain that the microraptors are the only dinosaurs the T. rex are afraid of, and that they snack on anything they find in search of food. Jon and Blitz volunteer to catch the microraptor before it eats their entire supply of watermelons, but the little mischievous is so cunning that he outsmarts them every time. It's only when a microraptor scares Biscuit and steals a dino rattle full of watermelons that Blitz finally admits that he needs help catching the tiny raptor. He and the Dinoranchers set off in pursuit of the frightened Rumble-toting Biscuit, and together they manage to catch the microraptor and deliver their watermelon harvest to the wild dinosaurs who need it most. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)... / Dino Ranch - (S02, E24, igrana serija, Kanada, 2022) Dinorančeri se spremaju odnijeti hranjive apatolubenice stadima divljih dinosaura, no iznenada se pojavi sićušni divlji mikroraptor koji uspije prestrašiti čak i Biskvita! Bo i Jane objašnjavaju da su mikroraptori jedini dinosauri kojih se T. rexovi boje te da grickaju sve što pronađu u potrazi za hranom. Jon i Blitz dobrovoljno se javljaju da uhvate mikroraptora prije nego što im izgrize cijelu zalihu apatolubenica, ali taj je mali nestaško toliko lukav da ih svaki put nadmudri. Tek kad mikroraptor prestraši Biskvita i ukrade dinotutnjalicu punu apatolubenica, Blitz napokon priznaje da mu treba pomoć pri hvatanju tog sićušnog raptora. On i Dinorančeri kreću u potjeru za preplašenim Biskvitom koji vuče tutnjalicu, i udruženim snagama uspijevaju uhvatiti mikroraptora te isporučiti svoju berbu lubenica divljim dinosaurima kojima je najpotrebnija. R.: Bill Speers Ul.: Tyler James Nathan (Jon), Ava Ro (Min), Athena Karkanis (Jane Cassidy), Scott Gorman (Bo Cassidy)...

programme.title: Superteta / Superteta

And that's where SuperTeta enters the scene and into their kindergarten stories! She creates, works, consoles... may she solve every problem! It's enough for her to snap her fingers, tap her heels... touch this or that and... start the magic of joint play, fun and creation... U Šarenom loncu pripremaju se predjela, glavna jela i deserti, ali na jedan potpuno nov način, uz igru i zabavu. Zavirite u Šareni lonac! R.: Petar Orešković...

programme.title: Daniel the tiger's neighborhood / Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E01, Drama, USA) "Daniel Tigers Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four, based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." The series tells inspiring stories about the lives of preschoolers, using musical strategies rooted in Fred Rogers' famous social-emotional learning. Through imagination, creativity and music, Daniel and his friends learn important social skills, necessary for school and life. The main character of the series is Tigrić Daniel (son of Mama Tigrica and Papa Tigra). Along with him, the series also features other children, characters from the Neighborhood of Imagination, such as Maca Katarina (daughter of Maca Henrietta), Miss Elena (daughter of Lady Elena Fairchilda and Niko Musician), Owl O (nephew of Owl X) and Prince Wednesday (youngest son of King Friday and Queen Saturday, younger brother of Prince Tuesday). Each episode consists of two parts connected by a common social-emotional theme, such as disappointment and sadness or anger and gratitude. Each of the stories is accompanied by appropriate musical numbers, in order to bring the theme and different life situations as close as possible to the youngest viewers. Street: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)... / Daniel Tigers Neighborhood - (S02, E01, igrana serija, SAD) "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa". Serija pripovijeda poticajne priče o životu predškolske djece, služeći se glazbenim strategijama ukorijenjenim u poznatom socijalno-emotivnom učenju Freda Rogersa. Kroz maštu, kreativnost i glazbu, Daniel i njegovi prijatelji uče važne društvene vještine, neophodne za školu i život. Glavni lik serije je Tigrić Daniel (sin Mame Tigrice i Tate Tigra). Uz njega, u seriji se također pojavljuju druga djeca, likovi iz Susjedstva Mašte, kao što su Maca Katarina (kći Mace Henrijete), gospođica Elena (kći ledi Elene Fairchilde i Nika Glazbenika), Sova O (nećak Sove X) i Princ Srijeda (najmlađi sin Kralja Petka i Kraljice Subote, mlađi brat Princa Utorka). Svaka epizoda sastoji se iz dva dijela povezana zajedničkom socijalno-emotivnom temom, kao što su razočarenje i tuga ili bijes i zahvalnost. Svaku od priča prate i prigodni glazbeni brojevi, kako bi se najmlađim gledateljima što bolje približila tema i različite životne situacije. Ul.: Jake Beale (Daniel), Heather Bambrick (Mamma), Ted Dykstra (Papà), Amariah Faulkner (Katerina), Tommy Lioutas (Principe Martedì)...
