programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Pancake song - (children's program, Croatia) Sing and dance to the new Pancake song. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković... / Pjesmica Palačinke - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković...

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey - (S03, E43, Drama, Australia) Bluey is an adorable and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle Dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. St.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)... / Bluey - (S03, E43, igrana serija, Australija) Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Bluey obožava igranje i uvlači svu svoju obitelj i cijelo susjedstvo u svoj svijet zabave i igranja. Ul.: David McCormack (Dad), Melanie Zanetti (Mum)...

programme.title: Tvidi i Muc / Tvidi i Muc
programme.desc: Tweedy and Fluff - (E04, drama series, England, 2023) Tweedy is a small rag toy made of tweed. He lives alone in the weaving house until Muc arrives in it - a ball of woolen balls on four legs - and becomes his beloved pet. The main characters of this warm, humorous series filmed in the stop animation technique meet on the floor of a spinning mill. The two immediately become inseparable friends, who communicate without speaking and learn to overcome their fears... / Tweedy and Fluff - (E04, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Tvidi je mala krpena igračka od tvida. Živi sam tkalačkoj kućici sve dok u nju ne stigne i Muc - klupko vunenih mucica na četiri noge - koji mu postane voljeni kućni ljubimac. Glavni likovi ove tople, šaljive serije snimljene u tehnici stop animacije susreću se na podu predionice. Njih dvojica smjesta postanu neraskidivi prijatelji, koji se sporazumijevaju i bez govora i uče prevladavati strahove...

programme.title: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke
programme.desc: Pepe, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka's - (S01, E17, drama series, Croatia) PEPE, Bubi and Lu at Dr. Zdravka Puppet drama series A series for the youngest about going to the doctor. Her main characters are Pepe, Bubi and Lu, little ones who are still growing their milk teeth. They are a little mischievous and very afraid of doctors and injections, but with dear doctor Zdravka and funny uncle Boža, they will master all the lessons and overcome their fear of the doctor's office. Three fun songs await you in the series! Puppet actors: Katarina Arbanas, Dinka Vuković, Jadran Grubišić, Mladen Vujčić Actors: Mirela Videk, David Petrović Screenwriter: Tomislav Zagoda Director: Petar Orešković Director of photography: Marko Jerbić Editor: Iva Blašković Editor: Sanja Nakić Producer: Sanja Ivančin... / Pepe, Bubi i Lu kod dr. Zdravke - (S01, E17, igrana serija, Hrvatska) PEPE, BUBI I LU kod dr. Zdravke Lutkarska igrana serija Serija za najmlađe o odlasku liječniku. Njezini su glavni junaci Pepe, Bubi i Lu, mališani kojima još rastu mliječni zubi. Malo su nestašni i jako se boje doktora i injekcije, ali uz dragu doktoricu Zdravku i smiješnog ujaka Božu savladat će sve lekcije i pobijediti strah od ordinacije. U serijalu vas očekuju i tri zabavne pjesmice! Glumci lutkari: Katarina Arbanas, Dinka Vuković, Jadran Grubišić, Mladen Vujčić Glumci: Mirela Videk, David Petrović Scenarist: Tomislav Zagoda Redatelj: Petar Orešković Direktor fotografije: Marko Jerbić Montažerka: Iva Blašković Urednica: Sanja Nakić Producentica: Sanja Ivančin...

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: Mališani - (children's program, Croatia) In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! The series was prepared by: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producer: Marinela Brala Editors: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer... / Mališani - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka! Seriju pripremili: Dario Hacek, Valentina Mavretić, Srđan Gulić Producentica: Marinela Brala Urednice: Sanja Nakić, Tanja Kirhmajer...

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: Numberblocks - (S01, E19, drama series, England) The series "Number Blocks" follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily... / Numberblocks - (S01, E19, igrana serija, Engleska) Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke...

programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: I love ZOO animals - (natural film, Croatia) In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he is given a special task that he cannot complete if he does not learn something about the daily activities in the zoo - feeding, cleaning and arranging the enclosures, playing, training or treating the animals. In the second episode, Marko was given the task of making toys for Egyptian letips and capuchin monkeys. But before that, they will need to find out how animals play and how to enrich their living space so that they don't get bored... / Volim životinje ZOO - (prirod. film, Hrvatska) U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu - prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju, treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U drugoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti igračke za egipatskog letipsa i majmune kapucine. Ali prije toga trebat će doznati kako se životinje igraju i kako obogatiti njihov životni prostor da im ne bude dosadno...

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Pjesmica Crvena - (children's program, Croatia) Crvena We will go on a winter walk and learn about the magic of the color red... / Pjesmica Crvena - (dječji program, Hrvatska) Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje...

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: Peppa Pig - (S02, E39, feature series, England) "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human traits, and there are also her family and friends. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother George, their parents and the other animal families that live in their town. Each family represents a different animal species, so Peppa's friends are the rabbit Rebecca, the sheep Suzy and the cat Candy. In each episode, the cheerful group experiences new adventures, and the plot often helps children cope with new feelings and experiences that come with growing up. The main character of the series is Peppa, a female pig with many human characteristics. Along with her, there are her family and friends. Peppa's friends are her own age, while her younger brother's friends are his peers. The plots of the episodes are related to the children's daily activities - going to kindergarten, swimming, visiting grandparents or other relatives, playing on the playground or riding bicycles. The characters in the series wear clothes, live in houses and drive cars, but they also show some characteristics of the animals on which they are based. R.: Mark Baker St.: John Sparkes (Narrator)... / Peppa Pig - (S02, E39, igrana serija, Engleska) "Praščić Peppa" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s mnogo ljudskih osobina, a tu su još i njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georgea, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu. Svaka obitelj predstavlja drugu životinjsku vrstu pa su tako Peppini prijatelji zečica Rebecca, ovca Suzy i mačka Candy. U svakoj epizodi vesela družina doživljava nove avanture, a radnja često pomaže djeci da se nose s novim osjećajima i iskustvima koje sa sobom donosi odrastanje. Glavni lik serije je Peppa, žensko prase s puno ljudskih osobina. Uz nju, tu su još njezina obitelj i prijatelji. Peppini prijatelji su njezinih godina, dok su prijatelji njezinog mlađeg brata njegovi vršnjaci. Zapleti epizoda vezani su uz svakodnevne aktivnosti djece - odlaske u vrtić, plivanja, posjete djedu i baki ili drugim rođacima, igre na igralištu ili vožnje biciklima. Likovi u seriji nose odjeću, žive u kućama i voze automobile, no pokazuju i neke osobine onih životinja na kojima su temeljeni. R.: Mark Baker Ul.: John Sparkes (Narator)...

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon - (S02, E11, Drama, France) Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with the vitality of childhood. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. Director: Julien Cayot Street: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)... / Simon - (S02, E11, igrana serija, Francuska) Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta. R.: Julien Cayot Ul.: Salome Keren Zeitoun (Simon), Tony Sanial (Gaspard), Magali Bonfils (Eva), Mathias Casartelli (Andre), Angèle Humeau (Patricia)...

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: 123 Number Squad - (E26, drama series, Singapore, 2021) Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123... / 123 Number Squad - (E26, igrana serija, Singapur, 2021) Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123...

programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo - (E50, feature series, England, 2018) The award-winning children's series "Pablo" was shot in 2D animation combined with feature parts. The main character, Pablo, is an artistically gifted five-year-old boy on the autism spectrum. His imaginative drawings come to life and allow him to face the real world with more confidence. With magic crayons, he bravely transforms his life challenges into fantastic adventures, and his feelings into picturesque, talking characters. With the help of his friends from the world of his drawings - Ljam, Noasaur, Misha, Rafi, Tango and Palča - Pablo understands his real world as a five-year-old more easily. "Pablo" pays tribute to individuality and thinking in a different way, as the first children's series in the world with an autistic main character. Each story depicts the real-life experiences of children with autism, who participated in creating the stories and writing the screenplay. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama), Sumita Majumdar (Wren)... / Pablo - (E50, igrana serija, Engleska, 2018) Nagrađivana serija za djecu "Pablo" snimljena je 2D animacijom u kombinaciji s igranim dijelovima. Glavni lik, Pablo, umjetnički je nadaren petogodišnji dječak u spektru autizma. Njegovi maštoviti crteži oživljavaju i omogućuju mu da se s više pouzdanja suočava sa stvarnim svijetom. Čarobnim bojicama on svoje životne izazove hrabro pretvara u fantastične pustolovine, a osjećaje u slikovite likove koji govore. Uz pomoć prijatelja iz svijeta svojih crteža - Ljamu, Noasaura, Mišu, Rafija, Tanga i Palči - Pablo lakše poima svoj stvarni svijet petogodišnjaka. "Pablo" odaje počast individualnosti i razmišljanju na drukčiji način, kao prva dječja serija na svijetu s autističnim glavnim likom. Svaka priča oslikava stvarna životna iskustva djece s autizmom, koja su sudjelovala u osmišljavanju priča i pisanju scenarija. R.: David McGrath Ul.: Rachael Dickson (Mouse), Rosie Barry (Pablos Mum), Tony Finnegan (Noasaurus), Rosie King (Llama), Sumita Majumdar (Wren)...

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E18, Drama, France) Grizzly Bear and the Lemmings is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the lemmings, who live in the forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. The ranger's log cabin is the only trace of human civilization amidst the untamed wilderness of Canada's great nature reserve. As the ranger escapes, the grizzly bear claims her, because after all, bears are at the top of the food chain. After moving into the house, Grizzly enjoys all the benefits of a modern way of living - a comfortable bed, an air-conditioned space and a fully equipped kitchen. But he is not alone. A group of small creatures, lemmings, also move into it. Since Grizzlies and lemmings are not civilized enough for a peaceful coexistence, they try to outwit each other with various tricks and complete madness reigns in the house. Street: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)... / Grizzy et les Lemmings - (S03, E18, igrana serija, Francuska) "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti - leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan. Rendžerova brvnara jedini je trag ljudske civilizacije usred neukroćene divljine velikog kanadskog rezervata prirode. Dok rendžer izbiva, medvjed Grizli je prisvaja, jer ipak su medvjedi na vrhu hranidbenog lanca. Nakon što se useli u kuću, Grizli uživa u svim blagodatima suvremenog načina stanovanja - udobnom ležaju, klimatiziranom prostoru i potpuno opremljenoj kuhinji. No nije sam. U nju se useljava i skupina malih stvorenja, leminga. Budući da Grizli i leminzi nisu dovoljno civilizirani za miran suživot, nastoje raznoraznim trikovima nadmudriti jedni druge te kućom zavlada potpuno ludilo. Ul.: Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (Grizzy), Josselin Charier (Lemmings)...

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: PAW Patrol - (S07, E25, animated series, USA, 2020) The hero of the series is a boy named Ryder, the leader of a team of search and rescue dogs called Patrol Dogs. The team goes on missions together to protect the coastal community of Adventure Bay. Each dog has special skills associated with emergency service professions, so members of the family include a firefighter, a policeman and an airman. They all live in doghouses that transform into vehicles adapted to their tasks. They are also equipped with special "dog backpacks" in which they carry all the tools needed for "dog jobs". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Peter Cugno (Francois), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Kingsley Marshall (Marshall)... / PAW Patrol - (S07, E25, anim. serija, SAD, 2020) Junak serije je dječak po imenu Ryder, vođa ekipe pasa tragača i spasitelja zvane Psići u ophodnji. Ekipa zajedno odlazi na zadatke u kojima rade na zaštiti priobalne zajednice zaljeva Adventure Bay. Svaki pas ima posebne vještine povezane s profesijama hitne službe, pa su članovi družine vatrogasac, policajac i zrakoplovac. Svi žive u psećim kućicama koje se preoblikuju u vozila prilagođena njihovim zadacima. Također su opremljeni posebnim "psećim ruksacima" u kojima nose sve alate potrebne za "pseće poslove". R.: Charles E. Bastien Ul.: Lilly Bartlam (Skye), Peter Cugno (Francois), Keegan Hedley (Rubble), Justin Paul Kelly (Chase), Kingsley Marshall (Marshall)...

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: The song "I'll do it all alone" - (children's program, Croatia) In the humorous song "I'll do it all alone" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own - without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message - that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time!... / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a - (dječji program, Hrvatska) U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami - bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku - da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!...

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: Juhuhu - (children's program, Croatia) JUHUHU is a children's morning program that includes cartoons, domestic and foreign shows for children of early school and kindergarten age. Through the morning and cheerful content, the Juhuhu people are led by actor-hosts who are there to tell a story, be a company for morning exercise, brush their teeth with a magical Juhuhu toothbrush or to teach their viewers some new, so far unknown things about the universe, chickens, sheep, refrigerators, trumpets, cabbage, broccoli and the secrets of Juhuhu plushies. Juhuhu is an adventure and the most beautiful way to spend the morning with a television program... / Juhuhu - (dječji program, Hrvatska) JUHUHU je dječji jutarnji program koji obuhvaća crtiće, domaće i strane emisije za djecu rane školske i vrtićke dobi. Kroz jutro i vesele sadržaje Juhuhuovce vode glumci voditelji koji su tu da ispričaju priču, budu društvo za jutarnju tjelovježbu, pranje zubića uz čarobnu Juhuhu četkicu ili da nauče svoje gledatelje nekim novim , do sada nepoznatim stvarima o svemiru, kokama, ovcama, hladnjacima, trubama, kupusu, brokulama i tajnama Juhuhu plišanaca. Juhuhu je pustolovina i najljepši način kako da provedete jutro uz televizijski program...

programme.title: Skitations / Skitancije
programme.desc: Skitancije (undiscovered Croatia) - (E01, doc. series, Croatia, 2014) Young biologist Goran Šafarek travels through the famous Baranja triangle Kopački rit - Danube - Drava in search of deer roar. He found himself in this area during a severe drought, which makes his journey even more exciting; where he is walking now, the water was high until recently, so he walks between scattered shells. Along the way, he meets interesting people, nature and river guardians, rare inhabitants of ethnic villages that are beautiful and eerily empty, an enthusiastic potter who makes jewelry from Drava stone, which he calls precious stone because of its value for the ecosystem. With a group of young ecologists, he sails down the Danube to a white sandbar that sometimes disappears, sometimes appears in a new, wonderful form. His mission is to help preserve rivers, without unnecessarily interfering with their flow and the life around them, as he likes to say: "Let the rivers breathe." R.: Darko Halapija... / Skitancije (neotkrivena Hrvatska) - (E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2014) Mladi biolog Goran Šafarek putuje glasovitim baranjskim trokutom Kopački rit - Dunav - Drava u potrazi za rikom jelena. U ovom području našao se za vrijeme velike suše što njegovo putovanje čini još uzbudljivijim; tamo gdje sada hoda do nedavno je bila visoka voda, pa prolazi između rasutih školjki. Putem susreće zanimljive ljude, čuvare prirode i čuvare rijeka, rijetke stanovnike etnosela koja su prelijepa i sablasno prazna, zanesenog keramičara koji izrađuje nakit iz dravskog kamena koji naziva dragi kamen zbog njegove vrijednosti za ekosustav. S grupom mladih ekologa Dunavom plovi do bijelog pješčanog spruda koji čas nestaje, čas se pojavljuje u nekom uvijek novom divnom obliku. Njegova je misija pomoći očuvanju rijeka, bez nepotrebnog upletanja u njihov tok i život oko njih, kako on to voli reći: "Pustite rijeke da dišu." R.: Darko Halapija...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: Salvation for Venice / Spas za Veneciju
programme.desc: Saving Venice - (doc. film, England, 2022) Venice is one of the most famous cities in the world. Her accommodation is a stimulus for her economic progress, but it also exposes her to floods. The first settlers drove wooden stakes into the soft mud of the lagoon and thus achieved sufficient strength for the soil to bear more weight. The whole city rests on this technique. Samples of thousand-year-old stakes show that the sludge slows down the rotting of wood, but increasingly frequent floods are a new threat. Restorers hurriedly remove the salt from the city's monuments, which, when it remains after evaporation, crystallizes and weakens the structure of the walls. After a decade of construction, MOSE, a multi-billion euro flood barrier system, is ready to protect the city. Passages have been built across three narrow bays that connect the lagoon to the open sea. In the control room, we monitor barrier raising operations as a devastating storm approaches the city. Despite the failure of the safety valves, the team manages to solve the problem and raise the door in time. The city is safe, but MOSE can only be used in exceptional circumstances because the barriers prevent the tides, which are necessary to remove pollution and human waste from the city. Engineers are working on plans to balance the two problems, including a groundbreaking project to pump billions of liters of seawater into aquifers deep beneath the city to raise the water level there by 25cm. Venice's relationship with the lagoon is crucial to the city's future and explains its current difficulties. In the 15th century, while the lagoon was getting clogged, large-scale engineering efforts prevented the lagoon from turning into dry land, but because of this, floods became more frequent. New routes to North and South America reduced Venice's trading power. In order to survive, the city was repurposed as an important tourist destination. Today, Venice attracts millions of tourists annually. R.: Duncan Bulling Ul.: Massimo Sergio Martella (Walter Mutti)... / Saving Venice - (dok. film, Engleska, 2022) Venecija je jedan od najpoznatijih gradova na svijetu. Njezin smještaj poticajan je za njezin gospodarski napredak, ali je zbog njega istodobno izložena poplavama. Prvi doseljenici zabijali su drvene kolce u meki mulj lagune i tako postigli dovoljnu čvrstoću da tlo podnese veću težinu. Na toj tehnici počiva cijeli grad. Uzorci kolaca starih tisuću godina pokazuju kako mulj usporava truljenje drva, ali sve češće poplave nova su prijetnja. Restauratori žurno uklanjaju sol s gradskih spomenika koja, kad ostane nakon isparavanja, kristalizira i slabi strukturu zidova. Nakon desetljeća izgradnje, MOSE, sustav poplavnih barijera vrijedan više milijardi eura, spreman je za zaštitu grada. Preko tri uske uvale koje povezuju lagunu s otvorenim morem izgrađeni su prolazi. U kontrolnoj sobi pratimo operacije podizanja barijera dok se gradu približava razorna oluja. Unatoč kvaru sigurnosnih ventila, ekipa uspijeva riješiti problem i na vrijeme podići vrata. Grad je siguran, ali MOSE se može primijeniti samo u iznimnim okolnostima jer barijere sprečavaju plimu i oseku, koje su nužne za uklanjanje onečišćenja i ljudskog otpada iz grada. Inženjeri rade na planovima za uravnoteženje ova dva problema, uključujući revolucionarni projekt ispumpavanja milijardi litara morske vode u vodonosnike duboko ispod grada kako bi se razina ondje podignula za 25 cm. Odnos Venecije s lagunom ključan je za budućnost grada i objašnjava njegove trenutne poteškoće. U 15. stoljeću, dok se laguna začepljivala, krupnim inženjerskim pothvatima spriječeno je pretvaranje lagune u suho tlo, ali zato su poplave postale učestalije. Nove rute prema Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi smanjile su trgovačku moć Venecije. Da bi preživio, grad je prenamijenjen u važnu turističku destinaciju. Danas Venecija privlači milijune turista godišnje. R.: Duncan Bulling Ul.: Massimo Sergio Martella (Walter Mutti)...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Klasika mundi - (concert film, Austria, 2025) Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic conducted by the renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal - bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Austrija, 2025) Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj - približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja...

programme.title: No signal area / Područje bez signala
programme.desc: Area without signal - (E05, drama series, Croatia, 2022) After a night spent with Tanja (L. Barić), the foreman Branoš (G. Bogdan) is greeted at home not only by his jealous wife Josip (A. Ramljak) but also bad news. After an attack on his doorstep, engineer Janda (I. Bajrović) ended up in the hospital and is in serious condition. Branoš tries to restrain Erol (S. Radoja) to whom Janda was like a father and who intends to deal with his real father Ragan (S. Štimac). Nikola (K. Mikić) and Oleg (R. Bitorajac) clash again over the uncertain future of the factory... Director: Dalibor Matanić Street: Goran Bogdan (Branos), Krešimir Mikić (Nikola), Rene Bitorajac (Oleg), Jovana Stojiljković (Seila), Tihana Lazović (Lipsa)... / Područje bez signala - (E05, igrana serija, Hrvatska, 2022) Nakon noći provedene s Tanjom (L. Barić) predradnika Branoša (G. Bogdan) kod kuće ne dočekuje samo ljubomorna supruga Josipa (A. Ramljak) nego i loše vijesti. Nakon napada na svom kućnom pragu, inženjer Janda (I. Bajrović) završio je u bolnici i u teškom je stanju. Branoš pokušava obuzdati Erola (S. Radoja) kojemu je Janda bio kao otac i koji se namjerava obračunati sa svojim pravim ocem Raganom (S. Štimac). Nikola (K. Mikić) i Oleg (R. Bitorajac) ponovno se sukobljavaju oko neizvjesne budućnosti tvornice... R.: Dalibor Matanić Ul.: Goran Bogdan (Branos), Krešimir Mikić (Nikola), Rene Bitorajac (Oleg), Jovana Stojiljković (Seila), Tihana Lazović (Lipsa)...

programme.title: No signal area / Područje bez signala
programme.desc: Area without a signal - (E06, drama series, Croatia, 2022) The client of the turbine stopped answering and Oleg (R. Bitorajac) travels to his home country in Africa. Oleg also brought Lipša (T. Lazović), now they are seriously in love. Riots have just broken out in the country, tourists are leaving the capital again and again. Oleg manages to find the client in the city and is forced to travel deeper into the desert where the fighting is going on. Lipša returns to Nuštin and conveys dramatic news to the workers and director Nikola (K. Mikić). The workers decide to complete the turbine no matter what... R.: Dalibor Matanić Ul.: Rene Bitorajac (Oleg), Krešimir Mikić (Nikola), Jovana Stojiljković (Seila), Goran Bogdan (Branos), Tihana Lazović (Lipsa)... / Područje bez signala - (E06, igrana serija, Hrvatska, 2022) Naručitelj turbine prestao se javljati i Oleg (R. Bitorajac) putuje u njegovu matičnu afričku državu. Oleg je poveo i Lipšu (T. Lazović), sad su već ozbiljno zaljubljeni. U državi su upravo izbili nemiri, turisti navrat-nanos napuštaju glavni grad. Oleg na uspijeva pronaći naručitelja u gradu i prisiljen je otputiti se dublje u pustinju gdje se vode borbe. Lipša se vraća u Nuštin i prenosi radnicima i direktoru Nikoli (K. Mikić) dramatične vijesti. Radnici odlučuju dovršiti turbinu bez obzira na sve... R.: Dalibor Matanić Ul.: Rene Bitorajac (Oleg), Krešimir Mikić (Nikola), Jovana Stojiljković (Seila), Goran Bogdan (Branos), Tihana Lazović (Lipsa)...

programme.title: Annie Hall / Annie Hall
programme.desc: Annie Hall - (comedy, USA, 1977) Neurotic comedian Alvy Singer (W. Allen) wistfully remembers his greatest love, Annie Hall (D. Keaton), looking for the reason for their breakup a year ago. Alvy has been visiting a psychiatrist regularly for 15 years. Even as a boy, he fell into unexplained depressions and thought that his classmates were jerks. He was married twice, one marriage falling apart because he and his wife, a liberal (C. Kane), could not agree on how J.F. Kennedy was killed. However, his greatest love was Annie Hall, a simple and confused girl he met at tennis. As he fell more and more in love with Annie, Alvy slowly managed to persuade her to devote herself seriously to her hobby - singing, start reading and attend evening lectures. When Annie grew from a girl to a woman, her relationship with Alvy became close... R.: Woody Allen Ul.: Diane Keaton (Annie Hall), Woody Allen (Alvy Singer), Tony Roberts (Rob), Carol Kane (Allison), Paul Simon (Tony Lacey)... / Annie Hall - (komedija, SAD, 1977) Neurotični komičar Alvy Singer (W. Allen) prisjeća se sa sjetom svoje najveće ljubavi Annie Hall (D. Keaton) tražeći razlog njihovog prekida od prije godinu dana. Već 15 godina Alvy redovito posjećuje psihijatra. Još kao dječak padao je u bezrazložne depresije i smatrao kako su njegovi razredni kolege kreteni. Bio je dvaput oženjen, jedan brak mu se raspao zato što se on i supruga, liberalka (C. Kane), nisu mogli složiti oko toga kako je ubijen J. F. Kennedy. Ipak, njegova najveća ljubav bila je Annie Hall, priprosta i zbunjena djevojka koju je upoznao na tenisu. Kako se sve više zajubljivao u Annie, Alvy ju je polako uspio nagovoriti da se ozbiljno posveti svom hobiju - pjevanju, počne čitati i pohađati večernja predavanja. Kada se Annie razvila iz djevojke u ženu, veza s Alvyjem postala joj je tijesna... R.: Woody Allen Ul.: Diane Keaton (Annie Hall), Woody Allen (Alvy Singer), Tony Roberts (Rob), Carol Kane (Allison), Paul Simon (Tony Lacey)...

programme.title: French connection / Francuska veza
programme.desc: The French Connection - (crime film, USA, 1971) New York detectives Jimmy Popeye Doyle (G. Hackman) and Buddy Cloudy Russo (R. Scheider) work in the narcotics division. They like the task of breaking the chain of transporting heroin from the south of France to the United States. The trail leads them to a New York candy store whose owners, Sal Broca (T. Lo Bianco) and his wife Angie, may be involved in the case. At the same time, in the French city of Marseille, the classy rich man Alain Charnier (F. Rey), the "king" of the local drug milieu, organizes business related to the sale of heroin to Americans. As he is informed about the progress of the investigation of Popeye and Cloudy, he decides to remove them and ensure the flow of drugs... R.: William Friedkin St.: Gene Hackman (Jimmy Doyle), Fernando Rey (Alain Charnier), Roy Scheider (Buddy Russo), Tony Lo Bianco (Sal Boca), Marcel Bozzuffi (Pierre Nicole)... / The French Connection - (krim. film, SAD, 1971) Newyorški detektivi Jimmy Popeye Doyle (G. Hackman) i Buddy Cloudy Russo (R. Scheider) rade u odjelu za narkotike. Dopadne ih zadatak da prekinu lanac transporta heroina iz južne Francuske u Sjedinjene Države. Trag ih dovede do newyorške trgovine slatkišima čiji bi vlasnici, Sal Broca (T. Lo Bianco) i njegova supruga Angie, mogli biti umiješani u slučaj. Istodobno, u francuskom gradu Marseilleu, otmjeni bogataš Alain Charnier (F. Rey), "kralj" mjesnoga narkomiljea, organizira poslove vezane uz prodaju heroina Amerikancima. Kako je informiran o napredovanju istrage Popeyea i Cloudyja, odluči ih ukloniti i osigurati protok droge... R.: William Friedkin Ul.: Gene Hackman (Jimmy Doyle), Fernando Rey (Alain Charnier), Roy Scheider (Buddy Russo), Tony Lo Bianco (Sal Boca), Marcel Bozzuffi (Pierre Nicoli)...

programme.title: Cavalier with a gun / Kavalir s pištoljem
programme.desc: The Old Man and the Gun - (biograf film, USA, 2018) Biographic/crime film. At the age of 70, Forrest Tucker escapes from San Quentin and commits a series of daring robberies that baffle the police and amaze the public. Detective John Hunt, amazed by Forrest's dedication to work, and a woman who loves him despite his "occupation" go in search of him... The film received numerous positive reviews, and at the Golden Globe Awards Robert Redford was nominated for the best actor in a comedy or musical. R.: David Lowery Ul.: Robert Redford (Forrest Tucker), Casey Affleck (John Hunt), Sissy Spacek (Jewel), Danny Glover (Teddy), Tom Waits (Waller)... / The Old Man and the Gun - (biograf. film, SAD, 2018) Biografski/kriminalistički film. U dobi od 70 godina Forrest Tucker pobjegne iz San Quentina i počini niz smjelih pljački koje zbune policiju i oduševe javnost. U potragu za njim kreću detektiv John Hunt, zadivljen Forrestovom predanošću poslu, i žena koja ga voli unatoč njegovu "zanimanju"... Film je dobio brojne pozitivne kritike, a na dodjeli Zlatnih globusa Robert Redford je nominiran za najboljeg glumca u komediji ili mjuziklu. R.: David Lowery Ul.: Robert Redford (Forrest Tucker), Casey Affleck (John Hunt), Sissy Spacek (Jewel), Danny Glover (Teddy), Tom Waits (Waller)...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazine, Croatia, 2025) Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karel Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon... / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu - (show magazin, Hrvatska, 2025) Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona...

programme.title: Ekpona / Eko zona
programme.desc: Eko zona - (E639, nature film, Croatia, 2025) Work is underway on the revitalization of the Opek Arboretum in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin. After the restoration of the Opeka castle, built in the Baroque style in the second half of the 17th century, which had been deteriorating for decades, sediment was removed from the small artificial lake and the planting of indigenous and rare species is planned. On the occasion of that project, an introductory conference was recently held. Jaškovo is a small settlement within the town of Ozlje in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records as far back as 1433, when Prince Bartol Frankopan gave the people of Jaškov the pasture around the Dobra River for their use. It is in this ancient region that the Kovač family's farm is located, which has high-mountain Scottish cattle in free-range pastures. In addition to cattle, the family also grows pumpkins, walnuts and hazelnuts in an ecological way. We also bring foreign news. The pearly series of islands and islets called Pakleni otoci has been a protected natural monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. Posidonia meadows still grow in its bays and straits... / Eko zona - (E639, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Nakon obnove dvorca Opeka, izgrađenog u baroknom stilu još u 2. polovici 17. stoljeća koji je desetljećima propadao, izvađen je sediment iz malenog umjetnog jezera te se planira sadnja autohtonih i rijetkih vrsta. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. Biserni niz otoka i otočića nazvan Pakleni otoci zaštićeni je spomenik prirode u kategoriji značajnog krajolika još od 1968. godine. U njegovim uvalama i tjesnacima i danas još rastu livade posidonije...

programme.title: Interview of the week / Intervju tjedna
programme.desc: Interview of the week - (talk show, Croatia) A show in which viewers will be able to see biographical interviews with people who are at the center of cultural interest that week. programme.title: Talents of EU regions / Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: Talents of the EU regions - (educational program, Slovenia) How do the regions of the European Union respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union - one of the key pillars of European development... / Talenti EU regij - (obrazovni program, Slovenija) Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije - jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja...

programme.title: The Beaver / The Beaver
programme.desc: Walter Black, a former executive of a toy company, suffers from problems in his marital and professional life that push him into depression, before he accidentally owns a hand-made Beaver doll that changes his life upside down. / والتر بلاك مدير تنفيذي سابق لإحدى شركات الألعاب والذي يعاني من مشاكل في حياته الزوجية والعملية تدفع به للاكتئاب، قبل أن يمتلك عن طريق المصادفة دمية "بيفر" يدوية تغيّر حياته رأساً على عقب.

programme.title: Long Shot / Long Shot
programme.desc: When Fred Flarsky reunites with his first crush, Charlotte Field, after she becomes one of the most influential women in the world, he charms her and captures her admiration, all while she is preparing to enter the race for President of the United States, hiring him as her speechwriter. / عندما يجتمع (فريد فلارسكي) من جديد مع أول فتاة أعجب بها، (شارلوت فيلد)، بعد أن أصبحت واحدة من أكثر النساء تأثيرًا في العالم، فإنه يسحرها ويستحوذ على إعجابها، كل ذلك بينما كانت هي تستعد للدخول في سباق رئاسة الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية، حيث استأجرته ككاتب لخطاباتها.

programme.title: Get Smart / Get Smart
programme.desc: Maxwell Smart works in an American spy agency in an administrative position, trying in every way to join the category of secret agents. When the agency's headquarters is attacked and its confidential data is stolen, the agency's director decides to promote him to a secret agent and send him on that mission with Agent 99, who recently had plastic surgery because she is not registered with the agency. They set off to try to track the intruder into Russian territory, and many comical paradoxes happen to them. / ماكسويل سمارت يعمل في إحدى وكالات التجسس الأمريكية في وظيفة إدارية، يحاول بكل الطرق الانضمام لفئة العملاء السريين. حينما يتم مهاجمة مقر الوكالة وسرقة بياناتها السرية، يقرر مدير الوكالة ترقيته لعميل سري وإرساله في تلك المهمة مع العميلة 99 التي قامت بعملية تجميلية مؤخرا لأنها غير مسجلة في الوكالة. ينطلقا لمحاولة تتبع المقتحم إلى الأراضي الروسية فتحدث لهما العديد من المفارقات الكوميدية.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie 2 / The Angry Birds Movie 2
programme.desc: When King Leonardo of Pig Island tries to take revenge on the Angry Birds after they destroyed his home in a battle to retrieve their eggs from it, there is in the meantime Zita, the mysterious purple bird, who is tired of his life on a remote icy island, and threatens them all with her own plans for invasion. / عندما يحاول الملك (ليوناردو) ملك جزيرة الخنزير الانتقام من الطيور الغاضبة بعدما دمروا موطنه في معركة استعادة بيضهم منه، يكون هناك في هذه الأثناء (زيتا) الطائر الأرجواني الغامض، والمتعب من حياته في جزيرة جليدية نائية، وتهددهم جميعًا بخططها الخاصة للغزو.

programme.title: Marry Me / Marry Me
programme.desc: As music stars Kat Valdez and Bastian prepare to get married in front of an audience at an international ceremony, Kat discovers that Bastian is unfaithful, so she decides instead to marry Charlie, a stranger in the crowd at the party. / بينما يستعد نجمي الموسيقى كات فالديز وباستيان للزواج أمام الجمهور في حفل عالمي، تكتشف كات أن باستيان خائن، فتقرر بدلاً من ذلك الزواج من تشارلي، وهو غريب بين الحشود في الحفل.

programme.title: Aloha / Aloha
programme.desc: Brian is a 37-year-old weapons consultant for the US Army. Almost no one likes him. His only friend is a highly advanced computer named Tiki. The US Army sends him to the island of Hawaii to supervise the launch of a spy satellite. He meets Major Lisa Ng, who does not have a great sense of humor. He also meets Tracy, the only love of his life after she got married and has two children. On this island, he discovers himself again. / (بريان) مستشار أسلحة للجيش الأمريكي يبلغ من العمر 37 عامًا، وتقريبًا لا يحبه أحد، صديقه الوحيد حاسوب متطور للغاية اسمه (تيكي). يرسله الجيش الأمريكي لجزيرة (هاواي) ليشرف على إطلاق قمر صناعي تجسسي، يتقابل مع الميجور (ليزا إن جي) التي لا تتمتع بروح الدعابة كثيرًا، ويقابل أيضًا (تريسي) الحب الوحيد في حياته بعدما تزوجت وأصبح لديها طفلان، وعلى هذه الجزيرة يكتشف نفسه من جديد.

programme.title: Burn / Burn
programme.desc: A gas station is attacked and armed by a desperate man looking for money. Hence, an unstable worker at the gas station decides to communicate with the thief because he remains on the sidelines all the time. / تتعرض محطة بنزين لهجوم وسطو مسلح من قبل رجل يائس يبحث عن المال، ومن هنا يقرر عامل غير مستقر في محطة البنزين أن يتواصل مع السارق بسبب بقائه طيلة الوقت على الهامش.

programme.title: The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Her / The Disappearance of Eleanor Rigby: Her
programme.desc: A story told from a female perspective, and it is the story of the couple (Eleanor) and (Connor), who are trying to restore their lives with the love that was overwhelming its details, repair what was corrupted from their distant past, and correct the course of their relationship to reach its optimal form. / قصة تُروى من منظور أنثوي، وهى قصة الزوجيّن (إليانور) و(كونور)، اللذان يحاولان استعادة حياتهما بالحب الذي كان يغمر تفاصيلها، ويصلحان ما فسد من ماضيهما البعيد، ويصوّبان مسار علاقتهما ليصلا بها للشكل الأمثل.

programme.title: The Colony / The Colony
programme.desc: Error 500 (Server Error)!!1500.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know. / ينتمي (The Colony) لنوعية أفلام الخيال العلمي المستقبلية، فيتحدث الفلم حول كارثة بيئية أعادت العصر الجليدي ، وأدت إلى انقراض البشر نتيجة الجوع والبرد والأمراض وظهور الزومبي ، أما القلة الباقية فتتجمع في مستعمرات منفصلة تحت الأرض ، محاولين البحث عن طوق للنجاة ، وطريقة للخروج .

programme.title: Battle: Los Angeles / Battle: Los Angeles
programme.desc: The city of Los Angeles is being invaded by aliens. The US Marines are trying to confront these invaders, trying to evacuate the city of residents and save the city from destruction. More ground forces are deployed in an attempt to regain control of the city. So, will the American forces be able to succeed in their mission? / تتعرض مدينة (لوس أنجلوس) لغزو من بعض الكائنات الفضائية، فتحاول قوات المارينز الأمريكية التصدي لهؤلاء الغزاة محاولين إخلاء المدينة من السكان، وإنقاذ المدينة من الدمار، ويتم نشر المزيد من القوات البرية في محاولة لاستعادة السيطرة على المدينة. فترى هل ستتمكن القوات الأمريكية من النجاج في مهمتها؟

programme.title: Godzilla: King of the Monsters / Godzilla: King of the Monsters
programme.desc: The film follows the diligent efforts of a secret animal society (Monarch) when they come face to face with a group of massive monsters, including the massive dinosaur Godzilla, who faces off against the three-headed King Gidroit, leaving humanity with an unknown fate. / يتابع الفيلم الجهود الحثيثة التي تقوم بها إحدى الجمعيات السرية المعنية بالحيوانات (مونارك) حينما تتواجه وجهًا لوجه مجموعة من الوحوش الضخمة بما فيهم الديناصور الهائل جودزيلا الذي يواجه كينج جيدروا ذو الرؤوس الثلاثة، مما يترك البشرية أمام مصير مجهول.

programme.title: 47 Meters Down: Uncaged / 47 Meters Down: Uncaged
programme.desc: While diving in a destroyed underwater city, four teenage girls discover that they are not alone inside the maze of submerged caves, and that they have entered an area infested with the fiercest types of sharks. / تكتشف أربع فتيات مراهقات أثناء ممارسة رياضة الغوص في مدينة مدمرة تحت الماء، أنهن لسن بمفردهن داخل متاهة الكهوف المغمورة بالمياه، وأنهم قد دخلوا في منطقة عامرة بأشرس أنواع أسماك القرش

programme.title: Life / Life
programme.desc: The film tells the story of the six-member crew of the International Space Station, who are on the verge of one of the most important discoveries in human history - the first evidence of extraterrestrial life on Mars. Once they begin their research, they encounter unexpected consequences and discover that the life form there is more intelligent than anyone expected. / يروي الفيلم قصة طاقم المحطة الفضائية الدولية المُكوّن من ستة أفراد، والذين على شفا واحد من أهم الاكتشافات في التاريخ البشري، ألا وهو أول دليل على وجود حياة خارج الأرض على كوكب المريخ، وبمجرد شروعهم في إجراء بحوثهم يبلغون عواقب غير متوقعة ويكتشفون أن شكل الحياة هناك أكثر ذكاءًا من توقعات أي شخص.

programme.title: Aloha / Aloha
programme.desc: Brian is a 37-year-old weapons consultant for the US Army. Almost no one likes him. His only friend is a highly advanced computer named Tiki. The US Army sends him to the island of Hawaii to supervise the launch of a spy satellite. He meets Major Lisa Ng, who does not have a great sense of humor. He also meets Tracy, the only love of his life after she got married and has two children. On this island, he discovers himself again. / (بريان) مستشار أسلحة للجيش الأمريكي يبلغ من العمر 37 عامًا، وتقريبًا لا يحبه أحد، صديقه الوحيد حاسوب متطور للغاية اسمه (تيكي). يرسله الجيش الأمريكي لجزيرة (هاواي) ليشرف على إطلاق قمر صناعي تجسسي، يتقابل مع الميجور (ليزا إن جي) التي لا تتمتع بروح الدعابة كثيرًا، ويقابل أيضًا (تريسي) الحب الوحيد في حياته بعدما تزوجت وأصبح لديها طفلان، وعلى هذه الجزيرة يكتشف نفسه من جديد.

programme.title: Savage Dog / Savage Dog
programme.desc: In the Indochina region in 1959, a town is controlled by a group of Vietnamese and European war leaders. There lies the Dien Dan Chan camp, which is considered the worst prison in this region. Among its prisoners is the former boxer Martin Tilliman. With his release imminent, the prison forces are keen to keep him behind bars, but he intends to take revenge. / في منطقة الهند الصينية في عام 1959، يسيطر على إحدى البلدات مجموعة من قادة الحرب الفيتناميين واﻷوروبيين، وهناك يقبع معسكر دين دان شان الذي يعد أسوأ سجن في هذه المنطقة، ومن سجنائه الملاكم السابق مارتن تليمان، ومع قرب اطلاق سراحه، تحرص قوات السجن على إبقائه وراء القضبان، لكنه ينوي الانتقام.

programme.title: Unfaithful / Unfaithful
programme.desc: Connie and Edward Summers are a middle-aged couple living in a house in a New York suburb. Their marriage is happy and stable, but lacking in intimacy. During Connie's visit to the city, a storm occurs and she collides with Paul and injures her foot, so he offers her help in his apartment. He tries to get close to her, but she refuses and leaves the house. Paul continues to occupy her mind, and she continues to visit his house for various reasons, until she becomes involved in a physical relationship with him, and their relationship continues, and soon Edward begins to suspect his wife of infidelity. / كوني وإدوارد سمرز زوجان في منتصف العمر يعيشان بمنزل بإحدى ضواحي نيويورك، زواجهما سعيد ومستقر لكنه يفتقر للحميمية. في زيارة لكوني للمدينة تحدث عاصفة وتصطدم بـبول وتصاب في قدمها فيعرض عليها المساعدة في شقته. يحاول التقرب منها لكنها ترفض وتترك المنزل. يظل بول يشغل تفكيرها فتظل تتردد على منزله لأسباب مختلفة، حتى تتورط في علاقة جسدية معه، وتستمر علاقتهما، وسرعان ما يبدأ إدوارد في الشك في خيانة زوجته.

programme.title: Lion / Lion
programme.desc: The film's events revolve around a five-year-old Indian boy who gets lost in the streets of Calcutta, which is thousands of miles away from his home. He struggles and faces many challenges until he is adopted by a couple from Australia. Twenty-five years after his adoption, he goes out to search for his lost family in India. / تدور أحداث الفيلم عن طفل هندي في الخامسة من عمره يتوه في شوارع (كالكوتا)، والتي تبعد آلاف الأميال عن منزله، يكافح ويواجه العديد من التحديات إلى أن يتبناه زوجيّن من أستراليا، وبعد خمسة وعشرين عامًا من تبنيه، فيخرج للبحث عن عائلته المفقودة في الهند.

programme.title: To be jealous / Kıskanmak
programme.desc: The events revolve around Siniha, who grew up in a wealthy family devoid of affection. She finds herself forced to confront her past while seeking to determine her destiny, identity, and being. However, envy and jealousy creep into all of her relationships, turning her life upside down. / تدور الأحداث حول (سينيهة)، التي نشأت في عائلة ثرية خالية من المودة، وتجد نفسها مضطرة لمواجهة ماضيها بينما تسعى لتحديد مصيرها وهويتها وكيانها، لكن الحسد والغيرة يتسللان إلى كل علاقاتها، ويقلبان حياتها رأسًا على عقب.

programme.title: His eyes are Black Sea / Gozleri Karadeniz
programme.desc: A young man from the Black Sea discovers that he is the heir to a powerful and influential Turkish family, and as he delves into the dark depths of Istanbul in search of answers about his past, he encounters a complex web of familial rivalry and forbidden romance. / يكتشف شاب من البحر الأسود أنه وريث عائلة تركية قوية وذات نفوذ، وبينما يغوص في أعماق إسطنبول المظلمة باحثًا عن إجابات حول ماضيه، يواجه شبكة معقدة من التنافس العائلي والرومانسية المحرمة.

programme.title: Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Except me, part 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Client / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around two brothers, Amir and Wissam, who have been separated by fate since childhood. Amir grows up to become a police officer, but joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together without knowing their true selves, and their fates are intertwined in a thrilling, suspense-filled setting. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: Secret Part 2: Challenge / سر ج2: التحدي
programme.desc: Amer Badran's battle begins after his release from prison to confront Detective Jad again, and to work with the Don in the contraband trade, and events escalate. / تبدأ معركة عامر بدران بعد خروجه من الحبس لمواجهة المحقق جاد من جديد، والعمل مع الدون في تجارة الممنوعات لتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Except me, part 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Inheritance Part 3 / الميراث ج3
programme.desc: Overnight, conditions change in this part. With Haifa's reappearance, Youssef decides to reconcile his calculations, marry her, and forgive her, while fire breaks out between Dima and Majed and they divorce, and Sahar decides to take revenge on everyone who caused her son's death. / ما بين ليلة وضحاها تتبدل الأحوال في هذ الجزء، فمع عودة هيفاء للظهور مرة أخرى يقرر يوسف إعادة حساباته والزواج منها ومسامحتها، في حين تشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد ويقع الطلاق بينهما، وتقرر سحر الانتقام من كل من تسبب في وفاة ابنها.

programme.title: Miss Farah Part 5 / الآنسة فرح ج5
programme.desc: The events of the fifth part revolve around Farah preparing to marry Shadi, but soon she faces a series of surprises that force her to adapt to her new reality, and events continue. / تدور أحداث الجزء الخامس حول استعداد (فرح) للزواج من (شادي)، ولكن سرعان ما تواجه سلسلة من المفاجآت تجبرها على التأقلم مع واقعها الجديد وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Films and Stars / Films and Stars
programme.desc: A program that is shown every Sunday, covering many news from the world of Hollywood, in addition to the scenes of films, revenues, and many topics and news of interest to cinema lovers in the world. / برنامج يُعرض في كل يوم أحد، يتناول العديد من أخبار عالم هوليوود، بجانب كواليس الأفلام والإيرادات والعديد من المواضيع والأخبار التي تهم محبي السينما في العالم.

programme.title: The Unfaithful S2 / The Unfaithful S2
programme.desc: In the second part, Asya decides to move away from Tekirdag and travel to Istanbul to build a new life with her son, Ali, after what happened with her husband, but she meets Aras, who is involved in an accident on his way to Tekirdag. / في الجزء الثاني، تقرر (آسيا) الابتعاد عن (تيكيرداغ) والسفر إلى إسطنبول لبناء حياة جديدة مع ابنها (علي) بعد ما حدث مع زوجها، ولكنها تلتقي بـ(أراس) الذي يتعرض لحادث في طريقه إلى (تيكيرداغ).

programme.title: Rock Paper Scissors / Tas Kagit Makas
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, a cleaner who suffers from Alzheimer's is accused of murder, and his son, who has an uncanny memory, must help him, because he has become his last hope of survival and proving his innocence in the face of a family that has great influence in Istanbul. / في إطار درامي، يتعرض عامل نظافة مريض بالزهايمر لاتهام بالقتل، ويجب على ابنه صاحب الذاكرة الخارقة أن يساعده، لأنه أصبح أمله الأخير في النجاة، وإثبات براءته في مواجهة عائلة لديها نفوذ كبير في إسطنبول.

programme.title: Birth certificate part 2 / شهادة ميلاد ج2
programme.desc: In the second season, Narges discovers that Kulthum and Qasim are not her real parents, and that she was replaced with another child when she was born. Then there are dramatic consequences as a result of this, and events follow. / في الموسم الثاني، تكتشف (نرجس) بأن (كلثوم) و(قاسم) ليسا أبويها الحقيقيين، وأنه تم تبديلها بمولود آخر حين ولادتها. ثم تحدث تبعات مثيرة نتيجة لهذا الأمر وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Whole number +1 / كامل العدد +1
programme.desc: The events revolve around Ahmed and Laila, as they find themselves in unenviable situations. After the development of their children’s lives, their many problems, and the announcement of the arrival of a new person into their lives. / تدور الأحداث حول (أحمد) و(ليلى)، حيث يجدان نفسيهما في مواقف لا يُحسدان عليها؛ بعد تطور حياة أولادهما، وكثرة مشاكلهما، وإعلان قدوم شخص جديد إلى حياتهما.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: Within a comedy-drama framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are exposed to the secrets, mysteries, and crimes hidden behind the closed doors of these homes, and often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: I'm free / أنا حرة
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, Nour goes through a harsh marriage experience with a narcissistic man who imposes psychological and physical violence on her. Her personal battle quickly turns into a struggle with society as a whole, after the husband tightens his control over daughter Farah by virtue of his right to custody. programme.title: earthquake / زلزال
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around the period of the 1992 earthquake, about Harbi, who buys a house in installments from Khalil. When the time comes to pay the last installment, he demands that he register the house in his name and give up his ownership. However, Khalil delays until the 1992 earthquake occurs, in which Harbi dies and the house collapses as a result of the earthquake and its consequences. Khalil then refuses to hand over the plot of land on which the house was built to the heirs. The deceased, which creates a clash between him and Muhammad Ibn Harbi, and despite the latter’s love story with Khalil’s daughter, the girl’s father stands as an obstacle between them. / تدور أحداث مسلسل في فترة زلزال 1992، عن (حربي) الذي يشتري منزلا بالقسط من (خليل) وحين يأتي موعد سداد القسط الأخير، يطالبه بتسجيل البيت باسمه والتنازل عن ملكيته، إلا أن (خليل) يُماطل إلى أن يقع "زلزال 1992" الذي يلقى فيه (حربي) حتفه وينهار المنزل على إثر الزلزال وتبعاته، فيرفض حينها خليل تسليم قطعة الأرض التي كان المنزل يُقام عليها لورثة الراحل، ما يخلق صدامًا بينه وبين محمد ابن حربي، وعلى الرغم من وجود قصة حب تجمع الأخير بابنة خليل، فإن والد الفتاة يقف عائقا بينهما.

programme.title: I love you / Mujhe Pyar Hua Tha
programme.desc: The events take place in a romantic context, where Saad falls in love with his cousin, Maher, and when he fails to confess his love and feelings for her, his life takes a radically different turn. / تدور الأحداث في إطار رومانسي، حيث يقع (سعد) في حب ابنة عمه (ماهير)، وعندما يفشل في الاعتراف لها بحبه ومشاعره تجاهها، تأخذ حياته منعطفًا مختلفًا جذريًا.

programme.title: Profa / بروفا
programme.desc: Majed works as a principal at a private school for his grandmother, Laila, but he sees that he is not doing anything at school, so he seeks change, as well as in his private life because of the problems between him and his wife, Nora, and upon getting to know Layal, who works as a dog trainer and a musician in a restaurant, a number of paradoxes and situations begin between them. / يعمل ماجد مدير مدرسة خاصة عند جدته ليلى، لكنه يرى أنه لا يقوم بشيء في المدرسة فيسعى للتغيير، وكذلك في حياته الخاصة بسبب المشاكل التي بينه وبين زوجته نورا، وبتعرفه على ليال التي تعمل مدربة كلاب وعازفة في مطعم، تبدأ بينهما عدد من المفارقات والمواقف.

However, Khalil delays until the 1992 earthquake occurs, in which Harbi dies and the house collapses as a result of the earthquake and its consequences. Khalil then refuses to hand over the plot of land on which the house was built to the heirs. The deceased, which creates a clash between him and Muhammad Ibn Harbi, and despite the latter’s love story with Khalil’s daughter, the girl’s father stands as an obstacle between them. / تدور أحداث مسلسل في فترة زلزال 1992، عن (حربي) الذي يشتري منزلا بالقسط من (خليل) وحين يأتي موعد سداد القسط الأخير، يطالبه بتسجيل البيت باسمه والتنازل عن ملكيته، إلا أن (خليل) يُماطل إلى أن يقع "زلزال 1992" الذي يلقى فيه (حربي) حتفه وينهار المنزل على إثر الزلزال وتبعاته، فيرفض حينها خليل تسليم قطعة الأرض التي كان المنزل يُقام عليها لورثة الراحل، ما يخلق صدامًا بينه وبين محمد ابن حربي، وعلى الرغم من وجود قصة حب تجمع الأخير بابنة خليل، فإن والد الفتاة يقف عائقا بينهما.

programme.title: Kaf Waduf / كف ودفوف
programme.desc: A social drama that takes place during the 1980s, in which Salima leads a women's singing group, but is forced to retire after the death of her husband, as hallucinations control her, and she believes that there is a jinn following her and putting her life and the life of her family at stake. / دراما اجتماعية تدور خلال ثمانينيات القرن الماضي، حيث سليمة التي تقود فرقة غنائية نسائية، ولكن تضطر للاعتزال بعد وفاة زوجها، حيث تُسيطر عليها الهلاوس، وتعتقد بوجود جن يتبعها ويجعل حياتها وحياة أسرتها على المحك.

programme.title: Parineetii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic context, as fate leads two close friends to marry the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and events follow one another. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: House 12 / منزل 12
programme.desc: Munira has an unusual sense that makes her see things from other worlds, so she helps people with that sense, until her young son Saqr dies in a car accident, so her life turns upside down and she decides to stay away from everything, and live a quiet life with her husband Muhammad, but the appearance of her neighbor Nadia in their lives changes the situation to the worst. / تمتلك منيرة حاسة غير عادية تجعلها ترى أشياء من العوالم الأخرى، فتساعد الناس بتلك الحاسة، إلى أن يتوفى ابنها الصغير صقر في حادث سيارة، فتنقلب حياتها رأسا على عقب وتقرر الابتعاد عن كل شيء، وتحيا حياة هادئة مع زوجها محمد، إلا أن ظهور جارتها نادية في حياتهما يبدل الأحوال إلى ما لا يحمد عقباه.

programme.title: Gamma Island / جزيرة غمام
programme.desc: Khaldoun and Al-Ayqa Al-Ghajariya settle on Gammam Island and try to control the people of the island, thinking that it contains a treasure and a big secret that no one knows. They try to extend their influence to implement their plan. Will the people of the island confront them, led by Arafat, Al-Ajmi, and Muhareb? / يستقر خلدون والعايقة الغجرية في جزيرة غمام ويحاولان السيطرة على أهل الجزيرة ظنًا منهم أنها تحوي كنز وسر كبير لا يعلمه أحد ويحاولان بسط نفوذهم لتنفيذ مخططهم، فهل يتصدى أهل الجزيرة لهما بقيادة عرفات والعجمي ومحارب.

programme.title: Kaf Waduf / كف ودفوف
programme.desc: A social drama that takes place during the 1980s, in which Salima leads a women's singing group, but is forced to retire after the death of her husband, as hallucinations control her, and she believes that there is a jinn following her and putting her life and the life of her family at stake. / دراما اجتماعية تدور خلال ثمانينيات القرن الماضي، حيث سليمة التي تقود فرقة غنائية نسائية، ولكن تضطر للاعتزال بعد وفاة زوجها، حيث تُسيطر عليها الهلاوس، وتعتقد بوجود جن يتبعها ويجعل حياتها وحياة أسرتها على المحك.

programme.title: Take care Zizi / خلي بالك من زيزي
programme.desc: After her attempt to give birth again fails, disagreements arise between Zainab and her husband, Hisham, and the matter quickly develops into court and Zainab is in danger of losing everything besides motherhood. / بعد فشل محاولتها للإنجاب مجددا، تضرب الخلافات بين زينب وزوجها هشام، وسرعان ما يتطور الأمر لساحات القضاء وتصبح زينب في خطر بفقدان كل شيء بجانب الأمومة.

programme.title: Eviction order / أمر إخلاء
programme.desc: A family is exposed to a major disaster when the father loses his property. The family gradually declines and their lives are turned upside down in their new position, and they must deal with the new situation. / تتعرض عائلة لكارثة كبيرة، حينما يخسر الأب ممتلكاته، لتنحدر العائلة رويدًا رويدًا وتنقلب حياتهم رأسًا على عقب في مكانتهم الجديدة، وعليهم التعامل مع الوضع الجديد.

programme.title: Love game / لعبة حب
programme.desc: A rich young man falls in love with a poor girl, then later discovers that his relative and grandfather were the ones who paid money to the girl, taking advantage of her need, so that she could trap him in her net and marry her, and events continue. / يقع شاب ثري في حب فتاة فقيرة، ثم يكتشف لاحقًا أن قريبته وجده هما من دفعا المال إلى الفتاة استغلالًا لاحتياجها، لكي توقعه في شباكها ويتزوجها، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: I have the right to love / من حقي أحب
programme.desc: A romantic drama that revolves around an engineer and his wife who live a tense and unstable life to the point that they get into many disagreements together, and their lives become more disturbed after their friends interfere. / دراما رومانسية تدور حول مهندس وزوجته يعيشان حياة متوترة وغير مستقرة لدرجة دخولهما في خلافات كثيرة معا، وتضطرب حياتهما أكثر بعد تدخل أصدقاءهما فيها.

programme.title: Lost in Someones Love / Lost in Someones Love
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, Sai Joshi lives with her father and is a brave, honest and fair girl who aspires to become a doctor, but she finds herself in a family dilemma during which she is forced to marry a police officer. / في إطار درامي، تعيش ساي جوشي مع والدها وهي فتاة شجاعة وصادقة ونزيهة تطمح لأن تصبح طبيبة، ولكنها تجد نفسها في معضلة عائلية مجبرة خلالها على الزواج من ضابط شرطة.

programme.title: Oh God, I am fasting / اللهم إني صايم
programme.desc: The story of the series “Oh God, I am Fasting” revolves around “Ali Abu Al Karamat” (Mustafa Shaaban). Ali lived all his life spoiled by his mother and was not punished for his mistakes. He grew up to become an abnormal person. He always lies and never tells the truth, and everyone around him knows his lies. Ali begins to exploit his talent for lying in order to make money, so he defrauds some major businessmen. Ali believes that these people's money should be taken from them to the poor, but the businessmen begin to uncover his fraud, and these businessmen, in addition to the police, chase him. What will happen in this chase? Will Ali be arrested, will businessmen find him to take revenge on him, or will he be able to escape? / تدور احداث قصة مسلسل “اللهم إني صائم” حول “على ابو الكرامات” (مصطفى شعبان) , عاش “علي” طوال حياته مدلل من والدته و لا يتم عقابه على اخطائه , فكبر ليصبح انسان غير سوي , دائمًا ما يكذب و لا يقول الحقيقة ابدًا و كل من حوله يعرفون كذبه . يبدأ “علي” استغلال موهبته في الكذب تلك من اجل جني المال , فيقوم بالنصب على بعض رجال الاعمال الكبار . يؤمن “علي” بان اولائك الاشخاص يجب ان يؤخذ من مالهم للفقراء , و لكن يبدأ رجال الاعمال في كشف نصبه, و يطارده رجال الاعمال اولائك بالاضافة الى الشرطة . ماذا سيحدث في تلك المطاردة ؟. هل يتم القبض على “علي” او يعثر عليه رجال الاعمال لينتقموا منه ام يستطيع الهروب ؟.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic setting, the wealthy and reckless businessman (Ashraf) falls in love with (Roya), whom he has been searching for a person like her all his life, but what he does not know is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: Within a comedy-drama framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are exposed to the secrets, mysteries, and crimes hidden behind the closed doors of these homes, and often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: Wild Bees / Wild Bees
programme.desc: In a context of crime and drama, after the death of their father, his three daughters must confront the richest man in their village who wants to buy their fields by force and by offering several temptations. / في إطار من الجريمة والدراما، وبعد وفاة والدهن، يتعين على بناته الثلاث مواجهة أغنى رجل في قريتهم الذي يريد شراء حقولهم بالقوة ومن خلال تقديم عدة مغريات.

programme.desc: After her attempt to give birth again fails, disagreements arise between Zainab and her husband, Hisham, and the matter quickly develops into court and Zainab is in danger of losing everything besides motherhood. / بعد فشل محاولتها للإنجاب مجددا، تضرب الخلافات بين زينب وزوجها هشام، وسرعان ما يتطور الأمر لساحات القضاء وتصبح زينب في خطر بفقدان كل شيء بجانب الأمومة.

programme.title: Eviction order / أمر إخلاء
programme.desc: A family is exposed to a major disaster when the father loses his property. The family gradually declines and their lives are turned upside down in their new position, and they must deal with the new situation. / تتعرض عائلة لكارثة كبيرة، حينما يخسر الأب ممتلكاته، لتنحدر العائلة رويدًا رويدًا وتنقلب حياتهم رأسًا على عقب في مكانتهم الجديدة، وعليهم التعامل مع الوضع الجديد.

programme.title: Love game / لعبة حب
programme.desc: A rich young man falls in love with a poor girl, then later discovers that his relative and grandfather were the ones who paid money to the girl, taking advantage of her need, so that she could trap him in her net and marry her, and events continue. / يقع شاب ثري في حب فتاة فقيرة، ثم يكتشف لاحقًا أن قريبته وجده هما من دفعا المال إلى الفتاة استغلالًا لاحتياجها، لكي توقعه في شباكها ويتزوجها، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: I have the right to love / من حقي أحب
programme.desc: A romantic drama that revolves around an engineer and his wife who live a tense and unstable life to the point that they get into many disagreements together, and their lives become more disturbed after their friends interfere. / دراما رومانسية تدور حول مهندس وزوجته يعيشان حياة متوترة وغير مستقرة لدرجة دخولهما في خلافات كثيرة معا، وتضطرب حياتهما أكثر بعد تدخل أصدقاءهما فيها.

programme.title: Lost in Someones Love / Lost in Someones Love
programme.desc: In a dramatic context, Sai Joshi lives with her father and is a brave, honest and fair girl who aspires to become a doctor, but she finds herself in a family dilemma during which she is forced to marry a police officer. / في إطار درامي، تعيش ساي جوشي مع والدها وهي فتاة شجاعة وصادقة ونزيهة تطمح لأن تصبح طبيبة، ولكنها تجد نفسها في معضلة عائلية مجبرة خلالها على الزواج من ضابط شرطة.

programme.title: Oh God, I am fasting / اللهم إني صايم
programme.desc: The story of the series “Oh God, I am Fasting” revolves around “Ali Abu Al Karamat” (Mustafa Shaaban). Ali lived all his life spoiled by his mother and was not punished for his mistakes. He grew up to become an abnormal person. He always lies and never tells the truth, and everyone around him knows his lies. Ali begins to exploit his talent for lying in order to make money, so he defrauds some major businessmen. Ali believes that these people's money should be taken from them to the poor, but the businessmen begin to uncover his fraud, and these businessmen, in addition to the police, chase him. What will happen in this chase? Will Ali be arrested, will businessmen find him to take revenge on him, or will he be able to escape? / تدور احداث قصة مسلسل “اللهم إني صائم” حول “على ابو الكرامات” (مصطفى شعبان) , عاش “علي” طوال حياته مدلل من والدته و لا يتم عقابه على اخطائه , فكبر ليصبح انسان غير سوي , دائمًا ما يكذب و لا يقول الحقيقة ابدًا و كل من حوله يعرفون كذبه . يبدأ “علي” استغلال موهبته في الكذب تلك من اجل جني المال , فيقوم بالنصب على بعض رجال الاعمال الكبار . يؤمن “علي” بان اولائك الاشخاص يجب ان يؤخذ من مالهم للفقراء , و لكن يبدأ رجال الاعمال في كشف نصبه, و يطارده رجال الاعمال اولائك بالاضافة الى الشرطة . ماذا سيحدث في تلك المطاردة ؟. هل يتم القبض على “علي” او يعثر عليه رجال الاعمال لينتقموا منه ام يستطيع الهروب ؟.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic setting, the wealthy and reckless businessman (Ashraf) falls in love with (Roya), whom he has been searching for a person like her all his life, but what he does not know is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.
